354-547.title: 📖 Al-Muzanī: No one possesses obedience from himself
354-547.body:
🖋️ **Ismāʿīl ibn Yaḥyā al-Muzanī** said:

***“Creation acts according to His prior knowledge and proceeds to that for which He created it, of good and of evil. They possess no benefit of obedience from themselves, and they find no way to turn sin away from themselves.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The servant is not independent of Allah. **Obedience, steadfastness and protection from sin** are gifts from Allah; that is why a person always needs His guidance and help.

abd-ar-rahman-ibn-mahdi-imam-im-wissen-4.title: 📖 Not everyone who relates a great deal is an imam in knowledge
abd-ar-rahman-ibn-mahdi-imam-im-wissen-4.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān b. Mahdī** said:

***“When a man meets someone above him in knowledge, that is the day of his gain. When he meets someone equal to him, he reviews with him and learns from him. And when he meets someone beneath him, he is humble toward him and teaches him. No one is an imam in knowledge who relates everything he hears, nor one who narrates from everyone, nor one who relates shādhdh reports.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Knowledge is not mere quantity, but an amānah.** Whoever relates everything he hears has not yet understood that the Sunnah is preserved through **examination**, **restraint** and **sound transmission**.

abdullah-ibn-amr-fitnah-huete-deine-zung.title: 📖 In the fitnah: guard your tongue
abdullah-ibn-amr-fitnah-huete-deine-zung.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr** رضي الله عنهما reported:

When the Prophet ﷺ mentioned the fitnah, I asked:

***“What should I do then, O Messenger of Allah?”***

He ﷺ replied:

***“Remain in your house, keep your tongue under control, hold to what you know to be right, and avoid what you recognize as wrong.***

***Attend to your own affair and keep away from the affair of the public.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**
In times of fitnah, safety does not lie in joining every dispute. The believer protects his dīn, controls his tongue and holds to what he knows with certainty from the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

abdullah-ibn-amr-schweigen-rettung-395.title: 📖 Whoever is silent will be saved
abdullah-ibn-amr-schweigen-rettung-395.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr** reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

***“Whoever is silent will be saved.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Many faults begin with an unconsidered word. Whoever guards his tongue and speaks only when there is benefit has a great share of safety and security for his dīn.

abdullah-ibn-masud-wissen-gottesfurcht-4.title: 📖 Knowledge is fear of Allah
abdullah-ibn-masud-wissen-gottesfurcht-4.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

***“Knowledge, for a person, does not consist in the abundance of reports. Knowledge is fear of Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **knowledge** is not shown only by how much someone relates or memorizes, but by whether that knowledge leads his heart to **taqwā**, humility and obedience to **ALLAH**.

abdurrahman-ibn-mahdi-kalam-allah-musa-0.title: 📖 Allah spoke to Mūsā
abdurrahman-ibn-mahdi-kalam-allah-musa-0.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī** said:

> ***“Whoever claims that Allah did not speak to Mūsā ibn ʿImrān is to be called to repentance.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm that Allah truly speaks, as it has come in the Qurʾān and the Sunnah. The statement refutes the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify the ***kalām of Allah*** by denial and reinterpretation.

abu-ad-darda-beginne-mit-deiner-eigenen-.title: 📖 Begin with your own soul
abu-ad-darda-beginne-mit-deiner-eigenen-.body:
🖋️ **Abū ad-Dardāʾ** رضي الله عنه said:

***“You will not possess full understanding until you detest people for the sake of Allah; then you return to your own soul and detest it even more.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**
True insight does not begin by seeing only the faults of others. The servant returns to himself and recognizes his own need, weakness and accountability before Allah.

abu-hatim-ar-razi-unser-weg-ist-festhalt.title: 📖 Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī: our way is holding to the āthār
abu-hatim-ar-razi-unser-weg-ist-festhalt.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī said, together with Abū Zurʿah: Our way and our choice is following the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his Companions and the Tābiʿīn after them, and holding to the paths of the people of the āthār.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahl as-Sunnah is not an empty name. It is attachment to the Messenger ﷺ, his Ṣaḥābah, the Tābiʿīn and the transmitted āthār.

abu-hatim-hadithkritik-ist-wissen-393.title: 📖 Hadith criticism is knowledge, not conjecture
abu-hatim-hadithkritik-ist-wissen-393.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said about examining certain reports:

***“This is a defective ḥadīth, this is bāṭil, this is munkar, and the rest of it is ṣaḥīḥ.”***

And when he was accused of claiming hidden knowledge, he said in meaning:

***“This is not a claim of hidden knowledge. We do not speak lightly, but with understanding. Just as the coin-assayer recognizes false coins and the jeweler distinguishes glass from the gem, so we were given knowledge of this.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ḥadīth criticism** is not guessing and not mere opinion. The imams recognized errors through **knowledge, experience and deep familiarity with the ʿilal**. Whoever does not know this discipline quickly confuses their precision with conjecture.

abu-hatim-jahmiyyah-mushabbihah-001.title: 📖 When the Jahmiyyah attack Ahl as-Sunnah
abu-hatim-jahmiyyah-mushabbihah-001.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“The sign of the Jahmiyyah is that they call Ahl as-Sunnah mushabbihah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever affirms the **attributes of Allah** as they have come in the Qurʾān and the Sunnah is not a mushabbih. **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm them without ***takyīf***, without ***tashbīh*** and without ***taʿṭīl*** — and that is precisely what struck the Jahmiyyah.

abu-hatim-quran-kalam-allah-001.title: 📖 The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah
abu-hatim-quran-kalam-allah-001.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī and Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah, uncreated, in all its respects.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **ʿaqīdah** of **Ahl as-Sunnah** is clear: the **Qurʾān** is the ***kalām of Allah***, uncreated. Whoever preserves this principle holds to what the early imams stood upon.

abu-hatim-ruyah-allah-im-jenseits-001.title: 📖 The believers will see their Lord
abu-hatim-ruyah-allah-im-jenseits-001.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī and Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Allah will be seen in the Hereafter; the people of Paradise will see Him with their eyes and hear His speech, as He wills and however He wills.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm the ***ruʾyah of Allah in the Hereafter*** as it was transmitted. The **Jahmiyyah** rejected such texts by denial and reinterpretation; the imams affirmed them without **takyīf**, without **tashbīh** and without **taʿṭīl**.

abu-hatim-sifat-allah-ohne-takyif-001.title: 📖 The attributes of Allah without a how
abu-hatim-sifat-allah-ohne-takyif-001.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī and Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Allah is above His Throne, separate from His creation, as He has described Himself in His Book and upon the tongue of His Messenger ﷺ — without a how.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm the **attributes of Allah** as they were transmitted: ***without takyīf, without tashbīh and without taʿṭīl***. Precisely in this lies the refutation of the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify Allah’s attributes by denial and reinterpretation.

abu-hatim-zeichen-ahl-al-bidah-001.title: 📖 The sign of the people of innovation
abu-hatim-zeichen-ahl-al-bidah-001.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“The sign of the people of innovation is disparaging the people of the athar.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation**

This statement is very strong, because it does not speak only about one group, but about a recurring pattern: whoever wants to weaken the **āthār** often begins by speaking ill of the **carriers of transmission**.

For that reason the early imams paid attention to how a person speaks about **Ahl al-Athar**, the people of hadith and the preservers of the Sunnah. A person’s stance toward the carriers of transmission often shows his stance toward the **Sunnah itself**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever treats the people of the **athar** with contempt does not only weaken persons; he opens a door against the transmitted **Sunnah**.

abu-jafar-ibn-abi-shaybah-allah-ueber-de.title: 📖 Allah is above His Throne
abu-jafar-ibn-abi-shaybah-allah-ueber-de.body:
🖋️ **Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿUthmān ibn Abī Shaybah** رحمه الله said:

***“There is agreement among the whole of creation that, when they make duʿāʾ to الله, they raise their hands toward the heaven.***

***If الله — ʿazza wa jall — were on the earth, they would not raise their hands toward the heaven while He was with them on the earth.***

***The reports have been transmitted in abundance that الله — the Exalted — created the Throne and then rose above it. Then He created the heavens and the earth, so that it now extends from the earth to the heaven and from the heaven to the Throne.***

***Thus He is above the heavens and above the Throne — in His essence — separate from His creation. Yet His knowledge encompasses them all, and nothing escapes His knowledge.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**
The ʿaqīdah of the Salaf affirms the highness of الله above His creation: above the heavens and above the Throne, separate from the creation, while His knowledge encompasses everything.

abu-ubaid-falsche-froemmigkeit-ist-ein-k.title: 📖 False piety is a garment of falsehood
abu-ubaid-falsche-froemmigkeit-ist-ein-k.body:
🖋️ **Abū ʿUbaid al-Qāsim ibn Sallām** said:

***“The one who adorns himself with more than he possesses, presents himself as greater than he is and beautifies himself with falsehood — those are the garments of lying and riyāʾ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True piety needs no stage. Whoever shows himself to people as greater than he really is before Allah may wear the garment of the pious, but not their reality.

abu-ubaid-hayaa-keine-ausrede-gutes-zu-v.title: 📖 Ḥayāʾ is no excuse for leaving good
abu-ubaid-hayaa-keine-ausrede-gutes-zu-v.body:
🖋️ **Abū ʿUbaid al-Qāsim b. Sallām** explained the hadith: **“If you feel no shame, then do what you will.”**

> ***The correct meaning is not that a person is truly permitted to do evil. Rather, it is a warning and a rebuke: whoever has no ḥayāʾ will do what he wills.***

At the same time he mentioned another sound interpretation: if someone wants to do something good and leaves it only out of fear of people or because of a whisper of riyāʾ, that false shyness should not keep him from the good.

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ḥayāʾ** keeps you from sin. But if you leave a good deed because of fear of people, that is not ḥayāʾ; it is a door through which Shayṭān wants to pull you away from obedience.

ad-darimi-ityan-allahs-bedeutung-klar-13.title: 📖 Allah’s coming is not an empty wording
ad-darimi-ityan-allahs-bedeutung-klar-13.body:
🖋️ **ʿUthmān ibn Saʿīd ad-Dārimī** said:

> ***“Concerning His coming on the Day of Resurrection and His coming in canopies of cloud together with the angels, there is no disagreement in the Ummah that He comes on that day in that way … Whoever does not believe this has not believed in the Day of Reckoning.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The early imams affirmed Allah’s **ityān** and **majīʾ** as they have come, without **takyīf**, without **tashbīh** and without **taʿṭīl**. Their speech shows that the meaning is not wholly unknown; what is forbidden is intruding into the **kayfiyyah** and twisting the texts.

ad-darimi-sifat-nuzul-001.title: 📖 Allah’s nuzūl is affirmed
ad-darimi-sifat-nuzul-001.body:
🖋️ **ʿUthmān ibn Saʿīd ad-Dārimī** mentioned the hadith of the nuzūl:

> ***“Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm the **nuzūl of Allah** as it was transmitted, ***without takyīf, without tashbīh and without taʿṭīl***. By this they contradict the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify such attributes by denial and reinterpretation.

adab-ist-nicht-mit-worten-zu-verletzen-2.title: 📖 Adab is not to harm with words
adab-ist-nicht-mit-worten-zu-verletzen-2.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab is not only good form. It means that people are safe from your tongue, your conduct and your harm.

adab-lass-was-dich-nicht-angeht-001.title: 📖 Leave what does not concern you
adab-lass-was-dich-nicht-angeht-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Part of a person’s good Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **adab** appears not only in speech, but also in **silence**, in **holding back**, and in ***not stepping into everything that does not concern one***.

adab-sprich-gutes-oder-schweige-001.title: 📖 Speak good or remain silent
adab-sprich-gutes-oder-schweige-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **adab** shows itself on the **tongue**: not every word deserves to be spoken. Whoever wants to protect his **īmān** guards his speech and chooses ***good or silence***.

ahmad-besser-als-sie-denken-001.title: 📖 Better than they think
ahmad-besser-als-sie-denken-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“I ask Allah to make us better than they think of us, and to forgive us what they do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **humility** means not taking people’s praise as security. The believer knows his hidden faults and asks Allah for ***forgiveness and sincerity***.

ahmad-grundlage-der-sunnah-001.title: 📖 The foundation of the Sunnah
ahmad-grundlage-der-sunnah-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation**

This statement sets the measure clearly: **ʿaqīdah** and **manhaj** are not built from later methods of disputation, personal preferences or philosophical terms, but from the way of the **Ṣaḥābah**.

The early imams made it plain: whoever seeks the truth looks first to the **Qurʾān**, then to the **Sunnah**, then to the understanding and the traces of the **Companions**.

Precisely in this lies safety from **deviation**, **innovation** and building the religion upon mere opinion.

🌙 **Conclusion:** The foundation of **Ahlus-Sunnah** is not a mere claim, but ***holding fast to the way of the Ṣaḥābah*** and to the transmitted **Sunnah**.

ahmad-lob-kann-herz-verderben-001.title: 📖 Praise can corrupt the heart
ahmad-lob-kann-herz-verderben-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said, when someone was told to his face, “You have revived the Sunnah”:

> ***“That is corruption for the man’s heart.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Praise** can change the heart in secret. Whoever wants to preserve **ikhlāṣ** fears not only blame, but also ***admiration and self-admiration***.

ahmad-mehr-wissen-mehr-handeln-001.title: 📖 More knowledge requires more action
ahmad-mehr-wissen-mehr-handeln-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said about someone who writes a great deal of hadith:

> ***“He should act in proportion to his increase in seeking knowledge.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Knowledge** is not honored by its amount, but by ***action***. The more a person learns, the greater his responsibility before Allah becomes.

ahmad-nicht-blind-folgen-001.title: 📖 Do not follow blindly
ahmad-nicht-blind-folgen-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Do not bind your religion, by blind following, to one of these men. What has come from the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions, take that.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ittibāʿ** means honoring the proof. The imams are loved and respected, but the religion is tied to ***Qurʾān, Sunnah and athar***.

ahmad-quran-kalam-allah-001.title: 📖 The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah
ahmad-quran-kalam-allah-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah and is not created.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the **Qurʾān** as the ***kalām of Allah***. In this lies the refutation of the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify Allah’s speech by the claim that the Qurʾān is created.

ahmad-sprich-nicht-ohne-imam-001.title: 📖 Do not speak without an exemplar
ahmad-sprich-nicht-ohne-imam-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Beware of speaking about a matter in which you have no imam before you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Fatwā** is no stage for conjecture. Whoever speaks about the dīn needs ***proof, an exemplar and fear of Allah***.

ahmad-taqwa-und-akhirah-001.title: 📖 Taqwā in the heart
ahmad-taqwa-und-akhirah-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Hold taqwā firmly in your heart and place the ākhirah before you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever keeps the **ākhirah** before his eyes becomes more watchful in the dunyā. **Taqwā** does not begin in outward appearance, but ***in the heart***.

ahmad-vorsicht-bei-ijma-behauptung-001.title: 📖 Do not claim ijmāʿ without knowledge
ahmad-vorsicht-bei-ijma-behauptung-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Whoever claims ijmāʿ in a matter is lying. Perhaps the people did differ in it.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ijmāʿ** is immense and must not be claimed lightly. The safe path is ***caution, proof, and restraint***.

ahmad-wer-hadith-zurueckweist-001.title: 📖 Whoever rejects the hadith
ahmad-wer-hadith-zurueckweist-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Whoever rejects the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stands on the brink of ruin.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Sunnah** is not a side branch of the dīn. Whoever belittles authentic transmission endangers his path — for safety lies in ***holding fast to the hadith***.

ahmad-wissen-gleicht-nichts-001.title: 📖 Nothing equals knowledge
ahmad-wissen-gleicht-nichts-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Nothing equals knowledge.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Knowledge** is not mere information. It is light, a standard, and protection — especially when it is joined to ***sincere intention*** and following.

ahmad-zeichen-des-suchenden-001.title: 📖 The sign of the seeker
ahmad-zeichen-des-suchenden-001.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“The sign of the seeker is to part from every companion who does not want what you want.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever seeks Allah pays attention to his **company**. Not every closeness helps the heart — some closeness weakens the path to the ***Ākhirah***.

ahmadiyyah-akhir-al-masajid-129.title: 📖 “My mosque is the last”
ahmadiyyah-akhir-al-masajid-129.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“I am the last of the prophets, and my mosque is the last of the mosques.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement ***“my mosque is the last of the mosques”*** does not mean, according to the imāms, that no mosque may be built after it. **Ibn Ḥibbān** explained expressly: what is meant is the ***last mosque of the prophets***, not the last mosque built in this world. Thus the hadith is a clear proof against every claim of a new prophethood after **Muḥammad ﷺ**.

ahmadiyyah-al-aqib-letzter-prophet-130.title: 📖 al-ʿĀqib – after him no prophet comes
ahmadiyyah-al-aqib-letzter-prophet-130.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“I am al-ʿĀqib; and al-ʿĀqib is the one after whom no prophet comes.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The name ***al-ʿĀqib*** is a clear prophetic explanation: after **Muḥammad ﷺ** no further prophet comes. With that, every claim of a new prophethood after him falls – whether law-giving or supposedly only “following.”

aishah-frauen-ansar-wissen-551.title: 📖 ʿĀʾishah: knowledge despite modesty
aishah-frauen-ansar-wissen-551.body:
🖋️ **ʿĀʾishah** said:

***“How excellent are the women of the Anṣār: their **modesty** did not prevent them from seeking understanding in the **dīn**.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True modesty does not lead to ignorance. It remains **pure**, but it does not prevent a person from learning ***necessary knowledge*** about the dīn.

aishah-scham-darf-nicht-vom-wissen-abhal.title: 📖 Modesty must not keep you from knowledge
aishah-scham-darf-nicht-vom-wissen-abhal.body:
🖋️ **ʿĀʾishah** رضي الله عنها said:

***“How excellent are the women of the Anṣār!***

***Their modesty did not keep them from acquiring a deep understanding of the dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
True modesty does not mean remaining silent out of ignorance. Whoever wishes to understand his dīn asks respectfully and does not let false restraint keep him from knowledge.

akhirah-macht-die-zunge-ernst-228.title: 📖 The Ākhirah makes the tongue serious
akhirah-macht-die-zunge-ernst-228.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Remembering the Ākhirah does not take hope from the heart, but it takes from it levity and false security.

akhlak-besten-mit-charakter-001.title: 📖 The best are those of the best character
akhlak-besten-mit-charakter-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Among the best of you are those of the best character.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Akhlāq** shows how strongly **īmān** shapes a person. Whoever wants to please Allah pays attention not only to outward deeds, but also to ***good character***, gentleness, and clean conduct.

akhlak-schlechter-charakter-verdirbt-tat.title: 📖 Bad character spoils deeds
akhlak-schlechter-charakter-verdirbt-tat.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Bad character spoils the deed, just as vinegar spoils honey.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Akhlāq** is not a side matter. Whoever wants to preserve his deeds must also preserve his **character** – for ***bad character*** can destroy the worth of good deeds.

akhlak-schwerste-tat-waage-001.title: 📖 Akhlāq weighs heavily
akhlak-schwerste-tat-waage-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Nothing is heavier on the Scale than good character.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Akhlāq** is not merely pleasant dealing with people. Good character is among the deeds that, on the Day of Resurrection, ***weigh heavily on the Scale***.

akhlak-vollkommener-iman-001.title: 📖 Akhlāq belongs to perfect īmān
akhlak-vollkommener-iman-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The most complete of the believers in īmān are those of the best character.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Akhlāq** is not a secondary ornament, but belongs to the completeness of **īmān**. Whoever improves his character thereby strengthens his path to Allah.

akhlaq-bedeutet-gute-zur-familie-236.title: 📖 Akhlāq means goodness toward the family
akhlaq-bedeutet-gute-zur-familie-236.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The best of you are the best to their families.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True character shows itself not only outside before people, but especially where one has authority, closeness, and daily life.

al-ajurri-groesstes-geschenk-im-paradies.title: 📖 The greatest gift in Paradise
al-ajurri-groesstes-geschenk-im-paradies.body:
🖋️ **al-Ājurrī** narrated from **Ṣuhayb** that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

> ***“When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, it will be called out to them: O people of Paradise, you have an appointment with Allah which you have not yet seen.”***

Then the veil is lifted, and they look upon Allah. The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that Allah has given them nothing more beloved to them than this, and he recited: **“For those who did good is the best – and still more.”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** The highest gift in Paradise is not only salvation from the Fire and entry into the gardens, but the **sight of Allah**. Ahlus-Sunnah affirms this truth without asking how and without distorting the clear texts.

al-awzai-sifat-allah-ueber-dem-thron-001.title: 📖 The ṣifāt of Allah are affirmed
al-awzai-sifat-allah-ueber-dem-thron-001.body:
🖋️ **al-Awzāʿī** said:

> ***“We said – while the Tābiʿīn were numerous: Allah is above His Throne, and we believe in what has come in the Sunnah concerning His ṣifāt.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the **ṣifāt of Allah** as they have come in the Qurʾān and the Sunnah. In this lies the clear refutation of the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify the attributes of Allah through ***taʿṭīl*** and reinterpretation.

al-awzai-sunnah-athar-001.title: 📖 Hold fast to the Sunnah
al-awzai-sunnah-athar-001.body:
🖋️ **al-Awzāʿī** said:

> ***“Hold yourself to the Sunnah, remain standing where the people stood, speak with that with which they spoke, and hold back from that from which they held back.”***

> ***“Follow the path of your righteous predecessors, for what sufficed them suffices you.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation**

This statement shows a mighty principle: the religion is not protected by **new methods**, **love of dispute**, or personal embellishment, but by ***holding fast to the Sunnah***, **restraint**, and **following the early imāms**.

Whoever remains standing with the **Sunnah** stands where the early generations stood. And whoever thinks that later people need something that did not suffice the first generations opens a door to **bidʿah**.

The strength of this statement lies in the fact that al-Awzāʿī does not call to special paths, but to **binding oneself to what has been transmitted**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever seeks safety in the **dīn** should not follow every new speech, but remain where the imāms of the **Ahlus-Sunnah** stood: with the **Sunnah**, the **āthār**, and the path of the early generations.

al-barbahari-bidah-athar-001.title: 📖 A small bidʿah becomes great
al-barbahari-bidah-athar-001.body:
🖋️ **al-Barbahārī** said:

> ***“Beware of small innovations; for a small bidʿah returns until it becomes great.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever wants to protect his **ʿaqīdah** must not belittle **small deviations**. For **bidʿah** often begins small, at first resembles the truth, and later becomes for many a fixed religion.

al-fudayl-ibn-iyad-folge-der-rechtleitun.title: 📖 Follow right guidance – even if few walk it
al-fudayl-ibn-iyad-folge-der-rechtleitun.body:
🖋️ **al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ** رحمه الله said:

***“Follow the paths of right guidance, and it will not harm you that few walk them. Beware of the paths of misguidance, and do not let the great number of those who perish deceive you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The truth is not measured by the number of its followers. Whoever follows the Sunnah remains steadfast, even if few walk with him; and whoever lets himself be deceived by the multitude can stray from the path of right guidance.

al-fudayl-zuhd-qanaah-001.title: 📖 Zuhd is contentment
al-fudayl-zuhd-qanaah-001.body:
🖋️ **al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ** was asked: “What is zuhd in the dunyā?” He said:

> ***“Contentment – and it is true wealth.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **zuhd** does not mean that a person possesses only little. True **wealth** lies in the heart being ***content*** and not constantly reaching for the **dunyā**.

al-hasan-al-basri-gute-taten-und-furcht-.title: 📖 Joining good deeds with fear
al-hasan-al-basri-gute-taten-und-furcht-.body:
🖋️ **al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** رحمه الله said:

***“The believer joins good deeds and fear; and the hypocrite joins evil deeds and a feeling of safety.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The believer does not rely on his deeds, but remains, despite obedience, full of fear of Allāh. Feeling safe amid sins is, by contrast, a dangerous sign.

al-lalakai-sifat-durch-offenbarung-001.title: 📖 The Ṣifāt are taken through revelation
al-lalakai-sifat-durch-offenbarung-001.body:
🖋️ **al-Lālakāʾī** said in the chapter on Tawḥīd, the Names and the Ṣifāt:

> ***“The obligation to know Allah and His Ṣifāt comes through transmission, not through mere intellect.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Ṣifāt of Allah** are not built from kalām, speculation, or philosophical interpretation. The **Ahlus-Sunnah** take them from ***Qurʾān, Sunnah and Athar*** — and that is precisely what contradicts the path of the **Jahmiyyah**.

al-qurtubi-istiwa-bedeutung-bekannt-133.title: 📖 Istiwaʾ: the meaning is known, the Kayfiyyah is unknown
al-qurtubi-istiwa-bedeutung-bekannt-133.body:
🖋️ **al-Qurṭubī** said:

> ***“The Salaf did not deny direction, and they did not speak of it by way of negation. Rather, they affirmed this for Allah, as His Book affirmed it and His messengers reported it. None of the Salaf denied that He truly rose over His Throne.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement shows the path of the **Ahlus-Sunnah**: **Istiwaʾ** is known in its meaning, while the **Kayfiyyah** remains unknown. That is affirmation without **Takyīf**, without **Tashbīh** and without **Taʿṭīl**.

ali-ibn-abi-talib-kinder-der-akhirah-437.title: 📖 Be among the children of the Ākhirah
ali-ibn-abi-talib-kinder-der-akhirah-437.body:
🖋️ **ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib** رضي الله عنه said:

***“The Dunyā has departed and turned away, and the Ākhirah has come forward and drawn near. Each of the two has children. So be among the children of the Ākhirah and do not be among the children of the Dunyā. For today there are deeds and no reckoning; and tomorrow there is reckoning and no deeds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The Dunyā calls to distraction, the Ākhirah calls to preparation. Whoever is wise uses the day of action before the day of reckoning comes.

allahs-hand-und-die-groesse-der-schoepfu.title: 📖 Allah’s Hand and the greatness of creation in His Hand
allahs-hand-und-die-groesse-der-schoepfu.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās and Abū ʿĪsā at-Tirmidhī** said:

> ***“The seven heavens and the seven earths are in Allah’s Hand only like a mustard seed in the hand of one of you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah affirms the Yad of Allah as it has come in the Qurʾān and in the Āthār, without equating and without reinterpretation as mere power.

allahs-rechte-hand-widerlegung-gegen-taw.title: 📖 Allah’s right Hand: refutation against Taʾwīl
allahs-rechte-hand-widerlegung-gegen-taw.body:
🖋️ **Abū Hurairah and Abū ʿĪsā at-Tirmidhī** said:

> ***“When the servant gives in charity from what is good, Allah accepts it, takes it with His right Hand and causes it to grow.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The texts affirm the right Hand, the Hand and the palm. Ahlus-Sunnah affirms this without Takyīf, without Tamthīl, without Taḥrīf and without Taʿṭīl.

allahs-stimme-nicht-wie-die-stimmen-der-.title: 📖 Allah’s Voice: not like the voices of creation
allahs-stimme-nicht-wie-die-stimmen-der-.body:
🖋️ **al-Bukhārī, Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal and Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“The Voice of Allah does not resemble the voices of creation.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Allah speaks with a Voice, as it has been transmitted, without equating and without the question of how; denying this text belongs to the path of the Jahmiyyah.

amali-sind-nur-nach-niyyah-199.title: 📖 Deeds are only according to intention
amali-sind-nur-nach-niyyah-199.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Deeds are only according to intentions (Niyyah), and each person receives only what he intended. Whoever emigrates to Allah and His Messenger, his emigration is to Allah and His Messenger. But whoever emigrates in order to obtain something worldly or to marry a woman, his emigration is to that for which he emigrated.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The worth of a deed lies not only in its outward form, but in the **Niyyah** (intention) of the heart. Whoever seeks **Ikhlas** (sincerity) for **Allah** should direct every deed to Him from the outset — for one acts according to that, and for that one is rewarded.

amanah-und-iman-gehoeren-zusammen-458.title: 📖 Amānah and Īmān belong together
amanah-und-iman-gehoeren-zusammen-458.body:
🖋️ **ʿUrwah ibn az-Zubayr** رحمه الله said:

**“In no person does his Amānah decrease without something of his Īmān thereby decreasing as well.”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** Amānah is not only good character, but is closely bound to Īmān. Whoever protects his trustworthiness thereby also protects something of his Dīn.

ant-colony-justice-20261013-474.title: 📖 Even an ant glorifies Allah
ant-colony-justice-20261013-474.body:
🖋️ **Abū Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:**

> "An ant bit one of the earlier prophets. Thereupon he had an entire ant colony burned. Then Allah revealed to him: 'Only because an ant bit you, have you destroyed an entire people that glorifies Allah?'"

🌙 **Conclusion:** Justice applies even toward the smallest creatures. The deed of one person does not justify punishing other innocent ones along with him.

aqidah-069-dieses-wissen-ist-din.title: 📖 This knowledge is Dīn
aqidah-069-dieses-wissen-ist-din.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“This knowledge is Dīn, so look from whom you take your Dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever wants to protect his Dīn does not take knowledge from every speaker, but examines the **source**, the **Manhaj** and the **attribution**.

aqidah-070-der-quran-ist-nicht-erschaffe.title: 📖 The Qurʾān is not created
aqidah-070-der-quran-ist-nicht-erschaffe.body:
🖋️ **ʿAmr ibn Dīnār** said:

> ***“I met nine of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: Whoever says that the Qurʾān is created is a Kāfir.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement shows how immense the question of the **Kalām of Allah** was among the early Imāms.

aqidah-071-ahmad-ibn-hanbal-ueber-den-er.title: 📖 Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal on the created Qurʾān
aqidah-071-ahmad-ibn-hanbal-ueber-den-er.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Whoever says that the Qurʾān is created is, with us, a Kāfir; for the Qurʾān belongs to the Knowledge of Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah does not separate reverence for Allah from reverence for His revealed Word.

aqidah-072-iman-ist-wort-und-tat.title: 📖 Īmān is word and deed
aqidah-072-iman-ist-wort-und-tat.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** said:

> ***“The scholars of Fiqh and Ḥadīth are agreed that Īmān is word and deed.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Īmān is not only a claim; it comprises the **heart**, the **tongue** and **deeds**.

aqidah-073-der-iman-nimmt-zu-und-ab.title: 📖 Īmān increases and decreases
aqidah-073-der-iman-nimmt-zu-und-ab.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** said:

> ***“Īmān increases through obedience and decreases through disobedience.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever knows this foundation pays attention to his deeds, because they affect the state of the heart.

aqidah-074-die-sifat-ohne-wie-frage.title: 📖 The Ṣifāt without the question of how
aqidah-074-die-sifat-ohne-wie-frage.body:
🖋️ **Umm Salamah and Imām Mālik** said:

> ***“al-Istiwāʾ is known, the how is unknown.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah affirms the Ṣifāt, without distorting them, denying them, comparing them, or asking about the how.

aqidah-075-paradies-und-hoelle-sind-ersc.title: 📖 Paradise and Hell are created
aqidah-075-paradies-und-hoelle-sind-ersc.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Abī al-ʿIzz** said:

> ***“Ahlus-Sunnah is agreed that Paradise and Hell are created and exist now.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ākhirah is not a mere idea, but a real homecoming toward which the servant is heading.

aqidah-076-die-glaeubigen-sehen-ihren-he.title: 📖 The believers will see their Lord
aqidah-076-die-glaeubigen-sehen-ihren-he.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“You will see your Lord as you see the moon on the night of the full moon; you will suffer no harm and no distress in seeing Him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ruʾyah is a confirmed truth of revelation and belongs to the greatest blessings for the believers.

aqidah-077-dua-ist-anbetung.title: 📖 Duʿāʾ is worship
aqidah-077-dua-ist-anbetung.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Duʿāʾ is the worship.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever directs Duʿāʾ to other than Allah gives a creature something that belongs to the core of worship.

aqidah-078-der-massstab-bei-ahl-al-ahwa.title: 📖 The standard concerning Ahl al-Ahwāʾ
aqidah-078-der-massstab-bei-ahl-al-ahwa.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“This knowledge is Dīn; so look from whom you take your Dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Especially with Ahl al-Ahwāʾ, fine speech is not enough; what decides is whether someone stands upon the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and the Āthār.

aqidah-allah-wird-im-jenseits-gesehen-24.title: 📖 ʿAqīdah: Allah will be seen in the Hereafter
aqidah-allah-wird-im-jenseits-gesehen-24.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in meaning: You will see your Lord as you see this moon; you will not be pressed together in the seeing.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah affirms what the clear text affirms: The believers see Allah in the Hereafter, without asking about the how.

aqidah-die-waage-am-juengsten-tag-ist-wa.title: 📖 ʿAqīdah: The Scale on the Day of Judgment is true
aqidah-die-waage-am-juengsten-tag-ist-wa.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qudāmah** said:

> ***“Ibn Qudāmah mentioned that among what is believed in is the Scale on the Day of Resurrection.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ākhirah is not a mere reminder, but certain. Deeds are weighed; therefore the heart should be awake today.

aqidah-iman-ist-wort-und-tat-250.title: 📖 ʿAqīdah: Īmān is word and deed
aqidah-iman-ist-wort-und-tat-250.body:
🖋️ **al-Bukhārī** said:

> ***“al-Bukhārī opened the chapter of īmān with the meaning that īmān comprises word and deed.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** With Ahlus-Sunnah, īmān is not only an inner claim. It shows itself in belief, word and action.

asad-musa-nuzul-zur-abrechnung-425.title: 📖 Allah’s descent on the Day of Reckoning
asad-musa-nuzul-zur-abrechnung-425.body:
🖋️ **Imām Asad ibn Mūsā** heads a chapter in *Kitāb az-Zuhd* with:

> ***"The **nuzūl of Allah** – tabāraka wa-taʿālā – in shade-canopies of clouds for the **reckoning**."***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the texts about the **nuzūl** and the **ityān of Allah**, as they were transmitted, ***without taḥrīf, without taʿṭīl and without takyīf***. They leave the **how** to Allah.

ash-shafii-ijma-nicht-leichtfertig-behau.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ is not claimed lightly
ash-shafii-ijma-nicht-leichtfertig-behau.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** رحمه الله said, when he was asked whether there is ijmāʿ:

***"Yes, much praise be to Allāh: in the general obligations concerning which ignorance is not permitted. That is the ijmāʿ in which, when you say: 'The people are agreed,' you find no one around you who possesses knowledge and says: 'That is not ijmāʿ.' That is the way on which the claim of an ijmāʿ is truthful – in such matters and in some foundations of knowledge, not in its branches."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Ijmāʿ is not a word that one uses lightly. Whoever claims ijmāʿ must be sure that no known contradiction exists

at-tabari-muhakamah-wir-hoeren-und-gehor.title: 📖 We hear and we obey
at-tabari-muhakamah-wir-hoeren-und-gehor.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī** said:

> ***“The statement of the believers, when they are called to the judgment of Allah and to the judgment of His Messenger ﷺ so that he may judge between them, is: We hear what was said to us, and we obey.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True muḥākamah shows itself not only in that one knows Allah’s judgment, but in that the heart **accepts** it, the tongue says: **We hear**, and the deed confirms: **We obey**.

ata-fudul-al-kalam-zungen-disziplin-taqw.title: 📖 Fuḍūl al-Kalām: Discipline of the tongue is taqwā
ata-fudul-al-kalam-zungen-disziplin-taqw.body:
🖋️ **ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ** said:

> ***“My nephew! Those before you used to detest superfluous speech – except reading Allāh’s Book, enjoining the good, forbidding the evil, or uttering what you truly need in your livelihood.”***

Then he reminded of the noble scribes and of the fact that no word is spoken without a watcher being ready.

> ***He asked in meaning: Is none of you ashamed if the scroll of his day were opened and most of what is in it concerned neither dīn nor dunyā?***

🌙 **Conclusion:** It is not only great sins that ruin. Often it is continual, superfluous speech that fills the scroll. Whoever wants barakah shortens **fuḍūl al-kalām** radically.

athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-ahwa-nicht-zuho.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Do not listen to Ahl al-Ahwāʾ
athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-ahwa-nicht-zuho.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“Ibn Sīrīn refused that people of desires recite an āyah to him, and said in meaning: Either you stand up or I stand up.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The athar refutes the naivety that one could expose the heart to every confusion. Protection of the dīn begins with protection of the ears.

athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-bidah-erkennt-m.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Ahl al-Bidʿah are recognized by their attack on Ahl al-Athar
athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-bidah-erkennt-m.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī said: ‘The sign of Ahl al-Bidʿah is the belittling of the people of the athar.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever insults the bearers of transmission does not attack only persons, but the way by which the Sunnah and the āthār were preserved.

athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-kalam-verwerfen.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Ahl al-Kalām reject the āthār
athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-kalam-verwerfen.body:
🖋️ **Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī said: ‘The sign of the Jahmiyyah is that they call Ahl al-Sunnah Mushabbihah.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The classical refutation is clear: Whoever twists the affirmed ṣifāt often insults those who follow the texts.

athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-ray-greifen-ahl.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Ahl al-Raʾy attack Ahl al-Ḥadīth
athar-widerlegung-ahl-al-ray-greifen-ahl.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī said in meaning: The sign of Ahl al-Raʾy is slandering Ahl al-Ḥadīth.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The early warning shows: When opinion is placed above transmission, the attack on Ahl al-Ḥadīth often becomes the method.

athar-widerlegung-bidah-ist-nicht-kleinz.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Bidʿah is not to be minimized
athar-widerlegung-bidah-ist-nicht-kleinz.body:
🖋️ **al-Barbahārī** said:

> ***“al-Barbahārī said in meaning: Beware of small innovations, for small innovations grow until they become great.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the downplaying of bidʿah. What begins small can draw the heart, step by step, away from the Sunnah.

athar-widerlegung-der-hadith-wird-nicht-.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The hadith is not abandoned because of opinion
athar-widerlegung-der-hadith-wird-nicht-.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī said in meaning: If the hadith is authentic, then that is my madhhab.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The athar refutes blind fanaticism. No madhhab stands above the authentic proof.

athar-widerlegung-der-quran-ist-nicht-er.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Qurʾān is not created
athar-widerlegung-der-quran-ist-nicht-er.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said: ‘The Qurʾān is Allah’s speech and is not created.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the Jahmiyyah and all who make Allah’s speech into a creation. The speech of Allah is His attribute.

athar-widerlegung-der-weg-ist-athar-nich.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The way is athar, not speculation
athar-widerlegung-der-weg-ist-athar-nich.body:
🖋️ **Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim said: Our way and our choice is following the Messenger ﷺ, his Companions and the Tābiʿīn, and holding fast to the ways of the people of the athar.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes speculative dīn. The safe way is transmission, the understanding of the Ṣaḥābah, and attachment to the early imāms.

athar-widerlegung-die-khawarij-verliesse.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Khawārij departed through misunderstanding
athar-widerlegung-die-khawarij-verliesse.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās** said:

> ***“Ibn ʿAbbās debated with the Khawārij, refuted their objections from the Qurʾān and the Sunnah, and many returned.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This athar refutes the way of the Khawārij: texts without the understanding of the Ṣaḥābah lead to harshness, division and false takfīr.

athar-widerlegung-die-sunnah-ist-arche-n.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Sunnah is the ark of Nūḥ
athar-widerlegung-die-sunnah-ist-arche-n.body:
🖋️ **Mālik ibn Anas** said:

> ***“Imām Mālik said in meaning: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ; whoever boards it is saved, and whoever stays behind goes under.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the thought that salvation could be sought without the Sunnah and without the way of the early imāms.

athar-widerlegung-dieses-wissen-ist-din-.title: 📖 Athar refutation: This knowledge is dīn
athar-widerlegung-dieses-wissen-ist-din-.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“Ibn Sīrīn said: ‘This knowledge is dīn, so look from whom you take your dīn.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This athar refutes blindly taking from every speaker. Dīn is examined, weighed and taken by trustworthy ways.

athar-widerlegung-isnad-ist-die-waffe-de.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The isnād is the weapon of the believer
athar-widerlegung-isnad-ist-die-waffe-de.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Sufyān ath-Thawrī said: ‘The isnād is the weapon of the believer. If he has no weapon, with what then does he fight?’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The athar refutes unproven religious claims. Without isnād, much remains only a voice without weight.

athar-widerlegung-istiwa-wird-bestaetigt.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Istiwaʾ is affirmed without how
athar-widerlegung-istiwa-wird-bestaetigt.body:
🖋️ **Imām Mālik ibn Anas** said:

> ***“Imām Mālik said in meaning: The istiwaʾ is known, the how is unknown, believing in it is obligatory, and asking about it is bidʿah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This rule refutes two extremes: taʿṭīl (denial of the attribute) and takyīf (determining the how).

athar-widerlegung-kein-reden-vor-den-sah.title: 📖 Athar refutation: No speaking before the Ṣaḥābah
athar-widerlegung-kein-reden-vor-den-sah.body:
🖋️ **al-Awzāʿī** said:

> ***“al-Awzāʿī said, in meaning: Hold fast to the āthār of the Salaf, even if the people reject you; and beware of the opinions of the people, even if they dress them up in fine words.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This athar refutes modern self-assurance against the way of the early imams. Truth is not replaced by the spirit of the age.

athar-widerlegung-mit-ahl-al-bidah-nicht.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Do not sit with Ahl al-Bidʿah
athar-widerlegung-mit-ahl-al-bidah-nicht.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah gathered the warnings of the early imams against sitting with Ahl al-Bidʿah and against looking into their books.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This athar path refutes the false security that one could consume every misguidance without the heart being affected.

athar-widerlegung-murjiah-trennen-handlu.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Murjiʾah separate action from īmān
athar-widerlegung-murjiah-trennen-handlu.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Sufyān ath-Thawrī and the imams of Ahl al-Sunnah explained īmān as word and deed; it rises and falls.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** By this, irjāʾ is refuted: īmān is not merely a statement or an inner claim, but comprises belief, word, and action.

athar-widerlegung-nicht-jede-gute-absich.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Not every good intention meets the Sunnah
athar-widerlegung-nicht-jede-gute-absich.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd said to people who wanted good, but introduced a new form of dhikr: ‘How many want good, yet do not attain it.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the claim that every religious innovation is good so long as the intention is good. The scale remains the Sunnah, not feeling.

athar-widerlegung-qadar-wird-nicht-mit-m.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Qadar is not contested by opinion
athar-widerlegung-qadar-wird-nicht-mit-m.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿUmar** said:

> ***“Ibn ʿUmar dissociated himself from those who denied the Qadar, and said, in meaning: If one of them were to donate gold like Uḥud, Allah would not accept it until he believes in the Qadar.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The athar refutes the Qadariyyah: belief in the Qadar is not a marginal topic, but belongs to the foundation of īmān.

athar-widerlegung-wer-den-hadith-zurueck.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Whoever rejects the hadith
athar-widerlegung-wer-den-hadith-zurueck.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said: ‘Whoever rejects the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stands on the brink of ruin.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes every method that discards the clear Sunnah because of inclination, politics, group, or kalām.

athar-widerlegung-wissen-ist-nicht-von-a.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Knowledge is not to be taken from Ahl al-Ahwāʾ
athar-widerlegung-wissen-ist-nicht-von-a.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“Ibn Sīrīn said: ‘Formerly one did not ask about the isnād. When the fitnah occurred, they said: Name us your men.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This athar refutes blind trust in every speaker. After fitnah one asks more precisely: Who narrates, and by which path?

aya-bringt-nur-gutes-191.title: 📖 Ḥayāʾ brings only good
aya-bringt-nur-gutes-191.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Ḥayāʾ brings only good.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Shame before Allah and before what is ugly preserves dignity, boundaries, and the purity of the heart.

aya-gehoert-zum-iman-178.title: 📖 Ḥayāʾ belongs to īmān
aya-gehoert-zum-iman-178.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Ḥayāʾ is a branch of īmān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True shame holds one back from what is ugly and makes the heart more alert. Whoever loses ḥayāʾ loses a protective wall of faith.

az-zajjaj-tawhid-ikhlas-kahf-18-28-20261.title: 📖 Tawḥīd and ikhlāṣ – the foundation of ʿibādah
az-zajjaj-tawhid-ikhlas-kahf-18-28-20261.body:
🖋️ **Imām Abū Isḥāq az-Zaǧǧāǧ** (d. 311 AH) explained the words of Allah about those who call upon their Lord morning and evening:

“They call upon Him with **tawḥīd** and **sincerity** toward Him and worship Him.”

🌙 **Conclusion:** Sincere ʿibādah rests upon **tawḥīd and ikhlāṣ** – worship is performed for Allah alone.

az-zuhri-festhalten-an-der-sunnah-rettun.title: 📖 Holding fast to the Sunnah is salvation
az-zuhri-festhalten-an-der-sunnah-rettun.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Shihāb az-Zuhrī** رحمه الله said:

***“The scholars before us used to say: Holding fast to the Sunnah is salvation. Knowledge is taken away swiftly; through the revival of knowledge, religion and the dunyā remain, and with the loss of knowledge all of that is lost.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Salvation lies in holding fast to the Sunnah and in preserving knowledge. When knowledge disappears, religion and the dunyā perish.

bei-bedraengnis-zur-salah-001.title: 📖 In distress, to the ṣalāh
bei-bedraengnis-zur-salah-001.body:
🖋️ **Ḥudhayfah ibn al-Yamān** reported:

> ***“When a matter distressed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he prayed.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever has **Tawakkul** does not flee, in distress, first to panic, but to the ***Ṣalāh*** and to nearness to Allah.

bishr-al-hafi-wissen-handeln-465.title: 📖 Knowledge is not for enjoyment
bishr-al-hafi-wissen-handeln-465.body:
🖋️ **Bishr ibn al-Ḥārith al-Ḥāfī** رحمه الله said:

**“You are only someone seeking enjoyment: you listen and dictate. From knowledge, only action is wanted. Listen, learn, act, teach, and flee. Do you not see how Sufyān ath-Thawrī sought knowledge, then knew, acted, taught, and fled?”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** Knowledge is not a collection for prestige, debates, or mere enjoyment. Its weight appears only when ikhlāṣ, action, daʿwah, and distance from the dunyā arise from it.

bukhari-sahih-ehrfurcht-411.title: 📖 "How al-Bukhārī treated his Ṣaḥīḥ
bukhari-sahih-ehrfurcht-411.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl al-Bukhārī** said:

***“I did not place a hadith in my book *aṣ-Ṣaḥīḥ* except that I had washed myself beforehand and prayed two rakʿah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Hadith, with the imams, was not a mere collecting of texts.** Al-Bukhārī treated what he attributed to the Prophet ﷺ with **reverence, examination, and consciousness of Allah**. Whoever loves the Sunnah does not handle it lightly.

das-gewaltige-recht-des-nachbarn-454.title: 📖 The tremendous right of the neighbor
das-gewaltige-recht-des-nachbarn-454.body:
🖋️ **ʿĀʾishah رضي الله عنها reported:**

**The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:**

***“Ǧibrīl did not cease to earnestly enjoin the neighbor upon me until I thought that he would make him an heir.”***

The repeated counsel of Ǧibrīl عليه السلام shows the **tremendous standing of the right of neighborliness**. The neighbor has a right to good treatment, consideration, help, and protection from harm both bodily and verbal.

The statement does not mean that the neighbor was actually declared an heir. Rather, the Prophet ﷺ thought, because of the emphatic and continued counsel, that a share of the inheritance might even be granted to him.

🌙 **Conclusion:** The neighbor’s right is not limited to merely not disturbing him. The Sunnah includes **beneficence, consideration, support, and the protection of his rights**. The closer the neighbor lives, the more immediate his relationship is, and the greater the responsibility not to wrong him.

das-lachen-allahs-bestaetigung-ohne-glei.title: 📖 The laughter of Allah: affirmation without equating
das-lachen-allahs-bestaetigung-ohne-glei.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Allah laughs, and one does not know how that is, except through the affirmation of the Messenger ﷺ and the firm establishment of the Qurʾān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah affirms the laughter of Allah as it was transmitted, without Takyīf, without Tamthīl, without Taḥrīf, and without Taʿṭīl.

der-beste-ist-der-beste-zu-seiner-famili.title: 📖 The best is the best to his family
der-beste-ist-der-beste-zu-seiner-famili.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The family is the first school of character. Whoever is harsh at home has not understood Akhlāq.

der-beste-unterricht-ist-quran-lernen-un.title: 📖 The best teaching is learning the Qurʾān and teaching it
der-beste-unterricht-ist-quran-lernen-un.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“The best of you are those who learn the Qurʾān and teach it.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah without the Qurʾān loses its center. The best teaching binds hearts to Allah’s Book.

der-mensch-wird-mit-dem-sein-den-er-lieb.title: 📖 A person will be with the one he loves
der-mensch-wird-mit-dem-sein-den-er-lieb.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘A person is with the one he loves.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Love is not neutral. The path, the state, and the end of the one you love become important for your heart.

der-muslim-verletzt-nicht-mit-zunge-und-.title: 📖 The Muslim does not harm with tongue and hand
der-muslim-verletzt-nicht-mit-zunge-und-.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Akhlaq is measured by whether people are safe from your tongue and your actions.

der-nachbar-muss-vor-deinem-schaden-sich.title: 📖 The neighbor must be safe from your harm
der-nachbar-muss-vor-deinem-schaden-sich.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“By Allah, he does not believe: the one whose neighbor is not safe from his harm.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Faith also shows itself at the door next door. Whoever harms the people near him weakens his claim to a good dīn.

der-prophet-vor-der-offenbarung-war-kein.title: 📖 The Prophet ﷺ before the revelation was not a mushrik
der-prophet-vor-der-offenbarung-war-kein.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ and al-Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ** said:

> ***“By Allah, I do not worship al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā. By Allah, I never worship them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Before the revelation the Prophet ﷺ did not know the details of the Sharīʿah, but Allah preserved him from shirk and guided him to tawḥīd.

der-stift-widerlegt-den-nur-muhammadi-ha.title: 📖 The Pen refutes the Nūr-Muḥammadī hadith
der-stift-widerlegt-den-nur-muhammadi-ha.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ and aṭ-Ṭabarī** said:

> ***“The first thing Allah created was the Pen; He said to it: Write.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Prophet ﷺ is the light of guidance, the best of people and a servant of Allah; the claim that he was created from Allah’s light is not carried by authentic passages in the books.

der-verlust-des-glaubens-wegen-suenden-1.title: 📖 The loss of faith because of sins
der-verlust-des-glaubens-wegen-suenden-1.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ and Ibn Ḥajar** said:

> ***“The adulterer commits zinā while, in this moment, he is not a believer.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** These texts of threat mean a lessening or the falling away of complete īmān during the sin; they are not proof for the Khawārij takfīr of every sinner.

der-vollstaendigere-iman-zeigt-sich-im-c.title: 📖 The more complete īmān shows itself in character
der-vollstaendigere-iman-zeigt-sich-im-c.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“The most complete of the believers in īmān are those with the best character.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Īmān is not only a claim in the heart, but shows itself in conduct. Whoever improves his character works on the completeness of his faith.

die-akhirah-lasst-weltliche-harte-klein-.title: 📖 The ākhirah makes worldly hardship small
die-akhirah-lasst-weltliche-harte-klein-.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The person of the dunyā most severely tried among the people of Jannah will be dipped once into Jannah and will then say that he never saw misery.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** No pain of the dunyā remains before the mercy of Jannah. Whoever is patient for Allah loses nothing.

die-eltern-im-alter-eine-geoeffnete-tuer.title: 📖 Parents in old age – an open door to Paradise
die-eltern-im-alter-eine-geoeffnete-tuer.body:
🖋️ **Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:**

**The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:**

***“May he be humiliated! Then may he be humiliated! Then may he be humiliated!”***

It was asked:

***“Who, O Messenger of Allah?”***

He ﷺ said:

***“The one who lives to see one or both of his parents in advanced old age and still does not enter Paradise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The advanced old age of the parents is a tremendous opportunity to attain Paradise through kindness, patience, provision and personal care. Whoever lives through this time and still neglects the rights of his parents leaves a particularly great door to good unused.

die-mutter-hat-das-groesste-recht-auf-gu.title: 📖 The mother has the greatest right to good companionship
die-mutter-hat-das-groesste-recht-auf-gu.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab toward parents is not general politeness. The mother has a particularly great standing.

die-nachsten-zum-propheten-am-jungsten-t.title: 📖 Those nearest to the Prophet ﷺ on the Last Day
die-nachsten-zum-propheten-am-jungsten-t.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Among the most beloved of you to me and those seated nearest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those with the most beautiful character.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Nearness to the Prophet ﷺ is not sought only by claim, but through the Sunnah, humility and beautiful character.

die-schonste-erziehung-war-der-quran-223.title: 📖 The most beautiful upbringing was the Qurʾān
die-schonste-erziehung-war-der-quran-223.body:
🖋️ **ʿĀʾishah رضي الله عنها** said:

> ***“ʿĀʾishah رضي الله عنها said about the character of the Prophet ﷺ: ‘His character was the Qurʾān.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The highest adab is not mere politeness, but that the Qurʾān shapes the words, the reactions and the conduct.

diese-welt-ist-nicht-der-ruheort-des-gla.title: 📖 This world is not the resting place of the believer
diese-welt-ist-nicht-der-ruheort-des-gla.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The dunyā is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the kāfir.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The believer does not expect final fulfillment from the dunyā. His comfort lies in this: the true spaciousness is with Allah.

dua-bei-schwierigkeit-001.title: 📖 Only Allah makes the hard easy
dua-bei-schwierigkeit-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** used to say:

> ***“O Allah, there is nothing easy except what You have made easy; and You make the hard easy when You will.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever has **tawakkul** knows: difficulties are not made easy by the human being alone, but through ***Allah’s facilitation***.

dua-dhi-nun-001.title: 📖 The duʿāʾ of Dhū’n-Nūn
dua-dhi-nun-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The duʿāʾ of Dhū’n-Nūn in the belly of the fish was: Lā ilāha illā Anta, Subḥānaka, innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** In the tightest distress, the way of the believer is **tawḥīd**, **repentance** and ***return to Allah***.

dua-ist-ibadah-001.title: 📖 Duʿāʾ is ʿibādah
dua-ist-ibadah-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Duʿāʾ is the ʿibādah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Duʿāʾ** is not merely asking, but ***worship***. Whoever binds his heart to Allah in supplication realizes a tremendous part of **tawḥīd**.

dunya-liebe-beschadigt-die-akhirah-238.title: 📖 Love of the dunyā harms the ākhirah
dunya-liebe-beschadigt-die-akhirah-238.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in meaning: Whoever loves his dunyā harms his ākhirah, and whoever loves his ākhirah harms his dunyā; so prefer what remains over what passes away.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The dunyā and the ākhirah compete in the heart. Whoever seeks what remains places what passes beneath it.

eid-zaehlt-quran-rezitation-als-sprechen.title: 📖 Oath: Does reciting the Qurʾān count as speaking?
eid-zaehlt-quran-rezitation-als-sprechen.body:
🖋️ **Abū ʿUbayd al-Qāsim ibn Sallām** said:

> ***“If a man swears not to speak today and then recites the Qurʾān, he does not break the oath.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** People’s oaths refer to human speech in dealings. The Qurʾān is the kalām of Allah; only when the intention includes the Qurʾān does his niyyah bind him.

ein-einziger-tauchgang-zeigt-die-wahrhei.title: 📖 A single dip shows the truth of the dunyā
ein-einziger-tauchgang-zeigt-die-wahrhei.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ reported that the most comfortable person of the dunyā among the people of the Fire will be dipped once into the Fire and will then say that he never saw any good.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The dunyā can seem long, yet before the ākhirah its enjoyment disappears. The intelligent person does not sell the eternal for what is brief.

ein-gutes-wort-ist-sadaqah-445.title: 📖 A good word is sadaqah
ein-gutes-wort-ist-sadaqah-445.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ said:**

***“A good word is a sadaqah.”***

This ḥadīth shows that the believer can attain a great reward even with his **tongue**, even if he owns no wealth.

A **sincere word**, an encouragement, a kind greeting, a reconciliation or a beneficial reminder of **Allah** can count with **Allah** as sadaqah.

**Not only money is sadaqah.**

**A good word can also be sadaqah.**

Sometimes a good word lifts a broken heart again, ends a dispute or gives a person new hope. A small statement can be easy for the speaker, yet with **Allah** it weighs **heavy on the scale**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Never underestimate a **good word**. Whoever uses his tongue for **truth, goodness and benefit** performs a sadaqah without having to spend wealth for it.

ein-laecheln-kann-adaqah-sein-187.title: 📖 A smile can be ṣadaqah
ein-laecheln-kann-adaqah-sein-187.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Your smile in the face of your brother is ṣadaqah for you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Akhlāq sometimes begins with a face that does not hurt the brother.

entferne-schaden-vom-weg-196.title: 📖 Remove harm from the path
entferne-schaden-vom-weg-196.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Removing harm from the path is a branch of īmān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab also shows itself where no one praises you. Whoever removes harm protects people and seeks Allah’s reward.

erlaubnis-wird-dreimal-erbeten-192.title: 📖 Permission is sought three times
erlaubnis-wird-dreimal-erbeten-192.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Permission is sought three times; if you are permitted, then enter, otherwise return.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab protects privacy. Whoever observes the limits when entering preserves modesty, safety and respect.

fiqh-der-beste-mann-ist-gut-zu-seiner-fa.title: 📖 Fiqh: The best man is good to his family
fiqh-der-beste-mann-ist-gut-zu-seiner-fa.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The best of you are the best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Manhood in Islam is not shown in harshness toward the weak, but in responsibility, mercy and just treatment.

fiqh-der-richter-ist-weg-zur-ruckholung-.title: 📖 Fiqh: The judge is the way to recover the right
fiqh-der-richter-ist-weg-zur-ruckholung-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qudāmah** explained:

> ***“Ibn Qudāmah said: If he can recover his right through the judge or the sultan, he may not take it by another way.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Fiqh is ordered. Rights are not sought according to anger and chaos, but through permitted ways when these are possible.

fiqh-die-frau-wird-nicht-gegen-ihren-wil.title: 📖 Fiqh: The woman is not married against her will
fiqh-die-frau-wird-nicht-gegen-ihren-wil.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in substance: A woman who has already been married is not given in marriage until she is asked, and a virgin is not until her permission is sought.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Sunnah protects the dignity of the woman in the nikāḥ. Marriage is not an act of coercion, but a contract with a legal order.

fiqh-dunya-und-offenbarung-001.title: 📖 Dunyā knowledge and revelation
fiqh-dunya-und-offenbarung-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“You know better about your dunyā affairs.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Fiqh** means correctly distinguishing between ***religious revelation*** and worldly experience. What comes from the Prophet ﷺ as **dīn** is followed; what concerns pure **dunyā experience** is judged according to benefit, knowledge and experience.

fiqh-frauen-haben-rechte-wie-pflichten-2.title: 📖 Fiqh: Women have rights just as they have duties
fiqh-frauen-haben-rechte-wie-pflichten-2.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained regarding Allah’s statement that women have rights just as they have duties according to what is approved: They have rights toward the men, just as the men have rights toward them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Just fiqh knows neither oppression nor equalization without proof. Rights and duties are ordered by Allah’s law.

fiqh-frauen-sind-die-schwestern-der-maen.title: 📖 Fiqh: Women are the sisters of men
fiqh-frauen-sind-die-schwestern-der-maen.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Women are only the sisters of men.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Sharīʿah distinguishes where Allah distinguishes, and joins where the proof joins. Fiqh is proof, not mood.

fiqh-halal-haram-schubuhat-001.title: 📖 Between ḥalāl and ḥarām
fiqh-halal-haram-schubuhat-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The ḥalāl is clear and the ḥarām is clear. Between them there are doubtful matters that many people do not know. Whoever guards himself against the doubtful things has preserved his religion and his honor.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **fiqh** shows itself not only in avoiding the forbidden, but also in being careful with **doubtful matters**. Whoever wants to protect his **religion** also protects his limits.

fiqh-haram-bleibt-haram-aber-unrecht-ble.title: 📖 Fiqh: Ḥarām remains ḥarām, but injustice remains injustice
fiqh-haram-bleibt-haram-aber-unrecht-ble.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** explained:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said about wine: There is no price for wine; but Muslims are prevented from causing them harm or from spoiling something of theirs.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Fiqh joins firmness in the ḥarām with justice in dealings. Neither is ḥarām raised in status, nor is arbitrariness permitted.

fiqh-kein-falsches-recht-durch-urteil-ne.title: 📖 Fiqh: Do not take a false right through a judgment
fiqh-kein-falsches-recht-durch-urteil-ne.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** explained:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in substance: Whoever I award something of his brother’s right, let him not take it; I only cut off for him thereby a piece of the Fire.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** An outward judgment does not make bāṭil halal. The believer does not ask only what he can gain, but what is truly his right before Allah.

fiqh-maenner-sollen-frauen-nicht-schaden.title: 📖 Fiqh: Men should not harm women
fiqh-maenner-sollen-frauen-nicht-schaden.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained regarding the āyah that holding on to women in order to harm and to transgress is forbidden.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Fiqh protects rights. Marital authority may not be used in order to cause harm or to transgress Allah’s limits.

fiqh-monche-werden-nicht-gezielt-getotet.title: 📖 Fiqh: Monks are not deliberately killed
fiqh-monche-werden-nicht-gezielt-getotet.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** explained:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī explained that the killing of monks is refrained from — as following Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq, not merely as analogical inference.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Even in siyar fiqh there are limits, transmitted practice and distinction. Anger does not replace fiqh.

fiqh-takwa-nach-vermogen-001.title: 📖 Fiqh according to ability
fiqh-takwa-nach-vermogen-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“If I forbid you something, then avoid it. And if I command you something, then do of it what you are able.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **fiqh** joins **obedience** with **ability**. Prohibitions are avoided, and commands are fulfilled according to what is possible — without negligence and without exaggeration.

fitrah-schayatin-irrefuehrung-410.title: 📖 The fiṭrah and the misguidance of the shayāṭīn
fitrah-schayatin-irrefuehrung-410.body:
🖋️ ʿIyāḍ ibn Ḥimār reported that the Prophet ﷺ transmitted from his Lord:

“I created My servants as ḥunafāʾ. Then the shayāṭīn came to them, turned them away from their religion, made forbidden to them what I had permitted them, and commanded them to associate partners with Me, for which I have sent down no proof.”

🌙 Conclusion: The human being is not born with shirk, but upon the fiṭrah — the natural disposition toward tawḥīd. The real danger begins when the shayāṭīn twist the standards and draw hearts away from the truth. Therefore the fiṭrah remains protected only through the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

ghulat-099-die-gefahr-des-vorschnellen-t.title: 📖 The danger of hasty takfīr
ghulat-099-die-gefahr-des-vorschnellen-t.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“If a man says to his brother: ‘O kāfir,’ then it returns upon one of the two.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Takfīr is not a game with words. Whoever judges Muslims without right brings himself into great danger.

ghulat-100-einen-muslim-des-kufr-zu-besc.title: 📖 Accusing a Muslim of kufr
ghulat-100-einen-muslim-des-kufr-zu-besc.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever accuses a believer of kufr is like his murderer.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The tongue of the ghulāt often opens the door to enmity against Muslims. The Sunnah closes this door with a mighty warning.

ghulat-101-nicht-nach-mir-zu-kuffar-zuru.title: 📖 Do not return after me to kuffār
ghulat-101-nicht-nach-mir-zu-kuffar-zuru.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Do not return after me as kuffār, by some of you striking the necks of the others.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The path of the ghulāt does not end at mere slogans, but often at division, bloodshed and the desecration of the Muslims.

ghulat-102-hast-du-sein-herz-aufgeschnit.title: 📖 Did you cut open his heart?
ghulat-102-hast-du-sein-herz-aufgeschnit.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Did you kill him after he had said ‘lā ilāha illā Allah’?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The ghulāt intrude into intentions and hearts. The Sunnah binds the judgment to what is manifest and warns against encroachments.

ghulat-103-der-quran-ueberschreitet-ihre.title: 📖 The Qurʾān does not pass beyond their throats
ghulat-103-der-quran-ueberschreitet-ihre.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“They read the Qurʾān, yet it does not pass beyond their throats.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Much recitation alone is no proof of right guidance when understanding, the Sunnah and the manhaj of the Salaf are abandoned.

ghulat-104-sie-toeten-die-muslime-und-la.title: 📖 They kill the Muslims and leave the idolaters
ghulat-104-sie-toeten-die-muslime-und-la.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“They kill the people of Islam and leave the people of the idols.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A mark of extreme deviation is that hatred against Muslims becomes stronger than the clear enmity against shirk and kufr.

ghulat-105-verse-ueber-kuffar-auf-muslim.title: 📖 Applying verses about the kuffār to Muslims
ghulat-105-verse-ueber-kuffar-auf-muslim.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar** said:

> ***“They went to verses that were revealed about the kuffār and applied them to the believers.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ghulāt read proofs, but they apply them wrongly. Not every āyah about the kuffār may be applied to Muslims.

ghulat-106-die-schlimmsten-der-schoepfun.title: 📖 The worst of creation
ghulat-106-die-schlimmsten-der-schoepfun.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“They are the worst of creation and of creatures.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Extreme harshness against Muslims is not a sign of strength in the Dīn, but a path against which the Prophet ﷺ warned mightily.

ghulat-107-junge-im-alter-schwach-im-ver.title: 📖 Young in age, weak in understanding
ghulat-107-junge-im-alter-schwach-im-ver.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“At the end of time, people come: young in age, weak in understanding.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ghulūw often arises from zeal without maturity, text without fiqh and courage without knowledge.

ghulat-108-die-hunde-des-feuers.title: 📖 The dogs of the Fire
ghulat-108-die-hunde-des-feuers.body:
🖋️ **Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī** said:

> ***“They are the dogs of the Fire; the worst of those killed under the heaven.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The warning of the Salaf against the Ghulāt was not a side matter, but a protection for the blood, the Dīn and the community of the Muslims.

ghulat-widerlegt-urteil-nach-dem-offenku.title: 📖 The Ghulāt refuted: judgment according to what is manifest
ghulat-widerlegt-urteil-nach-dem-offenku.body:
🖋️ **ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī and Maymūn ibn Mihrān** said:

> ***“Today we take you only according to what becomes visible to us of your deeds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Takfīr based on suspicion, and tearing apart the prayer and the Jamāʿah, contradicts the rule of the Salaf: judgment according to what is manifest.

gueltigkeit-des-gebets-vs-urteil-ueber-p.title: 📖 Validity of the prayer versus judgment about persons
gueltigkeit-des-gebets-vs-urteil-ueber-p.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿUmar, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī and Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Pray behind him – and his bidʿah rests upon him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The question of prayer behind an imām is fiqh: imāmah, avoidance, repetition and the jamāʿah. It is not an automatic takfīr of the one who prays.

hadith-0004-ad-din-an-nasihah-460.title: 📖 The Dīn is naṣīḥah
hadith-0004-ad-din-an-nasihah-460.body:
🖋️ **The Messenger of Allah ﷺ** said:

***“The Dīn is naṣīḥah.”***

**The Ṣaḥābah said:**

***“For whom?”***

**He ﷺ said:**

***“For Allah, for His Book, for His Messenger, for the leaders of the Muslims and for their common people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
**Naṣīḥah** is not merely advice, but sincere loyalty and honest goodwill: toward Allah, His Book, His Messenger ﷺ, those responsible among the Muslims and the Muslim common people.

hasan-al-basri-geld-im-herzen-macht-mens.title: 📖 When money grows large in the heart, the person becomes small
hasan-al-basri-geld-im-herzen-macht-mens.body:
🖋️ **al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** said:

> ***“No one honors the dirham except that Allah humiliates him.”***

The attribution comes through **Hishām b. Ḥassān**, who expressly said that he heard al-Ḥasan swear by Allah.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Money is not the problem – **its place in the heart** is. In the hand it can be of benefit; in the heart it becomes humiliation. Whoever seeks his dignity with Allah lets the dunyā serve – not rule.

hasan-al-basri-selbstpruefung-20261021-4.title: 📖 Calling the soul to account
hasan-al-basri-selbstpruefung-20261021-4.body:
🖋️ **Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** (Tābiʿī) said in meaning:

“The believer **watches over himself** and *calls himself to account for the sake of Allāh.*

The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be **easier** for those who *have already called themselves to account in this world.*

**The reckoning, by contrast, will be heavy** for those who have conducted their affairs *without accountability.*”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **The cultivation of one’s own soul begins with sincere self-examination.** Whoever recognizes his faults, masters his desires and calls himself to account strives for the **purification of his soul** and obedience toward Allāh.

herzen-und-taten-001.title: 📖 Allah looks at hearts and deeds
herzen-und-taten-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Allah does not look at your outward forms and your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The measure with Allah is not **appearance**, **possession** or outward standing, but ***the heart and the deed***. Whoever wants to purify his path begins with **ikhlāṣ**, truthfulness and righteous deeds.

hinter-ihm-beten-ist-kein-shirk-ritual-1.title: 📖 Praying behind him is not a shirk ritual
hinter-ihm-beten-ist-kein-shirk-ritual-1.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī and ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak** said:

> ***“The Jahmiyyah are kuffār, and the Qadariyyah are kuffār.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The imāms distinguished between the judgment upon a teaching and the fiqh question of prayer behind a person. From this follows no automatism: that whoever prays behind him would be a mushrik or a kāfir.

hudhayfah-das-schlechte-erkennen-446.title: 📖 Recognize the evil so that it does not strike you
hudhayfah-das-schlechte-erkennen-446.body:
🖋️ **Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه** said:

***“The people used to ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the **good**. I, however, asked him about the **evil** – out of **fear** that it might strike me.”***

Ḥuḏayfah رضي الله عنه did not ask about the evil out of mere curiosity. He wanted to recognize the **fitnah**, its causes and its paths, so that it would not reach him unprepared.

Recognizing what is false does not serve to occupy oneself with it or to spread it. It serves to ***avoid*** it in time, to ***warn*** against it, and to hold fast to the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever does not know a danger can more easily fall into it. Therefore the believer learns the **good** in order to follow it, and recognizes the **evil** in order to protect himself from it.

hudhayfah-nifaq-offen-getragen-441.title: 📖 When what is hidden is carried openly
hudhayfah-nifaq-offen-getragen-441.body:
🖋️ **Ḥudhayfah ibn al-Yamān** رضي الله عنه said:

***“The hypocrites today are worse than those in the time of the Prophet ﷺ: then they concealed it, and today they show it openly.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**
