The Salaf feared nifāq not only as a hidden evil, but especially when it became openly visible. Whoever wants to protect his heart pays heed to sincerity, truth inwardly and steadfastness outwardly.

hudud-nicht-in-dar-al-harb-136.title: 📖 No ḥudūd in dār al-ḥarb
hudud-nicht-in-dar-al-harb-136.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qudāmah** said:

> ***“The ḥadd punishment is not carried out upon a Muslim in the land of the enemy.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The deed remains **ḥarām**, but carrying out the **ḥudūd** has conditions such as **wilāyah**, security, jurisdiction and maṣlaḥah. Whoever makes of this a blanket lever of takfīr contradicts the known fiqh rules of **Ahlus-Sunnah**.

hukm-muhakamah-abu-mijlaz-ordnung-als-di.title: 📖 Abū Mijlaz: They know that departing is a sin
hukm-muhakamah-abu-mijlaz-ordnung-als-di.body:
🖋️ **Abū Mijlaz:**

> ***“When he was asked about 5:44–47, he explained concerning the rulers of that time: It is their religion, to which they adhere, with which they speak and to which they call. When they leave something of it, they know that they have committed a sin.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement protects against ghulūw: Whoever acknowledges the ḥukm of Allah as Dīn and knows his departure as a sin is not like the one who replaces or rejects Allah’s judgment.

hukm-muhakamah-abwendung-vom-herabgesand.title: 📖 When they are called to what was sent down
hukm-muhakamah-abwendung-vom-herabgesand.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“When it is said to them: Come to what Allah has sent down, and to the Messenger, one sees the hypocrites turn away.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The sickness lies not only in the case of dispute, but in iʿrāḍ: one is called to the ḥukm of Allah and turns away.

hukm-muhakamah-allah-ist-bester-richter-.title: 📖 Who is better in judging than Allah?
hukm-muhakamah-allah-ist-bester-richter-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Who is better in judging than Allah for a people that has certainty?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever possesses certainty seeks no better measure than Allah’s judgment. The judgment of the Jāhiliyyah is no alternative.

hukm-muhakamah-allah-weiss-was-in-herzen.title: 📖 Allah knows what is in their hearts
hukm-muhakamah-allah-weiss-was-in-herzen.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah knows what is in their hearts; therefore the Prophet ﷺ should admonish them and speak emphatic words to them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** In ḥākimiyyah it is not only the outward claim that counts. Allah knows riḍā, radd, iʿrāḍ and what is hidden in the heart.

hukm-muhakamah-bestes-wort-als-massstab-.title: 📖 Allah sent down the best word
hukm-muhakamah-bestes-wort-als-massstab-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah sent down the best word, a Book that is guidance for whom He wills.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** If Allah’s word is the best word, then no other judgment is more just, wiser or worthier than His ḥukm.

hukm-muhakamah-bund-und-gehorchen-425.title: 📖 The covenant requires obedience
hukm-muhakamah-bund-und-gehorchen-425.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah took the covenant of the Children of Israel and bound it to prayer, zakāh, belief in the messengers and support of the revealed way.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The covenant with Allah is not mere profession. It requires obedience, judgment according to revelation and fidelity to Allah’s limits.

hukm-muhakamah-bundbruch-und-tahrif-426.title: 📖 Covenant-breaking leads to Taḥrīf
hukm-muhakamah-bundbruch-und-tahrif-426.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Because of their breaking of the covenant they were rebuked; they twisted the words out of their places and forgot a portion of that with which they were admonished.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Taḥrīf does not arise by chance. Whoever breaks the covenant begins to twist revelation and to forget uncomfortable rulings.

hukm-muhakamah-das-urteil-gehoert-allah-.title: 📖 Judgment belongs to Allah alone
hukm-muhakamah-das-urteil-gehoert-allah-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“Regarding ‘Judgment belongs to Allah alone,’ it becomes clear: Allah commands that only He be worshipped, and His judgment is part of the straight Dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥukm is not to be separated from Tauḥīd. Legislation, Ḥalāl and Ḥarām belong to Allah, not to human whim.

hukm-muhakamah-fasiq-muslim-bei-sunde-37.title: 📖 Whoever recognizes the forbidden is not like the Mustaḥill
hukm-muhakamah-fasiq-muslim-bei-sunde-37.body:
🖋️ **al-Qurṭubī:**

> ***“Whoever acts while believing that he is committing something forbidden belongs to the transgressors among the Muslims; different is the case of the one who believes it and declares it lawful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The boundary is clear: sin together with acknowledgment is not like Istiḥlāl. Whoever blurs this falls either into downplaying or into Ghulūw.

hukm-muhakamah-folge-der-shariah-nicht-h.title: 📖 Follow the Scharīʿah, not the desires
hukm-muhakamah-folge-der-shariah-nicht-h.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah set the Prophet ﷺ upon a Scharīʿah of the command and commanded him to follow it and not the desires of those who do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The contrast is clear: Scharīʿah or Hawā. Whoever replaces Allah’s way does not merely follow an opinion, but leaves the revealed standard.

hukm-muhakamah-gehorsam-und-warnung-410.title: 📖 Obedience to Allah and to the Messenger ﷺ
hukm-muhakamah-gehorsam-und-warnung-410.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and be cautious. If you turn away, then upon the Messenger rests only the clear conveyance.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥākimiyyah requires obedience. Whoever knows the message and turns away bears the danger of his turning away.

hukm-muhakamah-gerechtigkeit-auch-gegen-.title: 📖 Justice even toward opponents
hukm-muhakamah-gerechtigkeit-auch-gegen-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Hatred of a people must not lead you to be unjust. Be just; that is closer to Taqwā.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm of Allah is justice. Whoever judges falsely out of hatred follows Hawā and contradicts the standard of revelation.

hukm-muhakamah-gerechtigkeit-auch-gegen-.title: 📖 Justice even against oneself
hukm-muhakamah-gerechtigkeit-auch-gegen-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Stand firmly for justice as witnesses for Allah, even if it is against yourselves, your parents or close relatives.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judge and the witness do not serve family, benefit or party. They stand for Allah’s right.

hukm-muhakamah-gesandte-warnen-und-verku.title: 📖 The messengers came with warning and glad tidings
hukm-muhakamah-gesandte-warnen-und-verku.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The messengers were sent only as bearers of glad tidings and warners; whoever believes and makes amends has no fear.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Judgment and warning come through revelation. Whoever accepts and makes amends is not treated like the one who rejects.

hukm-muhakamah-gesandter-wird-gehorcht-3.title: 📖 The Messenger ﷺ was sent so that he be obeyed
hukm-muhakamah-gesandter-wird-gehorcht-3.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah did not send any messenger except that he be obeyed by Allah’s permission; and He knows what is in the hearts of those who turn away.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever rejects the Messenger ﷺ as judge does not attack a person, but the duty of obedience to the revelation.

hukm-muhakamah-gesandter-zum-gehorsam-39.title: 📖 No messenger except for obedience
hukm-muhakamah-gesandter-zum-gehorsam-39.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah did not send any messenger except that he be obeyed by Allah’s permission.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judgment of the Prophet ﷺ is not mere counsel. It is obedience to revelation.

hukm-muhakamah-glaeubige-brueder-im-stre.title: 📖 Even in dispute the believers remain brothers
hukm-muhakamah-glaeubige-brueder-im-stre.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The believers are brothers; therefore make peace between your brothers and fear Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This Āyah protects against false Takfīr: even severe conflicts do not automatically remove brotherhood.

hukm-muhakamah-halal-haram-ohne-erlaubni.title: 📖 Say: Has Allah permitted it to you?
hukm-muhakamah-halal-haram-ohne-erlaubni.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah rebukes those who declare part of the provision ḥalāl and part ḥarām, and asks: Has Allah permitted it to you, or do you invent a lie against Allah?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever permits and forbids in Allah’s name needs proof. Without proof, Ḥalāl/Ḥarām becomes a lie against Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-heimliche-intrige-gegen-u.title: 📖 Hidden from people, but not from Allah
hukm-muhakamah-heimliche-intrige-gegen-u.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“They hide from the people but not from Allah, while He is with them when they plot by night words with which He is not pleased.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A false judgment often begins in secret: intrigue, collusion and deception. Allah sees what people conceal.

hukm-muhakamah-heuchler-rechtfertigen-ab.title: 📖 The justification of those who turn away
hukm-muhakamah-heuchler-rechtfertigen-ab.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“When they are struck by the consequences of their own deeds, they come swearing and say: We only wanted good and agreement.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every fine explanation excuses turning away from the Ḥukm of Allah. The standard remains revelation, not a later justification.

hukm-muhakamah-hukm-und-ibadah-389.title: 📖 Ḥukm and ʿIbādah belong together
hukm-muhakamah-hukm-und-ibadah-389.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Judgment belongs to Allah alone. He commanded that you worship none but Him. That is the straight Dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm of Allah is part of Tauḥīd. Whoever pushes Allah aside in judgment does not merely attack a question of Fiqh.

hukm-muhakamah-ibn-abbas-kufr-duna-kufr-.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbbās: Kufr dūna Kufr regarding al-Māʾidah 5:44
hukm-muhakamah-ibn-abbas-kufr-duna-kufr-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās:**

> ***“Regarding ‘Whoever does not judge according to what Allah has sent down,’ Ibn ʿAbbās explained: It is Kufr, but not like the Kufr of one who denies Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers. Ṭāwūs and ʿAṭāʾ explained this as Kufr below Kufr.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Āyah is tremendous, but the Salaf made Tafṣīl: whoever acknowledges Allah’s judgment and deviates sinfully does not automatically fall into Kufr Akbar.

hukm-muhakamah-ibn-masud-rishwa-im-urtei.title: 📖 Ibn Masʿūd: Bribery in judgment is Kufr
hukm-muhakamah-ibn-masud-rishwa-im-urtei.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Masʿūd:**

> ***“When Ibn Masʿūd was asked about bribery, he said: It belongs to as-suḥt. When it was asked: And in judgment? he said: That is al-Kufr. Then he recited: Whoever does not judge according to what Allah has sent down.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Bribery in judgment is a tremendous sin and can be called Kufr; yet the Salaf explained at the same time that not every designation as Kufr is automatically Kufr Akbar.

hukm-muhakamah-islam-ganz-annehmen-424.title: 📖 Enter into Islam completely
hukm-muhakamah-islam-ganz-annehmen-424.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah commands the believers to enter into Islam completely and not to follow the footsteps of Shayṭān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥākimiyyah is not a selectable part of the Dīn. The Muslim accepts Islam as a whole, not only what suits him.

hukm-muhakamah-jenseits-von-allahs-urtei.title: 📖 Whoever leaves Allah’s judgment seeks opinions and desires
hukm-muhakamah-jenseits-von-allahs-urtei.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explains that Allah rebukes the one who leaves the clear and comprehensive judgment of Allah and turns to opinions, desires and man-made agreements.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tabdīl begins where revelation is no longer the highest standard, but is replaced by views and systems.

hukm-muhakamah-kein-herzenswiderstand-39.title: 📖 No resistance of the heart against the judgment
hukm-muhakamah-kein-herzenswiderstand-39.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“They do not believe until they make the Messenger ﷺ judge in all disputes and find in themselves no distress against his judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah joins outward Muḥākamah with inward Taslīm: no resistance to the Ḥukm of the Messenger ﷺ.

hukm-muhakamah-kein-iman-ohne-taslim-374.title: 📖 No Īmān without complete submission
hukm-muhakamah-kein-iman-ohne-taslim-374.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“No, by your Lord, they do not believe until they make you judge in what is disputed between them, then find in themselves no distress over your judgment, and submit completely.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The core of Muḥākamah is not only the outward judgment, but Taslīm: the heart submits to the judgment of the Messenger ﷺ.

hukm-muhakamah-kein-urteil-ohne-wissen-4.title: 📖 Do not speak without knowledge
hukm-muhakamah-kein-urteil-ohne-wissen-4.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge; hearing, sight, and the heart will be called to account.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Takfīr, Ḥukm, and Muḥākamah without knowledge are dangerous. Whoever judges needs proof, not mere emotion.

hukm-muhakamah-keiner-traegt-schuld-eine.title: 📖 No soul bears the burden of another
hukm-muhakamah-keiner-traegt-schuld-eine.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“No burden-bearing soul bears the burden of another; then to your Lord is your return.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Justice applies also in Ḥākimiyyah: guilt, Takfīr, and responsibility are not transferred wholesale, but judged according to proof and the person.

hukm-muhakamah-kufr-begriff-braucht-tafs.title: 📖 The term Kufr needs Tafṣīl
hukm-muhakamah-kufr-begriff-braucht-tafs.body:
🖋️ **The Salaf:**

> ***“The explanation of Ibn ʿAbbās, Ṭāwūs, and ʿAṭāʾ shows: in 5:44 the term Kufr can mean a Kufr below Kufr.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever uses the term Kufr without Tafṣīl does not follow the method of the Salaf, but opens the door to erroneous Takfīr.

hukm-muhakamah-kufr-zulm-fisq-zusammen-3.title: 📖 Understanding Kufr, Ẓulm, and Fisq together
hukm-muhakamah-kufr-zulm-fisq-zusammen-3.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah names, in the connected verses, those who do not judge by what He has sent down as Kāfirūn, Ẓālimūn, and Fāsiqūn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The terms are weighty, but they are understood according to context and Iʿtiqād: denial is not like sinful deviation while acknowledging.

hukm-muhakamah-leugnung-und-anerkennung-.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbbās: denial is not like sinful deviation
hukm-muhakamah-leugnung-und-anerkennung-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās:**

> ***“Whoever denies what Allah has sent down falls into Kufr. But whoever acknowledges it and still does not judge by it falls under ẓulm and fisq.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This is the middle path of Ahlus-Sunnah: no belittling of the violation, and no blanket Takfīr without denial, replacement, or Istiḥlāl.

hukm-muhakamah-luege-gegen-allah-halal-h.title: 📖 Ḥalāl and Ḥarām without proof is a lie against Allah
hukm-muhakamah-luege-gegen-allah-halal-h.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do not say with your lying tongues: this is ḥalāl and this is ḥarām, so as to invent a lie against Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Dīn is not claimed by tongues, but established by revelation. Ḥalāl and Ḥarām without proof are a dangerous presumption.

hukm-muhakamah-muhkam-und-mutashabih-371.title: 📖 Muḥkam and Mutashābih: the foundation before Fitna
hukm-muhakamah-muhkam-und-mutashabih-371.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“In the Book there are clear verses that are the foundation, and others that are ambiguous. Whoever has deviation in the heart follows the ambiguous, seeking Fitna.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** In Ḥākimiyyah one must not tear single terms out of their context. The clear foundations of the Salaf govern the ambiguous passages.

hukm-muhakamah-nicht-fuer-verraeter-stre.title: 📖 Judge by what Allah showed you
hukm-muhakamah-nicht-fuer-verraeter-stre.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“We sent down the Book to you with the truth, so that you may judge between people by what Allah showed you; and do not be an advocate for the traitors.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judge must not become an advocate of fraud, faction, or deception. The measure is what Allah showed.

hukm-muhakamah-nicht-fuer-verraeter-stre.title: 📖 Do not contend for the traitors
hukm-muhakamah-nicht-fuer-verraeter-stre.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do not contend for those who betray themselves. Allah does not love anyone who is treacherous and sinful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah must not become a cover for fraud. Whoever twists the right does not serve Allah’s Ḥukm.

hukm-muhakamah-nifaq-abwendung-vom-urtei.title: 📖 Nifāq: turning away from the judgment of the Messenger ﷺ
hukm-muhakamah-nifaq-abwendung-vom-urtei.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“When they are called to the judgment of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, the hypocrites turn away; and true Īmān requires making the Messenger ﷺ the judge and submitting completely.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** It is not merely the legal path that decides, but the stance: acceptance and Taslīm, or turning away and refusal.

hukm-muhakamah-offenbarung-erklaert-alle.title: 📖 Revelation explains and obligates
hukm-muhakamah-offenbarung-erklaert-alle.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah sent down the Book as an explanation of everything and set the Prophet ﷺ upon a Sharīʿah of command, so that he would follow it and not the desires of those who do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm of Allah is not an empty term. It is revelation, guidance, and a binding path.

hukm-muhakamah-offenbarung-muss-uebermit.title: 📖 Convey what was sent down from your Lord
hukm-muhakamah-offenbarung-muss-uebermit.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah commanded the Messenger ﷺ to convey what was sent down from his Lord; if he did not do so, he would not have conveyed the message.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Revelation is not hidden, softened, or replaced. It is conveyed, even when it is hard for people.

hukm-muhakamah-partner-in-gesetzgebung-3.title: 📖 Do they have partners who legislate the religion?
hukm-muhakamah-partner-in-gesetzgebung-3.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah censures those who have partners that prescribe for them in the Dīn what Allah has not permitted.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tashrīʿ against Allah is not mere opinion. Whoever sets his own norms as Dīn intrudes into the domain that belongs to Allah alone.

hukm-muhakamah-qurtubi-zwei-faelle-357.title: 📖 al-Qurṭubī: Tabdīl is not like a sin from desire
hukm-muhakamah-qurtubi-zwei-faelle-357.body:
🖋️ **al-Qurṭubī:**

> ***“Whoever judges by what he has with himself, on the basis that it is from Allah, commits Tabdīl, which entails Kufr. But whoever judges thereby out of Hawā and sin commits a sin.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The key formula is clear: Tabdīl and Istiḥlāl are not like a single sinful deviation while acknowledging the Ḥukm of Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-rabbiner-als-herren-376.title: 📖 9:31: when Ḥalāl and Ḥarām are left to others
hukm-muhakamah-rabbiner-als-herren-376.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“The explanation of the verse shows: they took their scholars as lords in that these permitted them the Ḥarām and forbade them the Ḥalāl, and they followed them in that.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Obedience in self-appointed legislation is no small matter: Ḥalāl and Ḥarām are the right of Allah alone.

hukm-muhakamah-radd-des-quran-387.title: 📖 Whoever rejects the Qurʾān is not like the sinner
hukm-muhakamah-radd-des-quran-387.body:
🖋️ **al-Qurṭubī:**

> ***“Whoever does not judge by what Allah has sent down, out of rejection of the Qurʾān, is a kāfir; but whoever acts while believing that he is committing something forbidden belongs to the transgressors among the Muslims.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Radd is the axis of Kufr. Sin while acknowledging is dangerous and transgressive, but not automatically the same level.

hukm-muhakamah-rajm-fall-tahrif-359.title: 📖 The Rajm case: when revelation is concealed
hukm-muhakamah-rajm-fall-tahrif-359.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“The Jews sought from the Prophet ﷺ a milder judgment in the case of adultery. When the Rajm became visible from their scripture, the Prophet ﷺ said in substance that he judged by what is in the Tawrāt, and he had the judgment carried out.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The core of the Kufr here lies in deliberately concealing and replacing the revealed judgment, not in a mere error of the judge.

hukm-muhakamah-reform-mit-gerechtigkeit-.title: 📖 Reconciliation with justice
hukm-muhakamah-reform-mit-gerechtigkeit-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“If one group returns, then make peace between them with justice and be just; Allah loves the just.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Even in dispute among Muslims, the measure remains ʿAdl. Neither partiality nor Ghulūw may lead the judgment.

hukm-muhakamah-richte-mit-gerechtigkeit-.title: 📖 When you judge, judge with justice
hukm-muhakamah-richte-mit-gerechtigkeit-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“If you judge between them, then judge between them with justice. Truly, Allah loves the just.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥākimiyyah is not only a slogan. It requires ʿAdl: judgment according to truth, not according to money, faction, fear, or inclination.

hukm-muhakamah-richten-nach-offenbarung-.title: 📖 an-Nisāʾ 4:105: Judging by what Allah has shown
hukm-muhakamah-richten-nach-offenbarung-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“We sent down the Book to you with the truth, so that you may judge between the people by what Allah has shown you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The standard of the Ḥukm is revelation, not desire, tribal interest, bribery, or man-made arbitrariness.

hukm-muhakamah-richter-braucht-istighfar.title: 📖 Even in judgment the servant needs Istighfār
hukm-muhakamah-richter-braucht-istighfar.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah commands the Prophet ﷺ in the context of judging: Ask Allah for forgiveness; Allah is All-Forgiving and Merciful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This shows humility in the Ḥukm: the servant does not judge arrogantly, but with fear, examination, and return to Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-scheinargumente-der-heuch.title: 📖 Specious arguments after turning away
hukm-muhakamah-scheinargumente-der-heuch.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“When they are struck because of their own deeds, they come swearing and say: We only wanted good and agreement.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every fine declaration of intention excuses turning away from the judgment of Allah. Proofs weigh more than justifications.

hukm-muhakamah-schlussstein-kufr-duna-ku.title: 📖 Keystone: Kufr dūna Kufr remains a Salaf explanation
hukm-muhakamah-schlussstein-kufr-duna-ku.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās and Ṭāwūs:**

> ***“The Salaf did not explain the Kufr in 5:44 wholesale as leaving the religion; they distinguished between Kufr Akbar and Kufr dūna Kufr.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** With this the method is clear: we hold fast the gravity of the Āyah, but we judge by Tafṣīl, not by Ghulūw.

hukm-muhakamah-schuld-auf-sich-selbst-41.title: 📖 Whoever earns a sin earns it against himself
hukm-muhakamah-schuld-auf-sich-selbst-41.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever earns a sin earns it only against himself. Allah is All-Knowing and Wise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Responsibility is personal. In Ḥukm and Takfīr, guilt is not transferred wholesale.

hukm-muhakamah-schuld-nicht-auf-unschuld.title: 📖 Whoever casts guilt upon an innocent person
hukm-muhakamah-schuld-nicht-auf-unschuld.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever commits an offense or a sin and then attributes it to an innocent person bears slander and clear sin.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Even in the dispute over Ḥākimiyyah this holds: accusation without proof is itself a grave sin.

hukm-muhakamah-shariah-als-befehl-allahs.title: 📖 Sharīʿah is Allah’s command, not Hawā
hukm-muhakamah-shariah-als-befehl-allahs.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah set the Prophet ﷺ upon a Sharīʿah of command and ordered him to follow it and not the desires of those who do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever separates Sharīʿah from Hawā understands Ḥākimiyyah: Allah’s way is followed, not replaced according to whim.

hukm-muhakamah-sicherheit-durch-tauhid-4.title: 📖 Security belongs to the people of pure Tauḥīd
hukm-muhakamah-sicherheit-durch-tauhid-4.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Those who believe and do not mix their faith with Ẓulm — for them is security, and they are rightly guided.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The foundation remains Tauḥīd. Yet Ẓulm has degrees; not every Ẓulm is equated without Tafṣīl.

hukm-muhakamah-streit-zurueck-zu-allah-u.title: 📖 Dispute is brought back to Allah and the Messenger ﷺ
hukm-muhakamah-streit-zurueck-zu-allah-u.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“If you dispute about anything, then bring it back to Allah and to the Messenger, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah begins here: dispute is not brought back to Hawā, tribal law, or Ṭāghūt, but to the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

hukm-muhakamah-suddi-544-warnung-an-jude.title: 📖 as-Suddī: 5:44 rebukes abandoning Allah’s judgment
hukm-muhakamah-suddi-544-warnung-an-jude.body:
🖋️ **as-Suddī:**

> ***“The Āyah warns against abandoning what Allah has sent down, and against judging by other than His judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The verse remains immense and general as a warning. Its application, however, needs the Tafṣīl of the Salaf: denial and replacement are not like sinful deviation while acknowledging.

hukm-muhakamah-suht-und-luegenhoeren-384.title: 📖 Suḥt: When lying and forbidden gain corrupt the judgment
hukm-muhakamah-suht-und-luegenhoeren-384.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah describes those who listen to falsehood and consume as-suḥt. Then He mentions the decision between them and the just judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Bribery and forbidden gain corrupt the Ḥukm. This is a grave sin and closeness to the Jāhiliyyah, even though the concrete Takfīr needs Tafṣīl.

hukm-muhakamah-sunnah-erklaert-den-quran.title: 📖 The Messenger ﷺ explains the Qurʾān
hukm-muhakamah-sunnah-erklaert-den-quran.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah sent down the Reminder to the Messenger ﷺ so that he might explain to the people what was sent down to them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Therefore the Ḥukm is not separated from the Qurʾān, and the Sunnah is not set aside. Both are the standard.

hukm-muhakamah-sura-verpflichtend-gemach.title: 📖 Allah sent down and made binding
hukm-muhakamah-sura-verpflichtend-gemach.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“A Sūrah which We sent down and made binding, and in which We sent down clear signs, so that you may reflect.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Revelation is not mere inspiration without binding force. It contains Farāʾiḍ, limits, and clear Aḥkām.

hukm-muhakamah-tabari-tahrif-und-ersetzu.title: 📖 aṭ-Ṭabarī: They replaced and altered Allah’s judgment
hukm-muhakamah-tabari-tahrif-und-ersetzu.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“Those who are rebuked did not judge by what Allah had sent down in His Book; they replaced and altered His judgment, concealed the truth, showed the people something else, and judged by that.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This is not the case of a mere wrong judgment out of weakness, but the case of Taḥrīf and Tabdīl: Allah’s judgment is pushed aside and another judgment is put in its place.

hukm-muhakamah-taghut-verleugnen-394.title: 📖 The Ṭāghūt is to be rejected
hukm-muhakamah-taghut-verleugnen-394.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah rebukes those who claim to believe but want to have themselves judged by the Ṭāghūt, although they were commanded to reject him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah to the Ṭāghūt is no side matter. The foundation is Barāʾah from the false judgment and submission to Allah’s Ḥukm.

hukm-muhakamah-tahakum-zum-taghut-360.title: 📖 an-Nisāʾ 4:60: Taḥākum to the Ṭāghūt
hukm-muhakamah-tahakum-zum-taghut-360.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“Allah rebukes those who claim to believe but want to have themselves judged by the Ṭāghūt, although they were commanded to reject him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The dangerous core is not only an outward legal path, but Radd, Iʿrāḍ, and Riḍā toward the judgment of the Ṭāghūt instead of submission to Allah’s revelation.

hukm-muhakamah-tahkim-fremder-gesetze-is.title: 📖 Taḥkīm of foreign laws: ḥarām — and Kufr in the case of Istiḥlāl
hukm-muhakamah-tahkim-fremder-gesetze-is.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbd al-Laṭīf b. ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān Āl aš-Šaykh** explained:

> ***“Taḥkīm (recourse to / arbitration by) foreign laws is forbidden when it rests on false legislation that contradicts the Book of Allah and the Sunnah — such as the judgments of the Greeks, the Franks, the Tatars, and the customary laws of the Bedouin. Whoever, however, declares it lawful to judge by them is a Kāfir.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Foreign legislation is not made light of: **Taḥkīm** by laws that contradict the Qurʾān and the Sunnah is **ḥarām**. **Kufr Akbar**, however, occurs in the case of **Istiḥlāl** — when one declares this order lawful, grants it legitimacy, or ascribes to it supremacy over Allah’s law.

hukm-muhakamah-tahrif-wenn-urteil-nur-pa.title: 📖 Taḥrīf: Taking the judgment only when it suits
hukm-muhakamah-tahrif-wenn-urteil-nur-pa.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“Allah describes those who twist words out of their places and say: If this judgment is given to you, take it; if not, then be on your guard.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This is the core of Taḥrīf: revelation is not taken as the standard, but bent according to benefit and desire.

hukm-muhakamah-taschri-ohne-erlaubnis-al.title: 📖 Tašrīʿ without Allah’s permission
hukm-muhakamah-taschri-ohne-erlaubnis-al.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do they have partners who have prescribed for them a religion that Allah has not permitted? And do not say falsely: This is ḥalāl and this is ḥarām, in order to invent a lie against Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥalāl and Ḥarām belong to Allah alone. Whoever sets his own norms as Dīn, or permits and forbids in Allah’s name, enters the domain of Tašrīʿ and of lying against Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-taschri-von-satanswegen-4.title: 📖 Tašrīʿ without Allah’s permission follows the ways of the Shayāṭīn
hukm-muhakamah-taschri-von-satanswegen-4.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explains that they did not follow what Allah prescribed as the straight Dīn, but what their Shayāṭīn prescribed for them: to forbid the ḥalāl and to permit the ḥarām.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tašrīʿ against Allah is not a neutral legal act. It is an arrogation against the Dīn and the limits of Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-taubah-nach-sunde-418.title: 📖 Whoever sins and repents finds Allah forgiving
hukm-muhakamah-taubah-nach-sunde-418.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever does evil or wrongs himself and then asks Allah for forgiveness will find Allah All-Forgiving and Merciful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This Āyah guards against despair and against Ghulūw: sin is dangerous, but the door of Tawbah remains open.

hukm-muhakamah-tawakkul-im-gehorsam-433.title: 📖 Trusting in Allah within obedience
hukm-muhakamah-tawakkul-im-gehorsam-433.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah reminds the believers of His favor and commands Taqwā; in Allah the believers should place their trust.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever carries Allah’s Ḥukm needs Taqwā and Tawakkul. The truth is not abandoned out of fear of people.

hukm-muhakamah-tawus-kein-austritt-aus-m.title: 📖 Ṭāwūs: Not the Kufr that takes one out of the Millah
hukm-muhakamah-tawus-kein-austritt-aus-m.body:
🖋️ **Ṭāwūs:**

> ***“Concerning al-Māʾidah 5:44, Ṭāwūs explained that what may be meant by it is a Kufr that does not take one out of the Millah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This explanation is a firm foundation of the Salaf: the term Kufr is not mechanically always understood as Kufr Akbar.

hukm-muhakamah-urteil-der-jahiliyyah-366.title: 📖 The judgment of the Ǧāhiliyyah is no standard
hukm-muhakamah-urteil-der-jahiliyyah-366.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“Allah rebukes the one who turns away from the judgment of Allah and seeks the judgment of the Ǧāhiliyyah. Who is better in judging than Allah for a people of certainty?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever replaces Allah’s judgment with the standards of the Ǧāhiliyyah, or prefers them, attacks the core of Ḥākimiyyah.

hukm-muhakamah-urteil-nach-dem-was-allah.title: 📖 Judge according to what Allah has shown you
hukm-muhakamah-urteil-nach-dem-was-allah.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah sent down the Book with the truth, so that judgment is given among the people according to what Allah has shown, not as a defense of the traitors.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judge must not become an advocate of deception. The judgment follows revelation and truth.

hukm-muhakamah-verbietet-nicht-das-erlau.title: 📖 Do not forbid the good things that Allah has permitted
hukm-muhakamah-verbietet-nicht-das-erlau.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah forbids the believers to forbid the good things that He has permitted them, and He warns against transgression.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Personal abstinence is not the same as Tašrīʿ. It becomes dangerous when what is permitted is forbidden in the name of the religion.

hukm-muhakamah-verborgenes-wird-offengel.title: 📖 The Messenger ﷺ brings to light what was hidden of the Book
hukm-muhakamah-verborgenes-wird-offengel.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The Messenger ﷺ came to bring to light much of what had been hidden of the Book, and Allah sent down light and a clear Book.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The case of Rajm fits precisely this principle: revelation is concealed, and the Messenger ﷺ makes the Ḥukm of Allah visible again.

hukm-muhakamah-vergessen-des-geoffenbart.title: 📖 Whoever forgets a portion of the reminder
hukm-muhakamah-vergessen-des-geoffenbart.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The covenant was also taken from those who said they were Christians; then they forgot a portion of that with which they had been reminded.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A Dīn is damaged not only by open rejection, but also by the selective forgetting of the revealed duties.

hukm-muhakamah-verpflichtende-verse-422.title: 📖 Sent down and made binding
hukm-muhakamah-verpflichtende-verse-422.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah describes the Sūrah as sent down and made binding, with clear signs, so that the people may remember.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Revelation contains duties and limits. Whoever treats it as non-binding changes the meaning of the Scharīʿah.

hukm-muhakamah-vom-dunkel-zum-licht-429.title: 📖 Revelation leads out of darkness into light
hukm-muhakamah-vom-dunkel-zum-licht-429.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Through the Book, Allah guides those who seek His pleasure to the ways of peace and brings them out of darknesses into the light.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm of Allah is light. Whoever replaces it with Hawā or Ṭāghūt leaves light and guidance.

hukm-muhakamah-weg-der-glaeubigen-421.title: 📖 Whoever opposes the Messenger and follows another path
hukm-muhakamah-weg-der-glaeubigen-421.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him, and follows a path other than that of the believers, will be left to that to which he turned.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah does not follow isolated slogans, but the path of the Messenger ﷺ and the path of the believers.

hukm-muhakamah-wenn-es-passt-nehmen-sie-.title: 📖 If it suits them, they take it
hukm-muhakamah-wenn-es-passt-nehmen-sie-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“They said: If this judgment is given to you, then take it; if not, then be on your guard.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Taḥrīf begins where revelation is accepted only when it serves one’s own inclination.

hukm-muhakamah-wir-hoeren-und-gehorchen-.title: 📖 The answer of the believers: We hear and we obey
hukm-muhakamah-wir-hoeren-und-gehorchen-.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“When the believers are called to the judgment of Allah and of His Messenger ﷺ, their statement is: We hear and we obey.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah does not measure Ḥākimiyyah by slogans, but by acceptance, obedience and submission to the Ḥukm of Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-zusammenfassung-grenze-ku.title: 📖 The boundary: acknowledgment or replacement
hukm-muhakamah-zusammenfassung-grenze-ku.body:
🖋️ **The Imāms of Ahlus-Sunnah:**

> ***“If Allah’s judgment is acknowledged, but one deviates from it out of sin, desire, bribery or weakness, it is a major sin and Kufr dūna Kufr. If Allah’s judgment is denied, replaced, rejected or held to be non-binding, this is Kufr Akbar.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The series may neither trivialize nor exaggerate: no blanket Takfīr for every wrong judgment, and also no excuse for Tabdīl, Istiḥlāl and replacement of the Ḥukm of Allah.

hukm-muhakamah-zwei-wege-glaube-und-able.title: 📖 Faith and rejection have different ends
hukm-muhakamah-zwei-wege-glaube-und-able.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah promised the believers who do righteous deeds forgiveness and a tremendous reward; and He warned those who deny and declare His signs to be a lie.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The series must preserve both sides: hope for faith and repentance, and warning against denial and rejection.

ibn-abbas-rabbaniyin-hilm-fiqh-549.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbbās: Be Rabbānī
ibn-abbas-rabbaniyin-hilm-fiqh-549.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās** said about the word of Allāh: **“Be Rabbānīyīn”**:

***“Be Rabbānīyīn: people of **Ḥilm** and **Fiqh**.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A Rabbānī is not only someone who carries knowledge. He joins **knowledge** with ***forbearance*** and ***understanding in the Dīn***, so that people are built up with truth — not broken with harshness.

ibn-abd-al-barr-istiwa-sprache-bekannt-1.title: 📖 Istiwaʾ is known in the language
ibn-abd-al-barr-istiwa-sprache-bekannt-1.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** said:

> ***“Istiwaʾ is known and understood in the language: it means ʿulū, irtifāʿ, istiqrār and tamakkun.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement of **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** shows that **Istiwaʾ** is not meaningless or wholly unknown. **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the transmitted meaning, without entering into the **Kayfiyyah** and without emptying the texts by a false **Taʾwīl**.

ibn-abd-al-barr-nuzul-ohne-kayf-137.title: 📖 Ahlus-Sunnah affirm the Ṣifāt without Kayf
ibn-abd-al-barr-nuzul-ohne-kayf-137.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** said:

> ***“One says: He descends, but one does not say: How is the descending? And one does not say: How is the Istiwaʾ? How is the coming? How is the Tajallī?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the transmitted **Ṣifāt** such as **Nuzūl**, **Istiwaʾ**, **Majīʾ** and **Tajallī**, without asking about the **Kayfiyyah**. At the same time, **Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr** rejected the interpretation that only “command” or “mercy” was meant by it.

ibn-abd-al-barr-nuzul-ohne-kayf-slides-4.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr: Ahlus-Sunnah affirm the Ṣifāt without Kayf
ibn-abd-al-barr-nuzul-ohne-kayf-slides-4.body:
🖋️ Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr said about the Ḥadīth “Our Rabb descends”:

“The way of the scholars of Ahlus-Sunnah, truth and Īmān is to believe in such texts from the Qurʾān and the Sunnah – without a description of the how. They say: He descends, but they do not say: How is the descending? And they do not say: How is the Istiwāʾ? How is the coming? How is the Tajallī?”

👉🏼 Explanation: This is the clear middle of Ahlus-Sunnah: the Ṣifāt are affirmed, but the how is not described and is not compared with creation.

🖋️ Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr at the same time refuted the interpretation that only Allah’s command, mercy or favor descends:

“That is nothing, for His command descends by day and by night – not only at a fixed time such as the last third of the night.”

🌙 Conclusion: Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr affirms the Nuzūl without Kayf and rejects the reduction to mere command or mercy. Precisely that is the way of Ahlus-Sunnah: affirmation without Takyīf, without Taʿṭīl and without Tashbīh.

ibn-al-mubarak-zuhd-001.title: 📖 When the end stands before the eyes
ibn-al-mubarak-zuhd-001.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak** reported:

> ***“Death suffices as an admonisher.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever does not forget **death** sees the **Dunyā** smaller and the **Ākhirah** nearer. True vigilance begins where the heart grasps: ***This journey ends – and then the reckoning begins.***

ibn-battah-ahl-al-bidah-nicht-zum-herzen.title: 📖 Ibn Baṭṭah: Do not let Ahl al-Bidʿah into the heart
ibn-battah-ahl-al-bidah-nicht-zum-herzen.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah gathered the warnings of the early Imāms against listening to Ahl al-Ahwāʾ or sitting with them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The heart is weak. Whoever deliberately opens it to people who confuse exposes his Dīn to needless danger.

ibn-battah-das-fundament-ist-festhalten-.title: 📖 Ibn Baṭṭah: The foundation is holding fast to the Jamāʿah
ibn-battah-das-fundament-ist-festhalten-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah presented holding fast to the Jamāʿah and avoiding division as a mighty principle of the Sunnah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Manhaj is not chaos and going alone. The path of the Sunnah is attachment to the truth, the Jamāʿah and transmission.

ibn-battah-die-sunnah-ist-rettung-vor-sp.title: 📖 Ibn Baṭṭah: The Sunnah is salvation from division
ibn-battah-die-sunnah-ist-rettung-vor-sp.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah presented the Sunnah and the Jamāʿah as a protection against division and desires.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** When dispute increases, it is not the loudest voice that saves, but the firm return to the Sunnah and to the Athār.

ibn-masud-glaeubige-fuerchtet-suenden-16.title: 📖 The believer fears his sins – the heedless one brushes them away
ibn-masud-glaeubige-fuerchtet-suenden-16.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“The believer sees his sins as if he were sitting beneath a mountain and fears that it will fall upon him. The Fājir sees his sins like a fly that passes over his nose – and he brushes it away.”***

This is a mighty measure: Īmān is not shown by having no faults, but by how heavy one’s own faults weigh.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever belittles his sins loses vigilance. Whoever takes them seriously, without despairing of Allah’s mercy, carries a living heart. **Tawbah begins where the sin no longer seems normal.**

ibn-masud-ittiba-athar-001.title: 📖 Follow and do not invent
ibn-masud-ittiba-athar-001.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“Follow and do not invent, for you have been given what suffices.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation**

This short statement carries a mighty principle: the **Dīn** is not completed by new paths, later methods of dispute or personal embellishment. What Allah and His Messenger ﷺ have transmitted is **sufficient**, **clear** and **complete**.

Whoever follows the **Sunnah** holds to a safe path. Whoever thinks that religion must be supplemented by innovations places himself in a dangerous place: he treats **Bidʿah** as if it were a substitute for a lack in the revelation.

The early Imāms therefore understood: safety does not lie in saying much that is new, but in ***remaining firm with what has been transmitted***.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever seeks protection for his **Aqīdah** should not invent, but follow: **Qurʾān**, **Sunnah** and the **Ā

ibn-masud-jamaah-wahrheit-466.title: 📖 When the majority is not the measure
ibn-masud-jamaah-wahrheit-466.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

**"The mass of the Jamāʿah is that which has left the Jamāʿah. The Jamāʿah is only what agrees with obedience to Allah, even if you are alone."**

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Jamāʿah** is not measured by mere **majority**, but by **truth**, **obedience to Allah** and holding to the **proof**. Whoever stands with the **Qurʾān**, the **Sunnah** and the path of the **Salaf** is not abandoned, even if he appears outwardly **alone**.

ibn-masud-mira-zerstoert-mehr-als-sie-kl.title: 📖 Mirāʾ destroys more than it clarifies
ibn-masud-mira-zerstoert-mehr-als-sie-kl.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***"Mirāʾ (disputation) has no wisdom that can be grasped – and you are not safe from its Fitnah (trial/harm)."***

👉🏼 Not every argument is **ʿIlm (knowledge)**. Much of it is only **Nafs (ego)** that wants to win.

👉🏼 Mirāʾ takes the **Barakah (blessing)** out of knowledge, hardens the hearts and produces enmity, even when a person thinks he is defending the truth.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Seek the **Haqq (truth)** with **Adab**, not victory with loudness.

ibn-masud-opfere-vergaengliche-fuer-blei.title: 📖 Sacrifice the passing for the lasting
ibn-masud-opfere-vergaengliche-fuer-blei.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

***"Whoever wants the Ākhirah accepts harm in his Dunyā; and whoever wants the Dunyā accepts harm in his Ākhirah. O people, accept harm in the passing for the sake of the lasting."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Whoever truly prefers the Ākhirah is ready to bear worldly losses. The passing must not be placed above the lasting.

ibn-masud-wenig-sunnah-besser-als-viel-b.title: 📖 A little Sunnah is better than much Bidʿah
ibn-masud-wenig-sunnah-besser-als-viel-b.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“A little upon the Sunnah is better than much effort in a Bidʿah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The measure is not how much a person does, but whether his deed stands upon the **Sunnah**. A small deed on a sound basis is better than great exertion on an invented path.

ibn-masud-wenn-fiqh-wenig-wird-443.title: 📖 When Fiqh becomes scarce
ibn-masud-wenn-fiqh-wenig-wird-443.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

***"You are in a time in which its Fuqahāʾ are many and its reciters are few; in it the limits of the Qurʾān are preserved and its letters are neglected.***

***And a time will come upon the people in which their reciters are many and their Fuqahāʾ are few; the letters of the Qurʾān will be preserved, but its limits neglected."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The Salaf did not attend only to reciting the letters, but to preserving the limits, the meanings and the deeds. True knowledge is not shown only on the tongue, but in the Qurʾān guiding the person.

ibn-masud-wissen-verlangt-handeln-459.title: 📖 Knowledge requires action
ibn-masud-wissen-verlangt-handeln-459.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** (رضي الله عنه) said:

**"Learn, learn! Then, when you have attained knowledge, act upon it."**

🌙 **Conclusion:** True knowledge does not end at learning. Its benefit appears when what has been known is put into deed.

ibn-qutaybah-ahl-al-hadith-bewahren-die-.title: 📖 Ibn Qutaybah: Ahl al-Ḥadīth preserve the transmission
ibn-qutaybah-ahl-al-hadith-bewahren-die-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qutaybah** said:

> ***“Ibn Qutaybah defended Ahl al-Ḥadīth and explained that they carry and preserve the transmissions of the Messenger ﷺ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever belittles Ahl al-Ḥadīth weakens the bridge to the Sunnah. Transmission is a protection of the Dīn.

ibn-qutaybah-scheinbarer-widerspruch-wir.title: 📖 Ibn Qutaybah: An apparent contradiction is resolved with knowledge
ibn-qutaybah-scheinbarer-widerspruch-wir.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qutaybah** said:

> ***“Ibn Qutaybah explained in his work that apparent contradictions in the Ḥadīth are treated with knowledge, with the gathering of the transmissions and with sound understanding.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every apparent contradiction is a real contradiction. Often a person lacks only knowledge, context and patience.

ibn-sirin-wissen-vorbildliche-lebensfueh.title: 📖 Knowledge and an exemplary way of life
ibn-sirin-wissen-vorbildliche-lebensfueh.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn** said:

“They learned **exemplary conduct of life** just as they learned **knowledge**.”

🌙 **Conclusion:** Knowledge alone is not enough. The early generations placed just as great a weight on **character and exemplary behavior**.

ibn-taymiyyah-ghulat-takfir-durch-suende.title: 📖 The Ghulāt turn sins into Kufr
ibn-taymiyyah-ghulat-takfir-durch-suende.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“The second difference with the Khawārij and Ahl al-Bidʿah is: they declare people Kuffār because of sins and evil deeds. From this it follows, with them, that they declare the blood and the property of the Muslims lawful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ghulāt in Takfīr follow the path of the Khawārij when they turn sins into Kufr without the conditions and the impediments of Takfīr. Ahlus-Sunnah distinguishes between **sin**, **Bidʿah**, an **act of Kufr** and the **judgment upon the specific person**.

ibn-taymiyyah-mittler-zur-anrufung-gemac.title: 📖 When the intermediary is made someone to call upon
ibn-taymiyyah-mittler-zur-anrufung-gemac.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Whoever makes the angels and the prophets intermediaries, calls upon them, places his trust in them and asks them to bring benefit and to turn away harm … he is a Kāfir by the consensus of the Muslims.”***

What is meant is not the permitted asking of a living person for Duʿāʾ, or for help in what he is able to do. What is meant is calling upon someone besides **Allah**, placing tawakkul upon him and asking him for things that only **Allah** can do.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever attributes to prophets or angels what belongs to Allah alone leaves the core of **Tawḥīd**. Duʿāʾ, trust and rescue from distress belong to **Allah alone**.

ijma-auch-einzeln-uberlieferter-konsens-.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: A consensus transmitted by single reports also has probative force
ijma-auch-einzeln-uberlieferter-konsens-.body:
🖋️ **aš-Šawkānī** explained:

> ***“aš-Šawkānī said: The Ijmāʿ that is transmitted by the path of Āḥād is a Ḥujjah; this was said by al-Māwardī, Imām al-Ḥaramayn and al-Āmidī.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every Ijmāʿ is transmitted with equal strength, but a reliably reported Ijmāʿ is not simply made worthless.

ijma-keine-totung-unter-zwang-218.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: No killing under compulsion
ijma-keine-totung-unter-zwang-218.body:
🖋️ **al-Qurṭubī** explained:

> ***“al-Qurṭubī said: The scholars agree that the one who is compelled to kill another may not proceed to kill him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ikrāh has rules, but protected blood is not made lawful by compulsion. Here the boundary remains clear.

ijma-nafaqah-ist-durch-buch-sunnah-und-k.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: Nafaqah is obligatory by the Book, the Sunnah and consensus
ijma-nafaqah-ist-durch-buch-sunnah-und-k.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qudāmah** explained:

> ***“Ibn Qudāmah said: The Nafaqah of the wife is obligatory by the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and Ijmāʿ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Family fiqh is not mere custom. The rights of the wife belong to the ordered duties of the Sharīʿah.

ijma-riba-ist-durch-quran-sunnah-und-kon.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: Ribā is forbidden by the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and consensus
ijma-riba-ist-durch-quran-sunnah-und-kon.body:
🖋️ **Abū l-Ḥasan al-Māwardī** explained:

> ***“al-Māwardī said: The basis for the prohibition of Ribā is the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and then the Ijmāʿ; the Muslims have agreed upon the prohibition of Ribā.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ribā is not an ordinary point of dispute. Its being forbidden stands by revelation and Ijmāʿ.

ikhlas-allah-sieht-auf-herzen-und-taten-.title: 📖 Allah looks at hearts and deeds
ikhlas-allah-sieht-auf-herzen-und-taten-.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Allah does not look at your forms and your wealth; rather, He looks at your hearts and your deeds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The measure with Allah is not outward appearance, status, or possession. What decides is what is in the heart and what of that shows itself in deeds. The Muslim therefore needs not only visible good works, but also **Ikhlāṣ** and a heart that is purified for **Allah**.

ikhlas-freies-training-absicht-sunnah-20.title: 📖 Ikhlāṣ – When is a deed accepted?
ikhlas-freies-training-absicht-sunnah-20.body:
🖋️ **Al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ** رحمه الله said about Allah’s words:

“That He may test you, which of you does the best deeds.” (Hūd 11:7)

“The **most sincere** and the **most correct** deeds.

If a deed is **sincere** but not correct, it is not accepted.

And if it is **correct** but not sincere, it is likewise not accepted, until it is sincere and correct.

It is sincere when it is done **for Allah**.

And it is correct when it **accords with the Sunnah**.”

🌙 **Conclusion:** A deed needs two basic conditions: **Ikhlāṣ** – the sincere intention for Allah alone – and **conformity with the Sunnah**.

im-himmel-ein-ilah-und-auf-der-erde-ein-.title: 📖 “An Ilāh in the heaven and an Ilāh on the earth”
im-himmel-ein-ilah-und-auf-der-erde-ein-.body:
🖋️ **Qatādah, Mujāhid, and Ibn al-Jawzī** said:

> ***“He is worshipped in the heaven, and He is worshipped on the earth.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Az-Zukhruf 43:84 is a Tawḥīd verse about Ulūhiyyah, not a proof for Ḥulūl or the claim that Allah is with His essence everywhere.

imam-ahmad-gerechtigkeit-haram-nicht-auf.title: 📖 Justice does not mean elevating the Ḥarām
imam-ahmad-gerechtigkeit-haram-nicht-auf.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh b. Aḥmad** asked his father, **Imām Aḥmad**, about a Jewish man who claimed against a Muslim that he had poured out his wine.

> ***“There is no price for wine; the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of wine.”***

Then Imām Aḥmad explained further: if the Muslim poured out the wine, he does not rule that he must replace anything for it. At the same time, Muslims are prevented from harming Ahl adh-Dhimmah or spoiling anything of theirs; if they destroy something of theirs that is not among what Allah has forbidden, they are liable for it.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah join **firmness in the Ḥarām** with **justice in dealings**. In the Islamic ruling, wine remains without a recognized price, but that permits neither arbitrariness nor unjust harm against people.

imam-ahmad-iman-steigt-und-sinkt-282.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Īmān rises and falls
imam-ahmad-iman-steigt-und-sinkt-282.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said: ‘Īmān is word and deed; it rises and falls; when you do good, it rises, and when you neglect, it falls.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Īmān is not only a claim in the heart. It is strengthened by obedience and weakened by sin and neglect.

imam-ahmad-nicht-jeder-darf-fatwa-geben-.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Not everyone may set himself up for Fatwā
imam-ahmad-nicht-jeder-darf-fatwa-geben-.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

***“It is not fitting for a man to set himself up for Fatwā until five qualities are present in him: first, a sincere intention; second, knowledge, mildness, dignity, and calm; third, strength in that wherein he stands and in his knowledge; fourth, sufficient independence — otherwise the people will devour him; fifth, knowledge of people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Not everyone who can speak is suited for Fatwā. Before words come Niyya, ʿIlm, Ḥilm, and Waqār. Whoever speaks in the Dīn needs maturity and sincerity — otherwise he harms more than he benefits.

imam-ahmad-nimm-von-dort-wo-die-imame-na.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Take from where the Imāms took
imam-ahmad-nimm-von-dort-wo-die-imame-na.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said in meaning: ‘Do not follow me blindly, nor Mālik, ash-Shāfiʿī, al-Awzāʿī, or ath-Thawrī; rather, take from where they took.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Imāms did not want a blind attachment to names, but a return to the Qurʾān, the Sunnah, and clean proof.

imam-ahmad-und-tawassul-mit-dem-prophete.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad and Tawassul with the Prophet ﷺ
imam-ahmad-und-tawassul-mit-dem-prophete.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Mufliḥ and Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Aḥmad said in his Manāsik: He makes Tawassul with the Prophet ﷺ in his Duʿāʾ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This passage is not evidence for Duʿāʾ to the Prophet ﷺ or for grave rituals. The permitted meaning is delimited directly by Īmān, obedience, love, Ṣalāh and Salām, as well as by Duʿāʾ and Shafāʿah.

imam-ahmad-witr-anfang-der-nacht-397.title: 📖 Whoever cannot manage the end of the night
imam-ahmad-witr-anfang-der-nacht-397.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh b. Aḥmad asked his father, Imām Aḥmad**, whether he preferred the **Witr prayer** at the beginning of the night or at the end.

***“As for me, I pray Witr at the beginning. But whoever is strong enough to pray it at the end of the night, there is no problem in that.”***

Then he asked him about someone who fears falling asleep. **Imām Aḥmad said:**

***“He prays Witr at the beginning of the night.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** do not act by wishful thinking, but by the **Sunnah, caution, and honest knowledge of one’s own weakness**.

imam-ash-shafii-ueber-tahakum-weniger-al.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī on Taḥākum: less than Shirk
imam-ash-shafii-ueber-tahakum-weniger-al.body:
🖋️ **ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Leaving them upon that which is less than Shirk is all the more fitting, when we leave them upon the greater.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** ash-Shāfiʿī does not treat recourse to judges who judge by other than the truth as a Shirk ritual, but as a Fiqh question concerning Ahl adh-Dhimmah.

imam-ash-shafii-weder-rafidi-noch-kafir-.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī: neither Rāfiḍī nor Kāfir
imam-ash-shafii-weder-rafidi-noch-kafir-.body:
🖋️ **ash-Shāfiʿī, Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, and adh-Dhahabī** said:

> ***“Whoever claims that ash-Shāfiʿī is Shiite is a slanderer and does not know what he is saying.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The accusation against Imām ash-Shāfiʿī collapses: his own statements, the defense of the Imāms, and adh-Dhahabī’s critique refute the false attribution.

imam-ash-shafii-wissen-braucht-geduld-28.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī: knowledge needs patience
imam-ash-shafii-wissen-braucht-geduld-28.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī made clear that knowledge is not attained without patience, scant comfort, and seriousness.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever wants knowledge must detach himself from mere comfort. Knowledge demands time, patience, and a serious heart.

imam-ash-shafii-wissen-ist-das-was-nuetz.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī: knowledge is that which benefits
imam-ash-shafii-wissen-ist-das-was-nuetz.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī said in meaning: Knowledge is not that which is memorized; rather, knowledge is that which benefits.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Knowledge shows its worth through fear of Allah, action, and correction of the heart — not only through the quantity of terms.

imam-shafii-moenche-nicht-gezielt-getoet.title: 📖 Imām aš-Šāfiʿī: monks are not killed deliberately
imam-shafii-moenche-nicht-gezielt-getoet.body:
🖋️ **Imām aš-Šāfiʿī** said in meaning:

> ***The monks in monasteries, hermitages, and remote places are not killed deliberately; everyone who devotes himself to monasticism is left aside from being killed — as a following of Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq, not merely as one’s own analogy.***

This shows an important standard in Siyar-Fiqh: not every person in enemy territory is treated the same. There are legal limits, transmitted practice, and precise distinction.

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Fiqh of Ahlus-Sunnah is bound to the Qurʾān, the Sunnah, and the practice of the Ṣaḥābah. Even in the law of war, limits remain — not anger, chaos, or indiscriminate killing.

imam-shafii-wahrheit-vor-meinung-462.title: 📖 The truth before one’s own opinion
imam-shafii-wahrheit-vor-meinung-462.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** رحمه الله said:

**“I have never debated with anyone except that I wished the truth would appear through his tongue or through my tongue.”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** True seeking of knowledge does not mean letting one’s own opinion win, but that the truth be recognized, even when it becomes visible through the other.

imam-shafii-wasser-wird-durch-veraenderu.title: 📖 When water is changed by impurity
imam-shafii-wasser-wird-durch-veraenderu.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“If the taste, color, or smell of the water changes because of something forbidden that mixes with it, the water does not become pure again until it is drawn out or a large amount of water is poured upon it, so that the taste, color, and smell of the forbidden thing disappear. When this disappears and the water returns to the state in which Allah made it purifying, then its impurity has gone.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** In the Fiqh of Ṭahārah, mere doubt does not count, but a recognizable change. If water is changed by Najāsah in **taste**, **color**, or **smell**, it no longer counts as purifying until this change disappears.

imrar-nicht-tafwid-ibn-qutaybah-131.title: 📖 Imrār is not Tafwīḍ
imrar-nicht-tafwid-ibn-qutaybah-131.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qutaybah** said:

> ***“We did not see the Mufassirūn stop at anything of the Qurʾān and say: This is mutashābih, whose meaning only Allah knows; rather, they let it run completely through Tafsīr, even the disconnected letters.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement of the Salaf ***“let them pass on as they came”*** means **Imrār** with affirmation of what the text states — not **Tafwīḍ** in the sense of a total denial of meaning. What is unknown is the **Kayfiyyah**, not the linguistically understood meaning.

isa-ibn-maryam-nuzul-frueher-ikhtilaf-sl.title: 📖 The Nuzūl of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam – refutation of the metaphorical reading
isa-ibn-maryam-nuzul-frueher-ikhtilaf-sl.body:
<!-- slide: 1 -->
# The Qurʾān: ʿĪsā was not killed

🖋️ Allah تعالى

“They neither killed him nor crucified him … rather, Allah raised him to Himself.”

The Qurʾān expressly denies his killing by his opponents and sets his being raised over against that.

📝 Qurʾān, an-Nisāʾ 4:157–158.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 2 -->
# “Mutawaffīka” does not necessarily mean final death

🖋️ Allah تعالى

“Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those who have not died, during their sleep.”

🖋️ Allah تعالى

“And He is the One Who takes you by night.”

It is already clear from the Qurʾān: the verb tawaffā is not used exclusively for death.

Therefore the claim, “Mutawaffīka in Āl ʿImrān 3:55 can only mean that ʿĪsā has died finally,” is not linguistically compelling.

📝 Qurʾān, az-Zumar 39:42; al-Anʿām 6:60; Āl ʿImrān 3:55.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 3 -->
# The real Ikhtilāf about Āl ʿImrān 3:55

The early Ikhtilāf must not be concealed.

🖋️ ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما

Through ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥah it is transmitted from him about mutawaffīka:

“I cause you to die.”

This report exists and is not denied.

But it does not say: “ʿĪsā will never return.”
It does not say: “The Nuzūl is metaphorical.”
And it does not say: “A man born later from the Ummah is named ʿĪsā ibn Maryam in the Aḥādīṯ.”

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of Āl ʿImrān 3:55.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 4 -->
# Maṭar al-Warrāq and al-Ḥasan on mutawaffīka

🖋️ Maṭar al-Warrāq رحمه الله

“I take you out of this world; not by the taking of death.”

🖋️ Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله

“I take you from the earth.”

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of Āl ʿImrān 3:55.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 5 -->
# Ibn Zayd: Nuzūl before death

🖋️ Ibn Zayd رحمه الله

“Mutawaffīka means: I take you.”

Then he said about ʿĪsā:

“He has not yet died, until he kills the Daǧǧāl; after that he will die.”

Thus the order according to Ibn Zayd is:

He lives → he descends → he kills the Daǧǧāl → after that he dies.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of Āl ʿImrān 3:55.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 6 -->
# Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī: “He is alive now”

🖋️ Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله

About an-Nisāʾ 4:159 he said:

“Before the death of ʿĪsā. By Allah, he is now alive with Allah; when he descends, they will all believe in him.”

From him it is also transmitted at the same place:

“ʿĪsā — and he has not yet died.”

This is not a later theological construction, but the statement of a great Tābiʿī.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of an-Nisāʾ 4:159.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 7 -->
# Ibn ʿAbbās and the Nuzūl

🖋️ ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما

Concerning Allah’s statement:

“And indeed, he is a sign for the Hour”

it is transmitted from him:

“The descent of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam.”

This is decisive: even if the report from Ibn ʿAbbās, “mutawaffīka = I cause you to die,” is accepted, it does not follow that Ibn ʿAbbās denied the Nuzūl.

From him, precisely the descent of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam is transmitted.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of az-Zuḫruf 43:61.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 8 -->
# Qatādah and Muǧāhid on az-Zuḫruf 43:61

🖋️ Qatādah رحمه الله

“The descent of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam is a sign for the Hour.”

🖋️ Muǧāhid رحمه الله

He explained the verse by the appearance of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam before the Day of Resurrection.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of az-Zuḫruf 43:61.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 9 -->
# Aḍ-Ḍaḥḥāk on az-Zuḫruf 43:61

🖋️ Aḍ-Ḍaḥḥāk رحمه الله

He explained it by:

“the appearance of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam and his descent from heaven before the Day of Resurrection.”

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of az-Zuḫruf 43:61.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 10 -->
# The Prophet ﷺ says: “Ibn Maryam”

🖋️ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ

“How will it be with you when the son of Maryam descends among you and your Imām is from among you?”

The Prophet ﷺ did not say:

“a man like ʿĪsā,”
not: “a man with the title ʿĪsā,”
and not: “a Muslim born later who represents ʿĪsā.”

He said:

Ibn Maryam — the son of Maryam.

📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Buḫārī, no. 3449; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, no. 155.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 11 -->
# The Ummah, their Amīr, and ʿĪsā ibn Maryam

🖋️ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ

“A group of my Ummah will continue to fight for the truth …”

Then he said:

“Then ʿĪsā ibn Maryam descends.”

Thereupon their Amīr says to him:

“Come and lead the prayer for us.”

ʿĪsā declines.

The linguistic structure is clear:

my Ummah → their Amīr → then ʿĪsā ibn Maryam descends to them.

The text thus distinguishes between the Ummah that already exists, their leader, and ʿĪsā ibn Maryam.

This contradicts the claim that the announced ʿĪsā is merely a man born later from the same Ummah.

📝 Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, no. 156, from Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 12 -->
# The just judge

🖋️ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ

“By the One in Whose hand is my soul: soon the son of Maryam will descend among you as a just judge. He will break the cross, kill the swine, and abolish the Ǧizyah.”

Again the same one is named expressly:

the son of Maryam.

📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Buḫārī, no. 3448; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, no. 155.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 13 -->
# Al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam — place, angels, and the Daǧǧāl

🖋️ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ

In the long Ḥadīṯ about the Daǧǧāl, the Prophet ﷺ reports that Allah will send:

al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam.

He descends at the white minaret east of Damascus.

His hands rest upon the wings of two angels.

Then he pursues the Daǧǧāl and kills him at the gate of Ludd.

The report names: al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam, a concrete place, angels, his Nuzūl, the Daǧǧāl, his pursuit, and his killing at Ludd.

The text itself gives no indication that “al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam” means another person born later.

📝 Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, no. 2937, from an-Nawwās ibn Samʿān رضي الله عنه.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 14 -->
# Imām aṭ-Ṭabarī — d. 310 H.

🖋️ Imām aṭ-Ṭabarī رحمه الله

After mentioning the differing interpretations of mutawaffīka, he prefers the meaning:

“I take you from the earth and raise you to Me.”

As his reason he cites the reports, transmitted through many routes, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that ʿĪsā ibn Maryam will:

descend and kill the Daǧǧāl,
then remain for a time upon the earth,
and afterwards die.

Thus it already stands firm in 310 H.: the Ikhtilāf about tawaffī was known to aṭ-Ṭabarī. Nevertheless he understood the numerous reports of the Nuzūl as proof of the future personal Nuzūl of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ǧāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr of Āl ʿImrān 3:55.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 15 -->
# Aṭ-Ṭaḥāwī — d. 321 H.

🖋️ Abū Ǧaʿfar aṭ-Ṭaḥāwī

“We believe in the signs of the Hour: in the appearance of the Daǧǧāl and in the descent of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam from heaven.”

Here it stands expressly:

ʿĪsā ibn Maryam → from heaven.

📝 Aṭ-Ṭaḥāwī, al-ʿAqīdah aṭ-Ṭaḥāwiyyah, section on the signs of the Hour.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 16 -->
# Ibn Baṭṭah — d. 387 H.

🖋️ Imām Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī رحمه الله

In his presentation of the foundations upon which, according to his statement, Ahl al-Islām and the Ummah had agreed, Ibn Baṭṭah expressly mentions:

“Then the belief that ʿĪsā ibn Maryam descends from heaven to the earth, breaks the cross, and kills the swine.”

This is an early witness to consensus from the 4th century.

📝 Ibn Baṭṭah, aš-Šarḥ wa-l-Ibānah / al-Ibānah aṣ-Ṣuġrā, pp. 191 and 241 of the edition consulted.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 17 -->
# Abū ʿAmr ad-Dānī — d. 444 H.

🖋️ Imām Abū ʿAmr ad-Dānī رحمه الله

He counts among that which must be believed on the basis of the authentic transmission from the Prophet ﷺ:

“The descent of ʿĪsā.”

He also mentions the breaking of the cross and the killing of the Daǧǧāl.

About an-Nisāʾ 4:159 he explains:

“Before the death of ʿĪsā, when he descends.”

Thus this article of belief is also expressly documented in 444 H.

📝 Abū ʿAmr ad-Dānī, ar-Risālah al-Wāfiyah li-maḏhab Ahl as-Sunnah, nos. 168–169, p. 243.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 18 -->
# The decisive difference

It is factually correct to say:

Among the early Mufassirūn there was Ikhtilāf about the meaning and the temporal placing of tawaffī.

But from this it does not follow:

That among the Salaf there was Ikhtilāf about whether the authentic Nuzūl-Aḥādīṯ meant another man, born later, from the Ummah.

These are two different questions.

📝 Summary of the documented Tafsīr-Ikhtilāf and the Nuzūl-Aḥādīṯ; original references /q/35/.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 19 -->
# Whom the early sources actually name

The early sources speak of:

ʿĪsā ibn Maryam.
Al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam.
The son of Maryam.
His descent from heaven.
His meeting the Ummah that already exists.
The Amīr of this Ummah, already present.
His killing of the Daǧǧāl.
And his later death.

For the claim:

“The announced ʿĪsā ibn Maryam is merely another human being, born later in the Ummah, and called ʿĪsā only metaphorically”

no corresponding proof from the Ṣaḥābah, the Tābiʿīn, or the named Imāms up to the 5th century is found in these early texts.

📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Buḫārī 3448–3449; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 155–156, 2937; aṭ-Ṭabarī on 3:55 and 43:61; aṭ-Ṭaḥāwī; Ibn Baṭṭah; ad-Dānī.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

<!-- slide: 20 -->
# Conclusion: the personal Nuzūl

The early Ikhtilāf about mutawaffīka is real and must not be concealed. It does not, however, concern the identity of the ʿĪsā ibn Maryam named in the authentic Nuzūl-Aḥādīṯ.

The Sunnah expressly distinguishes between the Ummah, their Amīr, and ʿĪsā ibn Maryam, who descends to them.

The early texts of Tafsīr and ʿAqīdah confirm the same personal Nuzūl.

A later metaphorical substitute person is not named in these early sources.

📝 Overall conclusion from the Qurʾān, the authentic Sunnah, and the early texts of Tafsīr and ʿAqīdah; direct references /q/35/.

[→ Sources and direct references · Q35](/q/35/)

ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-der-weg-der-fruehen-i.title: 📖 Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh: the way of the early Imāms is the Book and the Sunnah
ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-der-weg-der-fruehen-i.body:
🖋️ **Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh** said:

> ***“Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim named the way of the Imāms, such as ash-Shāfiʿī, Aḥmad, Isḥāq, and Abū ʿUbayd: holding fast to the Book and the Sunnah and to the people of the Athar.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The name of an Imām counts only when his way is understood: the Book, the Sunnah, the Athār, and no innovation in the Dīn.

ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-die-sunnah-wird-nicht.title: 📖 Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh: the Sunnah is not abandoned
ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-die-sunnah-wird-nicht.body:
🖋️ **Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh** said:

> ***“Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh was among the Imāms whose way was holding fast to the Sunnah and to the Athār.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Manhaj is not merely a word. It shows itself in that the Sunnah and the Athār are placed above mere opinions.

ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-ruyah-allahs-ist-wahr.title: 📖 Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh: The Ruʾyah of Allah is truth
ishaq-ibn-rahawayh-ruyah-allahs-ist-wahr.body:
🖋️ **Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh** said:

> ***“Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh affirmed the reports about the Ruʾyah of Allah in the Hereafter and held firmly to them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The believers will see Allah in the Hereafter. This truth is affirmed without determining the how.

iyas-reine-herzen-wenig-ghibah-546.title: 📖 The best have pure hearts and little Ghībah
iyas-reine-herzen-wenig-ghibah-546.body:
🖋️ **Iyās b. Muʿāwiyah** transmitted from his father:

> ***“The best among them — that is, among the earlier people — were those with the purest breast and the least Ghībah (backbiting).”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **A pure heart and a guarded tongue** are signs of true maturity in the Dīn. Whoever speaks little about others and cleanses his breast of rancor carries a quiet but weighty form of Taqwā.

jahannam-wird-durch-begierden-leicht-gem.title: 📖 Jahannam is made easy by desires
jahannam-wird-durch-begierden-leicht-gem.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The Fire is surrounded by desires.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not everything the soul loves leads to good. Desires can be a beautiful door behind which ruin waits.

jannah-ist-hinter-dingen-die-der-nafs-sc.title: 📖 Jannah lies behind what is hard for the Nafs
jannah-ist-hinter-dingen-die-der-nafs-sc.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Jannah is surrounded by what is unpleasant, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The path to Jannah requires struggle against the Nafs and desire. The ease of sin must not be confused with a good end.

jeder-ist-hirte-und-verantwortlich-180.title: 📖 Each one is a shepherd and responsible
jeder-ist-hirte-und-verantwortlich-180.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you will be asked about his flock.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah is responsibility, not only feeling. Parents and those in charge will be asked about protection, religion, and care.

kein-schaden-und-kein-gegenschaden-194.title: 📖 No harm and no harm in return
kein-schaden-und-kein-gegenschaden-194.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“There is no harming and no harming in return.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab is not only kindness, but also refraining from harm.

keine-gegenseitige-abwendung-und-kein-ha.title: 📖 No mutual turning away and no hatred
keine-gegenseitige-abwendung-und-kein-ha.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Do not hate one another, do not envy one another, and do not turn away from one another; be servants of Allah as brothers.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Brotherhood needs purification from hatred, envy, and coldness. A heart full of rancor cannot carry community.

keine-tiyarah-001.title: 📖 No place for superstition
keine-tiyarah-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“He is not of us who practices superstition or for whom superstition is practiced.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Tawakkul** does not go together with superstition. Whoever binds his heart to **Allah** seeks no omens, fortune-tellers, or dark paths.

kinder-frueh-an-alah-gewoehnen-181.title: 📖 Accustom children to Ṣalāh early
kinder-frueh-an-alah-gewoehnen-181.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Command your children to prayer when they are seven years old.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah does not wait until habits have hardened. Children are accustomed early, lovingly and seriously, to the worship of Allah.

liebe-fuer-deinen-bruder-was-du-fuer-dic.title: 📖 Love for your brother what you love for yourself
liebe-fuer-deinen-bruder-was-du-fuer-dic.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“None of you believes perfectly until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Akhlāq begins with a person not making his ego the measure against others.

liebe-und-hass-mussen-fur-allah-gebunden.title: 📖 Love and hate must be bound for Allah
liebe-und-hass-mussen-fur-allah-gebunden.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The firmest handhold of Īmān is love for the sake of Allah and hate for the sake of Allah.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Love in the Dīn does not follow mere sympathy. It is ordered by Allah’s measure.

liebe-zum-propheten-gehort-zum-iman-231.title: 📖 Love of the Prophet ﷺ belongs to Īmān
liebe-zum-propheten-gehort-zum-iman-231.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘None of you believes completely until I am more beloved to him than his father, his child, and all people.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Love of the Prophet ﷺ is not only feeling. It shows itself in obedience, the Sunnah, and the priority of his way over every other way.

mahdi-bayah-makkah-nicht-istanbul-138.title: 📖 The Bayʿah of the Mahdī is in Makkah
mahdi-bayah-makkah-nicht-istanbul-138.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Bayʿah will be given to a man between the Rukn and the Maqām.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The strongest place-related texts speak of the **Bayʿah in Makkah** – between the **Rukn** and the **Maqām**. Constantinople appears in authentic end-time Aḥādīth as a conquest event, but not as the place where the Mahdī “appears”. Whoever speaks about this without proof leaves the measure of the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

makan-abdullah-ahmad-jahmiyyah-nicht-ueb.title: 📖 Allah is above the Throne – not everywhere
makan-abdullah-ahmad-jahmiyyah-nicht-ueb.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** refuted the Jahmiyyah, who denied that Allah is above the Throne, and cited verses such as **﴿الرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَى﴾** and **﴿ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾**.

***“Allah is above the seven heavens, above His Throne, separate from His creation.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation:** The statement is directed against the claim of the Jahmiyyah that Allah is everywhere. Ahlus-Sunnah, by contrast, affirm **Istiwāʾ**, **ʿUluww**, and separation from the creation, without comparing Allah to created beings.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Allah is above His Throne, not within the creation. Whoever claims “Allah is everywhere” with respect to His essence contradicts the way of the Salaf.

makan-fudayl-ibn-iyad-rabb-yafal-ma-yash.title: 📖 I believe in a Lord who does what He wills
makan-fudayl-ibn-iyad-rabb-yafal-ma-yash.body:
🖋️ **al-Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ** said:

***“If a Jahmī says to you: I deny a Lord who leaves His place, then say: I believe in a Lord who does what He wills.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation:** al-Fuḍayl does not refute the Nuzūl, but the false objection of the Jahmiyyah. Ahlus-Sunnah affirms what Allah and His Messenger ﷺ reported, without Tahrīf, Taʿṭīl, Takyīf, or Tamthīl.
