🌙 **Conclusion:** The strongest daily dhikr is the one that renews **Tawḥīd**.

tawhid-088-tawhid-und-kufr-an-falscher-a.title: 📖 Tawḥīd requires rejection of false worship
tawhid-088-tawhid-und-kufr-an-falscher-a.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever says **Lā ilāha illa Allah** and rejects what is worshipped besides Allah — his blood and his wealth are protected, and his reckoning lies with Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Lā ilāha illa Allah comprises **affirmation for Allah** and **rejection of false worship**.

tawhid-340-der-sinn-der-schoepfung-ist-i.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: The purpose of creation is ʿIbādah
tawhid-340-der-sinn-der-schoepfung-ist-i.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās** said:

> ***“Ibn ʿAbbās explained in substance: Every ʿIbādah in the Qurʾān is Tawḥīd.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tawḥīd is not only knowing that Allah creates. Tawḥīd means singling out Allah alone with every form of ʿIbādah.

tawhid-341-allah-allein-wird-angebetet.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: Allah alone is worshipped
tawhid-341-allah-allein-wird-angebetet.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī** said:

> ***“aṭ-Ṭabarī explained regarding ‘so that they worship Me’: They were created for the worship of Allah and submission to His command.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The way of the Salaf binds Tawḥīd to ʿIbādah, humility, and obedience toward Allah — not to mere theory.

tawhid-342-nur-dich-beten-wir-an.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: You alone we worship
tawhid-342-nur-dich-beten-wir-an.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that the Fātiḥah points to the Ikhlāṣ of ʿIbādah and to Tawḥīd al-Ulūhiyyah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Fātiḥah teaches Tawḥīd daily: worship and the seeking of help are devoted to Allah alone.

tawhid-343-die-mushrikun-verstanden-die-.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: The Mushrikūn understood the meaning of one God
tawhid-343-die-mushrikun-verstanden-die-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr mentioned, regarding ‘Has he made the gods into one single God?’, the astonishment of the Mushrikūn at the uniting of ʿIbādah for Allah alone.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Mushrikūn knew that Tawḥīd overthrows the false gods. Therefore Tawḥīd is more than a general belief in a Creator.

tawhid-344-dua-ist-ibadah.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: Duʿāʾ is ʿIbādah
tawhid-344-dua-ist-ibadah.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Duʿāʾ is ʿIbādah.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever understands Duʿāʾ as ʿIbādah recognizes this: supplications to the dead, to angels, or to other creatures do not belong to Tawḥīd.

tawhid-345-fuersprecher-werden-nicht-ang.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: Intercessors are not worshipped
tawhid-345-fuersprecher-werden-nicht-ang.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that the Mushrikūn took their idols as intercessors, although these neither harm nor benefit.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Shafāʿah is true, but it is not sought through the worship of others. It belongs to Allah and occurs only with His permission.

tawhid-346-naehe-zu-allah-wird-nicht-ueb.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: Nearness to Allah is not sought through idols
tawhid-346-naehe-zu-allah-wird-nicht-ueb.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that the Mushrikūn said: We worship them only so that they bring us nearer to Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tawḥīd rejects every ʿIbādah directed to intermediaries. Nearness to Allah is sought through Ikhlāṣ, the Sunnah, and obedience.

tawhid-347-millah-ibrahim-ist-lossagung-.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: The millah of Ibrāhīm is disavowal of Shirk
tawhid-347-millah-ibrahim-ist-lossagung-.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibrāhīm disavowed what his people worshipped — except the One Who created him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tawḥīd contains affirmation and negation: to worship Allah alone and to disavow Shirk and its paths.

tawhid-348-allah-liebt-ikhlas-in-der-iba.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: Allah loves Ikhlāṣ in ʿIbādah
tawhid-348-allah-liebt-ikhlas-in-der-iba.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that Allah commanded people to devote the Dīn sincerely to Him alone.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ikhlāṣ is the soul of Tawḥīd. ʿIbādah is not divided between Allah and creatures.

tawhid-349-keine-ibadah-neben-allah.title: 📖 Tawḥīd: No ʿIbādah besides Allah
tawhid-349-keine-ibadah-neben-allah.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī** said:

> ***“aṭ-Ṭabarī explained, regarding ‘Your Lord has decreed that you worship none except Him,’ that Allah commanded that ʿIbādah be devoted to Him alone.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The foundation of Tawḥīd is clear: no ʿIbādah for angels, prophets, the dead, saints, graves, or any creature.

tawhid-iman-akhlaq-ein-din-480.title: 📖 Tawḥīd, Īmān, and Akhlāq — one Dīn
tawhid-iman-akhlaq-ein-din-480.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās** رضي الله عنهما explained in substance regarding Sūrah an-Naḥl (16:90):

By **justice** is meant the confession that *there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah*, and by **Iḥsān** the fulfillment of the duties.

🖋️ **Qatādah** رحمه الله said in substance about the same verse:

There was no **good trait of character** which the people of the Ǧāhiliyyah cultivated and valued, except that Allah commanded it, and no **bad trait of character** which they reproached in one another, except that He forbade it.

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Tawḥīd is the foundation**, *Īmān requires obedience*, and **Akhlāq shows itself in action.** The Dīn unites faith and deeds.

tazkiyyah-beginnt-mit-rechenschaft-224.title: 📖 Tazkiyyah begins with self-reckoning
tazkiyyah-beginnt-mit-rechenschaft-224.body:
🖋️ **ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb** said:

> ***“ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: ‘Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever examines his heart now is not surprised by his own state. Tazkiyyah is daily vigilance before Allah.

tazkiyyah-ist-nicht-selbstlob-225.title: 📖 Tazkiyyah Is Not Self-Praise
tazkiyyah-ist-nicht-selbstlob-225.body:
🖋️ **al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** said:

> ***“al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī said: ‘Only a believer fears Nifāq, and only a hypocrite feels safe from it.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A living heart does not make itself safe. It fears deviation without despairing of Allah’s mercy.

ubayy-sunnah-besser-als-uebertreibung-39.title: 📖 Ubayy ibn Kaʿb: A Little upon the Sunnah Is Better
ubayy-sunnah-besser-als-uebertreibung-39.body:
🖋️ **Ubayy ibn Kaʿb** said:

***“Hold to the **path** and the **Sunnah**. For moderation upon the path of Allāh and His Sunnah is better than exertion against the path of Allāh and His Sunnah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every intense effort is accepted. The worth of a deed lies in its standing upon the **Sunnah**, ***sincerity***, and the path of the prophets — not in mere quantity or harshness.

umar-ibn-abd-al-aziz-wahre-taqwa-2026100.title: 📖 True Taqwā — More Than Fasting and the Night Prayer
umar-ibn-abd-al-aziz-wahre-taqwa-2026100.body:
🖋️ **ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz** رحمه الله is attributed the following saying:

“**Taqwā toward Allah** does not consist in fasting by day and praying at night while committing faults in between.

Rather, Taqwā toward Allah consists in **leaving what Allah has forbidden** and **fulfilling what Allah has made obligatory**.

Whoever is granted further good beyond that, for him it is good added to further good.”


🌙 **Conclusion:** **True Taqwā** is not shown in many voluntary acts of worship alone, but above all in **avoiding Allah’s prohibitions and fulfilling His obligations**. Voluntary deeds are a valuable addition — no substitute for obedience.

umar-qiyas-gueltig-wenn-kein-text-430.title: 📖 What Is Qiyās — and When Is It Valid at All?
umar-qiyas-gueltig-wenn-kein-text-430.body:
🖋️ **ʿUmar b. al-Ḫaṭṭāb** رضي الله عنه wrote in substance:

***“When something comes before you that stands expressly neither in the Qurʾān nor in the Sunnah, then compare the matters, recognize the similarities, and judge by what Allāh loves most and what comes nearest to what is right.”***

Qiyās does not mean that one places one’s own opinion above the text. It is used only when there is no direct text for the specific case. Then the case is compared with similar known cases, so that the ruling stays nearest to the Qurʾān, the Sunnah, and what is right.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Qiyās is serving — not ruling. It is used only when the Qurʾān and the Sunnah name no direct text for the specific case. Then one decides by comparison and by a derivation guided by knowledge, without overruling the text.

usul-des-manhaj-ahl-al-ahwa-nicht-das-he.title: 📖 Uṣūl of the Manhaj: Do Not Open the Heart to Ahl al-Ahwāʾ
usul-des-manhaj-ahl-al-ahwa-nicht-das-he.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“Ibn Sīrīn refused that people of desires recite an Āyah to him, and said in substance: Either you stand up or I stand up.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every recitation of the Qurʾān is guidance when a false interpretation carries it. The heart is protected by clear boundaries.

usul-des-manhaj-beweis-vor-meinung-244.title: 📖 Uṣūl of the Manhaj: Proof before Opinion
usul-des-manhaj-beweis-vor-meinung-244.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“ash-Shāfiʿī explained that Allah has made following His Messenger ﷺ obligatory upon people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Manhaj begins by placing the proof above opinion, taste, group, and person.

usul-des-manhaj-nicht-jede-schoene-tat-i.title: 📖 Uṣūl of the Manhaj: Not Every Beautiful Deed Is Sunnah
usul-des-manhaj-nicht-jede-schoene-tat-i.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“Ibn Masʿūd said to people who wanted good: ‘How many want good but do not attain it.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A good intention does not save an innovation. The scale is not feeling, but the Sunnah and transmission.

verwandtschaftspflege-bringt-barakah-185.title: 📖 Maintaining Kinship Brings Barakah
verwandtschaftspflege-bringt-barakah-185.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Whoever wants his provision to be expanded and his trace to be lengthened, let him maintain his kinship.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ṣilat ar-Raḥim is not only family culture, but Dīn and a cause of Barakah.

vollkommener-iman-zeigt-sich-im-charakte.title: 📖 Perfect Īmān Shows Itself in Character
vollkommener-iman-zeigt-sich-im-charakte.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The most complete of the believers in Īmān are those of the best character.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Akhlāq (character) is not a side topic. Beautiful conduct is a visible sign of the strength of Īmān.

wahre-staerke-ist-kontrolle-bei-zorn-173.title: 📖 True Strength Is Self-Control in Anger
wahre-staerke-ist-kontrolle-bei-zorn-173.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“The strong one is not the wrestler; the strong one is he who controls himself when angry.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Training of the heart begins where the ego boils. Whoever restrains himself in anger possesses a strength that many do not see.

wahrer-iman-zeigt-sich-in-den-taten-452.title: 📖 True Īmān Shows Itself in Deeds
wahrer-iman-zeigt-sich-in-den-taten-452.body:
🖋️ **al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله said:**

***“Īmān does not consist in outward adornment, nor in mere wishful thinking. Īmān is rather what settles in the heart and is confirmed by deed.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Īmān is not a mere claim and not an outward show. What truly resides in the heart shows its effect in obedience and in righteous deeds.

wahrer-zuhd-ist-zu-lassen-was-der-akhira.title: 📖 True Zuhd Is to Leave What Does Not Benefit the Ākhirah
wahrer-zuhd-ist-zu-lassen-was-der-akhira.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah said in substance: Zuhd is to leave what does not benefit in the Ākhirah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Zuhd does not mean throwing away everything worldly, but freeing the heart and one’s time from what brings no benefit before Allah.

wahrhaftigkeit-fuehrt-zum-paradies-174.title: 📖 Truthfulness Leads to Paradise
wahrhaftigkeit-fuehrt-zum-paradies-174.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Truth is Tarbiyyah for the inner self. Whoever accustoms himself to truth is led by it onto a path that in the end points to Paradise.

was-ist-wirkliche-ueble-nachrede-190.title: 📖 What Is Real Backbiting?
was-ist-wirkliche-ueble-nachrede-190.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Ghibah is that you mention your brother with what he dislikes.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every true statement is permitted. When truth becomes exposure, the tongue needs fear of Allah.

wer-barmherzig-ist-dem-wird-barmherzigke.title: 📖 Whoever Is Merciful Is Shown Mercy
wer-barmherzig-ist-dem-wird-barmherzigke.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“The Most Merciful shows mercy to those who are merciful. Show mercy to those on the earth, and the One in heaven will show mercy to you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Mercy is not a mere emotion. It is a path by which Allah’s mercy is hoped for.

wer-die-kleinen-nicht-erbarmt-und-die-gr.title: 📖 Whoever Does Not Show Mercy to the Young nor Respect the Elders
wer-die-kleinen-nicht-erbarmt-und-die-gr.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“He is not of us who does not show mercy to our young and does not recognize the right of our elders.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah joins gentleness toward the young with respect for the elders. Both together preserve the order of the community.

wer-gutes-zeigt-bekommt-anteil-am-lohn-1.title: 📖 Whoever Points to Good Receives a Share of the Reward
wer-gutes-zeigt-bekommt-anteil-am-lohn-1.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Whoever points to something good receives the same reward as the one who does it.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah also takes place through pointing and reminder. A single good word can open doors to ongoing reward.

wer-seine-zunge-bewahrt-dem-wird-paradie.title: 📖 Whoever Guards His Tongue Is Promised Paradise
wer-seine-zunge-bewahrt-dem-wird-paradie.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and what is between his legs, I guarantee him Paradise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever guards speech and desire protects two immense entrances to sin.

wer-sich-aus-unnotigem-zuruckhalt-222.title: 📖 Whoever Holds Back from What Is Unnecessary
wer-sich-aus-unnotigem-zuruckhalt-222.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Part of a person’s beautiful Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Adab begins by not entering every matter, not speaking every word, and not making every distraction one’s own affair.

wiederhole-nicht-den-zorn-188.title: 📖 Do Not Repeat the Anger
wiederhole-nicht-den-zorn-188.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Do not get angry.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Many faults begin not with a lack of knowledge, but with unrestrained anger. Therefore the heart needs training before the reaction.

wissen-muss-im-verhalten-sichtbar-werden.title: 📖 Knowledge Must Become Visible in Conduct
wissen-muss-im-verhalten-sichtbar-werden.body:
🖋️ **Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī said:**
***“In earlier times a man sought knowledge, and soon its effect was seen in his humility, his way of life, his tongue, his gaze, and his hand.”***
This statement shows that true **knowledge** is not recognized only by many words, books, or discussions. Its effect must become visible in **character**, in the way of life, and in a person’s deeds.
Whoever truly learns becomes **more humble**, more careful with his tongue, and more restrained with his gaze and his hands.
Knowledge should not make a person more arrogant and quarrelsome, but lead him to more **fear of Allah, dignity, and good conduct**.
The Salaf regarded knowledge as **education of the whole person**. The conduct of one who knows should testify that what was learned reached his heart and changed him.
🌙 **Conclusion:** True **knowledge leaves visible traces**. It reins in the tongue, guards the gaze, improves deeds, and beautifies character. If conduct remains unchanged, a person must examine what benefit his knowledge has actually brought him.

ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum-001.title: 📖 Calling upon Allah in Grief
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said in distress:

> ***“Yā Ḥayyu, Yā Qayyūm, through Your mercy I seek help.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The believer directs his heart in grief to **Allah**, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer. True help begins with ***Istighāthah with Allah***.

yahya-bin-main-ayat-al-kursi-im-haus-409.title: Āyat al-Kursī in the House
yahya-bin-main-ayat-al-kursi-im-haus-409.body:
🖋️ **Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn** said:

***“When I entered my house at night, I recited Āyat al-Kursī over my house and my family five times. While I was reciting, something spoke to me: ‘How often do you recite that? As if no other person could recite properly!’ Then I said: ‘I see that this bothers you. By Allah, I will increase it.’ After that I recited it fifty or sixty times in the night.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever notices that **Dhikr** disturbs the enemy of Allah should not lessen it, but **increase** it. The heart and the house are not protected by empty words, but by the **Qurʾān**, by **constancy**, and by trust in **Allah**.

yahya-bin-main-dunya-kein-ort-der-ruhe-4.title: 📖 The Dunyā Is Not a Place of Rest
yahya-bin-main-dunya-kein-ort-der-ruhe-4.body:
🖋️ **Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn** said:

***“The Dunyā is a house of unpleasant things and deaths.”***

The Dunyā is not a place of lasting rest. Whoever recognizes it as a trial does not attach his heart to it, but takes from it only what brings him to **Allah**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Dunyā is not a place upon which one builds one’s heart. Whoever recognizes it as a trial does not seek his rest in it, but with **Allah** and in the Hereafter.

yahya-bin-main-dunya-nichts-wenn-fuer-al.title: 📖 Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn: The Dunyā Is Nothing When You Are Free for Allah
yahya-bin-main-dunya-nichts-wenn-fuer-al.body:
🖋️ **Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn** said to Ibn al-Junayd, when he had neither child nor wife:

> ***“What then holds you here? Go to the Thaghr or cast yourself upon those coasts, for the Dunyā is nothing.”***

What is meant is not aimless danger, but an education of the heart: whoever has fewer ties should not lose his free time in idleness.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever has been made free for **Allah** should not give that freedom away to the Dunyā. True strength is to fill the short lifetime with benefit, Taqwā, and serious effort.

yazid-harun-fitrah-istiwa-jahmiyyah-428.title: 📖 The Fitrah of the Muslims concerning Allah’s Exaltation above the Throne
yazid-harun-fitrah-istiwa-jahmiyyah-428.body:
🖋️ **Yazīd ibn Hārūn** (رحمه الله, died 206 H) was asked: **“Who are the Jahmiyyah?”**

He said:

> ***“Whoever claims that the Most Merciful’s rising above the Throne stands contrary to what is anchored in the hearts of the general body of the Muslims is a Jahmī.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The early imams did not criticize a mere choice of words, but the **reinterpretation of the Istiwaʾ** against the plain sense of the revelation. The way of the Salaf is affirmation of what Allah has revealed about Himself — **without Taḥrīf**, **without Taʿṭīl**, **without Takyīf**, and **without Tamthīl**.

yusuf-hatte-echte-muhakamah-kein-nur-dia.title: 📖 Yūsuf Had a Real Muḥākamah — Not “Only Dialogue”
yusuf-hatte-echte-muhakamah-kein-nur-dia.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī, Ibn Kathīr, and Ibn al-ʿArabī** said:

> ***“The king said: Bring them to me. Then he asked: What was your affair when you sought to seduce Yūsuf?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Qurʾān scene contains a summons, questioning, testimony, confession, and exoneration. It is not mere chatter, but a worldly clarification of the accusation.

yusufs-brueder-verteidigten-sich-vor-ein.title: 📖 Yūsuf’s Brothers Defended Themselves before a Foreign System
yusufs-brueder-verteidigten-sich-vor-ein.body:
🖋️ **Yūsuf’s brothers and al-Bukhārī** said:

> ***“By Allah, you know well: we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we are not thieves.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Mere defense against an accusation is not automatically Kufr or Shirk. It is not the same as worship, nor as legitimizing a foreign legal system.

zuflucht-bei-allah-001.title: 📖 Refuge with Allah
zuflucht-bei-allah-001.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever alights at a place and says: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created — nothing harms him until he leaves that place.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Protection does not lie in superstition or signs, but in ***refuge with Allah*** and in the words that were authentically transmitted.

zuhd-409.title: 📖 Ibn al-Mubārak: A Time in Which Duʿāʾ for the General Public Is Not Answered
zuhd-409.body:
🖋️ **From Ibn al-Mubārak** it is transmitted with a weak chain:

***“A time will come upon the people in which a man supplicates for the general public. Then Allah says: Supplicate for your particular affairs, and I will answer you; but as for the general public, no, for I am angry with them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This report is **weak** because of its chain and is therefore mentioned only as an admonition from the works of Zuhd. It is not a direct proof for Takfīr bil-ʿUmūm, but a warning against collective corruption and Allah’s anger over widespread sins.

ibn-abbas-mutter-wahltun-20261031-q49.title: 📖 The special standing of the mother
ibn-abbas-mutter-wahltun-20261031-q49.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās (may Allah be pleased with them both)**

I know of no deed that brings a person nearer to Allah than being dutiful to one's mother.

🌙 Conclusion: A believer should honour and care for his mother without neglecting his father's rights.

dieses-wissen-ist-religion-isnad-2026110.title: 📖 THIS KNOWLEDGE IS RELIGION
dieses-wissen-ist-religion-isnad-2026110.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn (may Allah have mercy on him)**

Indeed, this knowledge is religion, so consider carefully from whom you take your religion.

🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak (may Allah have mercy on him)**

The chain of transmission is part of religion. Without it, anyone could say whatever they wished.

🌙 Conclusion: Religious knowledge is not accepted merely because a speaker is well known: the source, its chain and the actual wording require verification.

qatadah-tawhid-schoepfer-anbetung-202611.title: 📖 ACKNOWLEDGING THE CREATOR ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH
qatadah-tawhid-schoepfer-anbetung-202611.body:
🖋️ **Qatādah ibn Diʿāmah (raḥimahullāh)**

You know that Allah created you and created the heavens and the earth, yet you set up equals beside Him.

🖋️ **Qatādah ibn Diʿāmah (raḥimahullāh)**

The word 'equals' means counterparts. [Contextual rendering]

🌙 Conclusion: Tawḥīd requires more than acknowledging Allah as Creator: worship must be directed to Him alone without partners.

mujahid-ungehorsam-trotz-wissens-2026111.title: 📖 Disobedience despite knowing
mujahid-ungehorsam-trotz-wissens-2026111.body:
🖋️ ****

Everyone who disobeys his Lord is ignorant until he gives up his disobedience.

🌙 Conclusion: Beneficial knowledge should be visible in obedience. Whoever falls into sin should repent and turn back.

mujahid-scham-hochmut-wissen-20261118-q5.title: 📖 SHYNESS AND ARROGANCE CAN PREVENT LEARNING
mujahid-scham-hochmut-wissen-20261118-q5.body:
🖋️ ****

Knowledge is not learned by someone held back by shyness, nor by someone who is arrogant.

🌙 Conclusion: Ask respectfully when you do not understand, and accept the truth with humility.

hafsah-bint-sirin-jugend-handeln-2026112.title: 📖 YOUTH IS THE TIME FOR ACTION
hafsah-bint-sirin-jugend-handeln-2026112.body:
🖋️ **Ḥafṣah bint Sīrīn · woman of the Tābiʿīn**

“Young people, act! For the time for action is youth.”

🌙 Conclusion: Do not continually postpone obedience to Allah. Make good use of youth before the opportunity passes.

abu-umamah-ikhlas-an-nasai-3140-20261121.title: 📖 ALLAH ACCEPTS ONLY DEEDS DONE SINCERELY FOR HIM
abu-umamah-ikhlas-an-nasai-3140-20261121.body:
🖋️ **Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī (Companion) narrated from the Prophet ﷺ**

Indeed, Allah accepts only those deeds that are done sincerely for Him and in pursuit of His Face.

🌙 Conclusion: Examine your intention in good deeds: seek Allah’s pleasure rather than praise and fame.

ibn-masud-religion-schmeichelei-20261124.title: 📖 When a man loses his religion
ibn-masud-religion-schmeichelei-20261124.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd**

A man leaves his house with his religion and returns with none of it left. He goes to a man who has no power to harm or benefit him or himself, and swears by Allah to him, ‘You are such and such!’ He returns having obtained nothing of his need and having incurred Allah’s displeasure.

🌙 Conclusion: Do not sacrifice your religion for human approval.

umar-liebe-hass-gerechtigkeit-20261124-q.title: 📖 Do not let love and hatred blind you
umar-liebe-hass-gerechtigkeit-20261124-q.body:
🖋️ **ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb**

Do not let your love become infatuation or your hatred destruction. I asked, ‘How is that?’ He said, ‘When you love, you become infatuated like a child; when you hate, you wish destruction upon your companion.’

🌙 Conclusion: Remain just even when your feelings pull you elsewhere.

mutarrif-fitnah-religion-20261125-q66-49.title: 📖 The danger of fitnah
mutarrif-fitnah-religion-20261125-q66-49.body:
🖋️ **Muṭarrif ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn ash-Shikhkhīr**

Indeed, fitnah does not come to guide people, but comes to drive the believer away from his religion.

🌙 Conclusion: Preserve your religion and hold to the truth during fitnah.

prophet-hochmut-wahrheit-ablehnen-463.title: 📖 Arrogance is rejecting the truth
prophet-hochmut-wahrheit-ablehnen-463.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ said:**

“Arrogance is rejecting the truth and looking down on people.”

🌙 Conclusion: Whoever knows the truth and rejects it out of ego carries arrogance in the heart.

fudayl-ghibah-ukhuwah-20261107-q53.title: 📖 Backbiting – the hidden poison
fudayl-ghibah-ukhuwah-20261107-q53.body:
🖋️ **Al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ said:**

“When backbiting appears, brotherhood for Allah’s sake disappears. You then become like something plated with gold and silver: inside it is wood, but outside it looks fine.”

🌙 Conclusion: True brotherhood is more than a pleasant appearance. Whoever guards his tongue from backbiting protects his brother’s honour and works on his own soul.

ibn-taymiyyah-muwaddah-kinship-need-2026.title: 📖 Ibn Taymiyyah – worldly affection and the limit of kufr
ibn-taymiyyah-muwaddah-kinship-need-2026.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah:**

“A person may feel affection for them because of kinship or a need. That is then a sin which decreases his faith without making him a disbeliever — as happened with Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿah when he sent the idolaters some news about the Prophet ﷺ.”

🌙 Conclusion: Not every worldly affection is kufr. It can be a sin that lessens faith without taking a person out of Islam.

shafii-hatib-manifest-kufr-20261111.title: 📖 Ash-Shāfiʿī – not every aid is clear kufr
shafii-hatib-manifest-kufr-20261111.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī:**

“Neither exposing a Muslim’s weak point nor aiding a non-Muslim by warning him of a surprise attack planned by the Muslims, so that he can guard himself or strike the Muslims first, is clear kufr.”

🌙 Conclusion: Not every outward aid to a non-Muslim is clear kufr. The ruling depends on the form of the act and its intent.

nawawi-hudaybiyyah-contract-20261111.title: 📖 The treaty of al-Ḥudaybiyyah – omission is not denial
nawawi-hudaybiyyah-contract-20261111.body:
🖋️ **Imām an-Nawawī:**

“Likewise, omitting his description ﷺ as Messenger in this place does not deny his messengership. So there was no harm in what they asked. Harm would have arisen if they had demanded that something forbidden be written, such as glorifying their deities or the like.”

🌙 Conclusion: Leaving out a title in a treaty document is not a denial of the message. Harm would be demanding that something forbidden be written.

dua-001-rabbana-atina.title: Our Lord, grant us good in the Dunyā and the Ākhirah
dua-001-rabbana-atina.meaning: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua-002-sabr-thabbit.title: Duʿāʾ for patience and firm footing
dua-002-sabr-thabbit.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

dua-003-la-tuakhidhna.title: Our Lord, do not take us to account for forgetfulness and mistakes
dua-003-la-tuakhidhna.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and ease
dua-003-la-tuakhidhna.meaning: Our Lord, do not take us to account if we forget or make mistakes.

dua-004-ighfir-dhunubana.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness of sins and firmness
dua-004-ighfir-dhunubana.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, and make our feet firm.

dua-005-faghfir-lana.title: Forgive us and have mercy on us
dua-005-faghfir-lana.occasion: Repentance and a plea for mercy
dua-005-faghfir-lana.meaning: Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

dua-006-rabbi-ighfir-warham.title: My Lord, forgive and have mercy
dua-006-rabbi-ighfir-warham.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

dua-007-qalb-salim.title: Let me come with a sound heart
dua-007-qalb-salim.meaning: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are raised; the Day when neither wealth nor children will benefit, except one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart.

dua-008-hukman-walhiqni.title: Grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous
dua-008-hukman-walhiqni.occasion: A plea for wisdom and a good end
dua-008-hukman-walhiqni.meaning: My Lord, grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous.

dua-009-lisan-sidq.title: Grant me a truthful reputation
dua-009-lisan-sidq.meaning: And grant me a truthful reputation among later generations.

dua-010-jannah-naim.title: Make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss
dua-010-jannah-naim.meaning: And make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss.

dua-011-najji-mina-zalimin.title: Save me from the wrongdoing people
dua-011-najji-mina-zalimin.meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

dua-012-awzini-shukr.title: Guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor
dua-012-awzini-shukr.meaning: My Lord, guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents.

dua-013-amal-salih.title: Guide me to righteous deeds
dua-013-amal-salih.meaning: And that I do righteous deeds with which You are pleased.

dua-014-adkhilni-rahmatik.title: Admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants
dua-014-adkhilni-rahmatik.meaning: And admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.

dua-015-fattah.title: Our Lord, judge between us in truth
dua-015-fattah.occasion: When truth and falsehood stand opposed
dua-015-fattah.meaning: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, and You are the Best of judges.

dua-016-afrigh-sabra-tawaffana.title: Let us die as Muslims
dua-016-afrigh-sabra-tawaffana.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.

dua-017-rahma-ilm.title: Our Lord encompasses all things in mercy and knowledge
dua-017-rahma-ilm.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and protection from the Fire
dua-017-rahma-ilm.meaning: Our Lord, You encompass all things in mercy and knowledge. Forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

dua-018-adkhilhum-jannat-adn.title: Admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn
dua-018-adkhilhum-jannat-adn.occasion: Duʿāʾ for the believers and their families
dua-018-adkhilhum-jannat-adn.meaning: Our Lord, admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn which You have promised them, and the righteous among their fathers, their spouses, and their descendants.

dua-019-qihim-sayyiat.title: Protect them from evil deeds
dua-019-qihim-sayyiat.occasion: Protection from sins and a bad end
dua-019-qihim-sayyiat.meaning: And protect them from evil deeds. Whomever You protect from evil deeds on that Day, him You have had mercy upon.

dua-020-rabbana-ghfir-lana-ikhwan.title: Forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
dua-020-rabbana-ghfir-lana-ikhwan.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

dua-021-la-ghill.title: Leave no rancor in our hearts toward the believers
dua-021-la-ghill.occasion: Purification of the heart toward the Muslims
dua-021-la-ghill.meaning: And place no rancor in our hearts toward those who believe. Our Lord, You are surely Kind and Merciful.

dua-022-tawakkalna-anabna.title: In You we trust and to You we turn
dua-022-tawakkalna-anabna.meaning: Our Lord, in You we place our trust, to You we turn in repentance, and to You is the return.

dua-023-la-tajalna-fitna.title: Do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve
dua-023-la-tajalna-fitna.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord.

dua-024-atmim-nurana.title: Complete our light for us and forgive us
dua-024-atmim-nurana.occasion: A plea for light and forgiveness
dua-024-atmim-nurana.meaning: Our Lord, complete our light for us and forgive us. You surely have power over all things.

dua-025-qunut-witr.title: Duʿāʾ al-Qunūt in the Witr
dua-025-qunut-witr.meaning: O Allāh, guide me among those whom You have guided; grant me well-being among those whom You have granted well-being; and take me into Your care among those whom You have taken into Your care.

dua-026-ya-muqallib.title: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm
dua-026-ya-muqallib.meaning: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

dua-027-allahumma-inni-asaluka-huda.title: Supplication for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment
dua-027-allahumma-inni-asaluka-huda.meaning: O Allāh, I ask You for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment.

dua-028-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-il.title: Protection from knowledge that brings no benefit
dua-028-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-il.occasion: Knowledge and protection of the heart
dua-028-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-il.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that brings no benefit, from a heart that is not humble, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a Duʿāʾ that is not answered.

dua-029-audhu-bika-min-zawal.title: Protection from the vanishing of favor
dua-029-audhu-bika-min-zawal.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the vanishing of Your favor, from the change of Your well-being, from the sudden coming of Your punishment, and from everything that provokes Your anger.

dua-030-audhu-bika-min-jahd.title: Protection from severe trial and an evil fate
dua-030-audhu-bika-min-jahd.occasion: Protection from hardship, misery and gloating
dua-030-audhu-bika-min-jahd.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from severe trial, from reaching misery, from an evil fate, and from the gloating of enemies.

dua-031-rabbana-la-tuzigh-qulubana.title: Duʿāʾ for firm Īmān and mercy
dua-031-rabbana-la-tuzigh-qulubana.occasion: Against the heart turning away after guidance
dua-031-rabbana-la-tuzigh-qulubana.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Giver.

dua-032-rabbi-zidni-ilma.title: Duʿāʾ for more knowledge
dua-032-rabbi-zidni-ilma.occasion: When learning, studying and asking for beneficial knowledge
dua-032-rabbi-zidni-ilma.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

dua-033-rabbana-wa-la-tahmil-alayna-isra.title: Duʿāʾ against a heavy burden
dua-033-rabbana-wa-la-tahmil-alayna-isra.occasion: In overwhelm, strain and heavy responsibility
dua-033-rabbana-wa-la-tahmil-alayna-isra.meaning: Our Lord, do not lay upon us a heavy burden as You laid it upon those before us.

dua-034-rabbana-wa-la-tuhammilna.title: Duʿāʾ for pardon, forgiveness and mercy
dua-034-rabbana-wa-la-tuhammilna.occasion: In weakness, sin and great strain
dua-034-rabbana-wa-la-tuhammilna.meaning: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear; pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us.

dua-035-rabbana-innana-amanna.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness and protection from the Fire
dua-035-rabbana-innana-amanna.occasion: A general plea for forgiveness and salvation
dua-035-rabbana-innana-amanna.meaning: Our Lord, we believe; so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua-036-rabbana-amanna-bima-anzalta.title: Duʿāʾ to be recorded among the witnesses
dua-036-rabbana-amanna-bima-anzalta.occasion: When faith is made firm and revelation is affirmed
dua-036-rabbana-amanna-bima-anzalta.meaning: Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down and we follow the Messenger; so record us among the witnesses.

dua-037-rabbana-ghfir-lana-dhunubana.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness, firmness and victory
dua-037-rabbana-ghfir-lana-dhunubana.occasion: In trial, struggle against one’s own Nafs and steadfastness
dua-037-rabbana-ghfir-lana-dhunubana.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

dua-038-rabbana-ma-khalaqta-hadha-batila.title: Duʿāʾ when reflecting on creation
dua-038-rabbana-ma-khalaqta-hadha-batila.occasion: When reflecting on the heavens, the earth and the signs of Allāh
dua-038-rabbana-ma-khalaqta-hadha-batila.meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua-039-rabbana-innaka-man-tudkhil-an-na.title: Duʿāʾ for rescue from disgrace on the Last Day
dua-039-rabbana-innaka-man-tudkhil-an-na.occasion: In fear of the reckoning and in plea for rescue
dua-039-rabbana-innaka-man-tudkhil-an-na.meaning: Our Lord, whomever You cause to enter the Fire, him You have truly disgraced; and the wrongdoers have no helpers.

dua-040-rabbana-atina-ma-waadtana.title: Duʿāʾ for the fulfillment of the promise
dua-040-rabbana-atina-ma-waadtana.occasion: A plea for Jannah, rescue and no disgrace on the Last Day
dua-040-rabbana-atina-ma-waadtana.meaning: Our Lord, give us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not break the promise.

dua-041-rabbana-zalamna-anfusana-maidah.title: Duʿāʾ after wronging oneself
dua-041-rabbana-zalamna-anfusana-maidah.occasion: In repentance, insight and a plea for mercy
dua-041-rabbana-zalamna-anfusana-maidah.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

dua-042-rabbana-la-tajalna-maal-qawm-az-.title: Duʿāʾ not to be with the wrongdoers
dua-042-rabbana-la-tajalna-maal-qawm-az-.occasion: In fear of bad company, wrongdoing and misguidance
dua-042-rabbana-la-tajalna-maal-qawm-az-.meaning: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

dua-043-rabbi-jalni-muqimas-salati.title: Duʿāʾ for steadfast prayer
dua-043-rabbi-jalni-muqimas-salati.occasion: For regular prayer and righteous offspring
dua-043-rabbi-jalni-muqimas-salati.meaning: My Lord, make me one who performs the prayer, and also from my offspring. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

dua-044-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-li-walidayya.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness for oneself, one’s parents and the believers
dua-044-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-li-walidayya.occasion: For forgiveness on the Day of Reckoning
dua-044-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-li-walidayya.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning takes place.

dua-045-ala-allahi-tawakkalna-rabbana-la.title: Duʿāʾ not to become a trial for the wrongdoers
dua-045-ala-allahi-tawakkalna-rabbana-la.occasion: In distress, oppression and trust in Allāh
dua-045-ala-allahi-tawakkalna-rabbana-la.meaning: In Allāh we place our trust. Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

dua-046-rabbi-inni-audhu-bika-an-asalaka.title: Duʿāʾ not to ask in ignorance
dua-046-rabbi-inni-audhu-bika-an-asalaka.occasion: When one asks Allāh for something whose outcome one does not know
dua-046-rabbi-inni-audhu-bika-an-asalaka.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking You for something of which I have no knowledge. If You do not forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be among the losers.

dua-047-rabbi-qad-ataytani-min-al-mulk.title: Duʿāʾ of Yūsuf for a good ending
dua-047-rabbi-qad-ataytani-min-al-mulk.occasion: In gratitude, success and a plea for a good death
dua-047-rabbi-qad-ataytani-min-al-mulk.meaning: My Lord, You have given me something of sovereignty and taught me something of the interpretation of events. Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my Protector in this world and the Hereafter. Let me die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

dua-048-rabbi-adkhilni-mudkhala-sidq.title: Duʿāʾ for a truthful entrance and exit
dua-048-rabbi-adkhilni-mudkhala-sidq.occasion: At new paths, tasks, journeys or difficult decisions
dua-048-rabbi-adkhilni-mudkhala-sidq.meaning: My Lord, cause me to enter a truthful entrance and to go out a truthful exit, and grant me from Yourself a helping authority.

dua-049-rabbi-shrah-li-sadri.title: Duʿāʾ of Mūsā for ease and clear speech
dua-049-rabbi-shrah-li-sadri.occasion: Before conversations, teaching, Daʿwah, an examination or a difficult task
dua-049-rabbi-shrah-li-sadri.meaning: My Lord, expand my breast for me, make my affair easy for me, and untie the knot from my tongue, so that they understand my words.

dua-050-rabbi-la-tadharni-fardan.title: Duʿāʾ of Zakariyyā for offspring
dua-050-rabbi-la-tadharni-fardan.occasion: When hoping for a child and asking for righteous offspring
dua-050-rabbi-la-tadharni-fardan.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

dua-076-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-liwalidayya.title: Seeking forgiveness for parents and believers
dua-076-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-liwalidayya.occasion: For oneself, one's parents and all believers
dua-076-rabbana-ghfir-li-wa-liwalidayya.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.

dua-077-rabbana-atina-min-ladunka-rahmah.title: Seeking mercy and a right way
dua-077-rabbana-atina-min-ladunka-rahmah.occasion: In distress, difficult decisions and the search for a way out
dua-077-rabbana-atina-min-ladunka-rahmah.meaning: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us a right way in our affair.

dua-078-rabbi-zidni-ilma.title: Seeking an increase in knowledge
dua-078-rabbi-zidni-ilma.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

dua-079-rabbi-audhu-bika-min-hamazati-sh.title: Protection from the whispers of the Shayāṭīn
dua-079-rabbi-audhu-bika-min-hamazati-sh.occasion: At times of whispers, fear and inner unrest
dua-079-rabbi-audhu-bika-min-hamazati-sh.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the Shayāṭīn, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their being present with me.

dua-080-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.title: Supplication for a righteous family
dua-080-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.occasion: For spouses, children and righteous offspring
dua-080-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.meaning: Our Lord, grant us joy of the eyes from our spouses and offspring, and make us examples for the God-fearing.

dua-081-allahumma-ainni-ala-dhikrik.title: Help in remembrance and good worship
dua-081-allahumma-ainni-ala-dhikrik.occasion: At the end of the prayer and in general for good worship
dua-081-allahumma-ainni-ala-dhikrik.meaning: O Allāh, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You in the best way.

dua-082-allahumma-inni-zalamtu-nafsi-kat.title: Comprehensive supplication for forgiveness
dua-082-allahumma-inni-zalamtu-nafsi-kat.occasion: In the prayer and in sincere repentance
dua-082-allahumma-inni-zalamtu-nafsi-kat.meaning: O Allāh, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You. So forgive me with a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. You are indeed the All-Forgiving, the Merciful.

dua-083-allahumma-musarrif-al-qulub.title: Supplication to direct the hearts toward obedience
dua-083-allahumma-musarrif-al-qulub.occasion: For steadfastness and obedience to Allāh
dua-083-allahumma-musarrif-al-qulub.meaning: O Allāh, Turner of hearts, direct our hearts toward obedience to You.

dua-084-allahumma-audhu-min-sharri-ma-am.title: Protection from the evil of one's own deeds
dua-084-allahumma-audhu-min-sharri-ma-am.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not yet done.

dua-085-rabbi-ghfir-li-wa-tub-alayya.title: A short, frequent plea for forgiveness
dua-085-rabbi-ghfir-li-wa-tub-alayya.occasion: For frequent Istighfār in daily life
dua-085-rabbi-ghfir-li-wa-tub-alayya.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are indeed the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

dua-086-allahumma-ihdini-wa-saddidni.title: Seeking right guidance and right action
dua-086-allahumma-ihdini-wa-saddidni.meaning: O Allāh, guide me aright and make me act rightly.

dua-087-sayyid-al-istighfar.title: Sayyid al-Istighfār
dua-087-sayyid-al-istighfar.occasion: To be said in the morning and evening with certainty
dua-087-sayyid-al-istighfar.meaning: O Allāh, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I confess my sin. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

dua-088-allahumma-audhu-min-munkarati-l-.title: Protection from blameworthy character and conduct
dua-088-allahumma-audhu-min-munkarati-l-.occasion: For good character and protection from bad inclinations
dua-088-allahumma-audhu-min-munkarati-l-.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from blameworthy character, blameworthy deeds and blameworthy inclinations.

dua-089-allahumma-audhu-min-al-kufri-wal.title: Protection from Kufr, poverty and the punishment of the grave
dua-089-allahumma-audhu-min-al-kufri-wal.occasion: At the end of the prayer and in the morning and evening
dua-089-allahumma-audhu-min-al-kufri-wal.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from Kufr, poverty and the punishment of the grave.

dua-090-umar-shahadah-madinah.title: Duʿāʾ of ʿUmar for Shahādah
dua-090-umar-shahadah-madinah.occasion: A plea for a good death and Shahādah
dua-090-umar-shahadah-madinah.meaning: O Allāh, grant me martyrdom on Your path and let my death be in the city of Your Messenger ﷺ.

dua-111-adhab-jahannam-qabr-dajjal.title: Protection from the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave and the great trials
dua-111-adhab-jahannam-qabr-dajjal.occasion: After the final Tašahhud and before the Taslīm
dua-111-adhab-jahannam-qabr-dajjal.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of life and of death, and from the evil of the trial of the false Messiah ad-Dajjāl.

dua-112-ighfir-dhanbi-kullahu.title: Comprehensive plea for forgiveness of all sins
dua-112-ighfir-dhanbi-kullahu.meaning: O Allāh, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, and the public and the hidden.

dua-113-audhu-biridaka.title: Seeking refuge in Allāh's pleasure from His wrath
dua-113-audhu-biridaka.occasion: In Suǧūd; also connected with the Witr in authentic reports
dua-113-audhu-biridaka.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath and in Your sparing me from Your punishment. I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot fully enumerate praise of You. You are as You have praised Yourself.

dua-114-ighsil-khatayaya.title: Supplication for purification from all sins
dua-114-ighsil-khatayaya.occasion: As a comprehensive plea for forgiveness and purification
dua-114-ighsil-khatayaya.meaning: O Allāh, wash away my sins with snow-water and hail-water. Purify my heart from sins as You purify the white garment from dirt, and distance me from my sins as You have distanced the east from the west.

dua-115-rabb-jibril-mikail-israfil.title: Seeking guidance amid differences of opinion
dua-115-rabb-jibril-mikail-israfil.occasion: As the opening supplication of the night prayer
dua-115-rabb-jibril-mikail-israfil.meaning: O Allāh, Lord of Jibrīl, Mīkāʾīl and Isrāfīl, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen. You judge between Your servants concerning that over which they differed. Guide me, by Your permission, to the truth in that over which there is disagreement. You guide whom You will to a straight path.

dua-116-laka-aslamtu.title: Duʿāʾ of complete submission and trust
dua-116-laka-aslamtu.occasion: As a comprehensive Duʿāʾ for submission, Tawakkul and protection from being led astray
dua-116-laka-aslamtu.meaning: O Allāh, to You I have submitted, in You I believe, upon You I rely and to You I turn in repentance. With Your help I confront the opponent. O Allāh, I seek refuge in Your might — none has the right to be worshipped except You — from Your letting me go astray. You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while the Jinn and human beings die.

dua-117-la-sahla.title: Supplication for ease in a difficult matter
dua-117-la-sahla.occasion: In difficult tasks, trials and burdensome matters
dua-117-la-sahla.meaning: O Allāh, nothing is easy except what You have made easy. And You make the difficult easy when You will.

dua-051-la-ilaha-illa-anta-subhanaka.title: Duʿāʾ of Yūnus in the darkness
dua-051-la-ilaha-illa-anta-subhanaka.occasion: In distress, constriction, a sense of guilt, and a severe situation
dua-051-la-ilaha-illa-anta-subhanaka.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.

dua-052-rabbi-anzilni-munzalan-mubarakan.title: Duʿāʾ for a blessed arrival
dua-052-rabbi-anzilni-munzalan-mubarakan.occasion: Upon arrival, lodging, moving, or travel
dua-052-rabbi-anzilni-munzalan-mubarakan.meaning: My Lord, let me arrive at a blessed place, and You are the best of those who grant arrival.

dua-053-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.title: Duʿāʾ for joy through the family
dua-053-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.occasion: For marriage, children, and a righteous family
dua-053-rabbana-hab-lana-min-azwajina.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our wives and our offspring joy for the eyes, and make us a model for the God-fearing.

dua-054-rabbana-isrif-anna-adhaba-jahann.title: Duʿāʾ of the servants of ar-Raḥmān against Jahannam
dua-054-rabbana-isrif-anna-adhaba-jahann.occasion: A plea for deliverance from the punishment
dua-054-rabbana-isrif-anna-adhaba-jahann.meaning: Our Lord, turn the punishment of Jahannam away from us; indeed, its punishment is clinging.

dua-055-rabbi-maghlubun-fantasir.title: Duʿāʾ of Nūḥ when overwhelmed
dua-055-rabbi-maghlubun-fantasir.occasion: When one feels overwhelmed and helpless
dua-055-rabbi-maghlubun-fantasir.meaning: My Lord, I am overwhelmed, so help me.

dua-056-rabbana-hab-lana-rahmatan.title: Duʿāʾ of the Companions of the Cave
dua-056-rabbana-hab-lana-rahmatan.occasion: In a severe situation, asking for mercy and right guidance
dua-056-rabbana-hab-lana-rahmatan.meaning: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.

dua-057-rabbi-awzini-an-ashkura.title: Duʿāʾ for gratitude and righteous action
dua-057-rabbi-awzini-an-ashkura.occasion: For gratitude, family, parents, and asking for good deeds
dua-057-rabbi-awzini-an-ashkura.meaning: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to act righteously in a way that pleases You.

dua-058-rabbana-amanna-faktubna.title: Duʿāʾ to be recorded among the witnesses
dua-058-rabbana-amanna-faktubna.occasion: After accepting faith and for firmness
dua-058-rabbana-amanna-faktubna.meaning: Our Lord, we believe, so record us among the witnesses.

dua-059-sayyid-al-istighfar.title: The best supplication for forgiveness
dua-059-sayyid-al-istighfar.occasion: Morning and evening, and as a comprehensive Duʿāʾ of repentance
dua-059-sayyid-al-istighfar.meaning: O Allāh, You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I abide, as far as I am able, by Your covenant and Your promise. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge to You Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

dua-060-rabbi-awzini-ahqaf.title: Duʿāʾ from the age of forty and for righteous offspring
dua-060-rabbi-awzini-ahqaf.occasion: For gratitude, maturity, parents, and children
dua-060-rabbi-awzini-ahqaf.meaning: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to act righteously in a way that pleases You. Make my offspring righteous for me. I repent to You, and I am among the Muslims.

dua-061-ayyub-massaniya-durr.title: Duʿāʾ of Ayyūb in illness and suffering
dua-061-ayyub-massaniya-durr.occasion: In illness, pain, and a severe trial
dua-061-ayyub-massaniya-durr.meaning: Harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

dua-062-rabbi-inni-lima-anzalta.title: Duʿāʾ of Mūsā for the good from Allāh
dua-062-rabbi-inni-lima-anzalta.occasion: In need, for provision, and in a difficult situation
dua-062-rabbi-inni-lima-anzalta.meaning: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

dua-063-rabbi-inni-zalamtu-nafsi.title: Duʿāʾ of Mūsā for forgiveness
dua-063-rabbi-inni-zalamtu-nafsi.occasion: After a sin or a mistake
dua-063-rabbi-inni-zalamtu-nafsi.meaning: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

dua-064-rabbi-hab-li-dhurriyyatan-tayyib.title: Duʿāʾ of Zakariyyā for good offspring
dua-064-rabbi-hab-li-dhurriyyatan-tayyib.occasion: When desiring children and for righteous offspring
dua-064-rabbi-hab-li-dhurriyyatan-tayyib.meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

dua-065-allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-w.title: Plea for forgiveness and well-being
dua-065-allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-w.occasion: Morning and evening, and as a comprehensive daily Duʿāʾ
dua-065-allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-w.meaning: O Allāh, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter.

dua-066-allahumma-aslih-li-dini.title: Plea for the betterment of religion and all affairs
dua-066-allahumma-aslih-li-dini.occasion: As a comprehensive Duʿāʾ for Dīn, Dunyā, and Ākhirah
dua-066-allahumma-aslih-li-dini.meaning: O Allāh, rectify for me my religion, which is the safeguard of my affair. Rectify for me my worldly life, in which my livelihood lies, and rectify for me my Hereafter, to which is my return.

dua-067-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.title: Protection from worry, grief, weakness, and debt
dua-067-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.occasion: In worries, grief, debt, and inner burden
dua-067-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from inability and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overwhelmed by people.

dua-068-allahumma-innaka-afuwwun.title: Duʿāʾ for Allāh’s forgiveness
dua-068-allahumma-innaka-afuwwun.occasion: Especially in Laylat al-Qadr and generally for forgiveness
dua-068-allahumma-innaka-afuwwun.meaning: O Allāh, You are Forgiving and You love forgiveness, so forgive me.

dua-069-rahmataka-arju.title: Duʿāʾ in sorrow and severe distress
dua-069-rahmataka-arju.occasion: In sorrow, being overwhelmed, and difficult affairs
dua-069-rahmataka-arju.meaning: O Allāh, in Your mercy I place my hope. Do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Rectify all my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

dua-070-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.title: Protection from severe illnesses
dua-070-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.occasion: A plea for protection from severe and harmful illnesses
dua-070-allahumma-inni-audhu-bika-min-al.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from leukoderma, madness, leprosy, and from evil diseases.

dua-071-rabbana-taqabbal-minna.title: Plea for the acceptance of deeds
dua-071-rabbana-taqabbal-minna.occasion: After good deeds, worship, and shared work
dua-071-rabbana-taqabbal-minna.meaning: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

dua-072-wajalna-muslimayni-lak.title: Plea for complete submission to Allāh
dua-072-wajalna-muslimayni-lak.occasion: For oneself, the family, and righteous offspring
dua-072-wajalna-muslimayni-lak.meaning: Our Lord, make us submissive to You and, from our offspring, a community submissive to You. Show us our rites of worship and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

dua-073-rabbana-la-tuzigh-qulubana.title: Protection from the heart’s deviation
dua-073-rabbana-la-tuzigh-qulubana.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Ever-Bestowing.

dua-074-rabbana-innaka-jamiu-nnas.title: Affirmation of the resurrection
dua-074-rabbana-innaka-jamiu-nnas.occasion: To strengthen certainty in the Last Day
dua-074-rabbana-innaka-jamiu-nnas.meaning: Our Lord, You will gather the people to a Day in which there is no doubt. Allāh does not break His promise.

dua-075-rabbi-jalni-muqima-s-salah.title: Plea for steadfastness in prayer
dua-075-rabbi-jalni-muqima-s-salah.occasion: For one’s own faithfulness in prayer and for the offspring
dua-075-rabbi-jalni-muqima-s-salah.meaning: My Lord, make me and a portion of my offspring among those who establish the prayer. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

Unser Herr, gib uns im Diesseits Gutes u.title: Our Lord, grant us good in the Dunyā and the Ākhirah
Unser Herr, gib uns im Diesseits Gutes u.meaning: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Unser Herr, gib uns Gutes in Dunyā und Ā.title: Our Lord, grant us good in the Dunyā and the Ākhirah
Unser Herr, gib uns Gutes in Dunyā und Ā.meaning: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Unser Herr, gieße Geduld über uns aus, f.title: Duʿāʾ for patience and firm footing
Unser Herr, gieße Geduld über uns aus, f.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

Duʿāʾ um Geduld und festen Stand.title: Duʿāʾ for patience and firm footing
Duʿāʾ um Geduld und festen Stand.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht zur Rechensch.title: Our Lord, do not take us to account for forgetfulness and mistakes
Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht zur Rechensch.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and ease
Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht zur Rechensch.meaning: Our Lord, do not take us to account if we forget or make mistakes.

Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht für Vergessen.title: Our Lord, do not take us to account for forgetfulness and mistakes
Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht für Vergessen.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and ease
Unser Herr, nimm uns nicht für Vergessen.meaning: Our Lord, do not take us to account if we forget or make mistakes.

Unser Herr, vergib uns unsere Sünden und.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness of sins and firmness
Unser Herr, vergib uns unsere Sünden und.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, and make our feet firm.

Duʿāʾ um Vergebung der Sünden und Festig.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness of sins and firmness
Duʿāʾ um Vergebung der Sünden und Festig.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, and make our feet firm.

Unser Herr, wir glauben, so vergib uns u.title: Forgive us and have mercy on us
Unser Herr, wir glauben, so vergib uns u.occasion: Repentance and a plea for mercy
Unser Herr, wir glauben, so vergib uns u.meaning: Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

Vergib uns und erbarme Dich unser.title: Forgive us and have mercy on us
Vergib uns und erbarme Dich unser.occasion: Repentance and a plea for mercy
Vergib uns und erbarme Dich unser.meaning: Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

Mein Herr, vergib und erbarme Dich, denn.title: My Lord, forgive and have mercy
Mein Herr, vergib und erbarme Dich, denn.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

Mein Herr, vergib und erbarme Dich.title: My Lord, forgive and have mercy
Mein Herr, vergib und erbarme Dich.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy.

Und beschäme mich nicht am Tag, an dem s.title: Let me come with a sound heart
Und beschäme mich nicht am Tag, an dem s.meaning: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are raised; the Day when neither wealth nor children will benefit, except one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart.

Lass mich mit einem gesunden Herzen komm.title: Let me come with a sound heart
Lass mich mit einem gesunden Herzen komm.meaning: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are raised; the Day when neither wealth nor children will benefit, except one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart.

Mein Herr, schenke mir Urteilskraft und.title: Grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous
Mein Herr, schenke mir Urteilskraft und.occasion: A plea for wisdom and a good end
Mein Herr, schenke mir Urteilskraft und.meaning: My Lord, grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous.

Gib mir Urteilskraft und füge mich den R.title: Grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous
Gib mir Urteilskraft und füge mich den R.occasion: A plea for wisdom and a good end
Gib mir Urteilskraft und füge mich den R.meaning: My Lord, grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous.

Und mache mir einen wahrhaftigen Ruf unt.title: Grant me a truthful reputation
Und mache mir einen wahrhaftigen Ruf unt.meaning: And grant me a truthful reputation among later generations.

Schenke mir einen wahrhaftigen Ruf.title: Grant me a truthful reputation
Schenke mir einen wahrhaftigen Ruf.meaning: And grant me a truthful reputation among later generations.

Und mache mich zu den Erben des Gartens.title: Make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss
Und mache mich zu den Erben des Gartens.meaning: And make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss.

Mache mich zu den Erben des Gartens der.title: Make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss
Mache mich zu den Erben des Gartens der.meaning: And make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss.

Mein Herr, rette mich vor dem ungerechte.title: Save me from the wrongdoing people
Mein Herr, rette mich vor dem ungerechte.meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

Rette mich vor dem ungerechten Volk.title: Save me from the wrongdoing people
Rette mich vor dem ungerechten Volk.meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

Mein Herr, leite mich an, Deine Gunst da.title: Guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor
Mein Herr, leite mich an, Deine Gunst da.meaning: My Lord, guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents.

Leite mich an, Deine Gunst dankbar zu er.title: Guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor
Leite mich an, Deine Gunst dankbar zu er.meaning: My Lord, guide me to gratefully recognize Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents.

Und dass ich rechtschaffen handle, womit.title: Guide me to righteous deeds
Und dass ich rechtschaffen handle, womit.meaning: And that I do righteous deeds with which You are pleased.

Leite mich zu rechtschaffenen Taten.title: Guide me to righteous deeds
Leite mich zu rechtschaffenen Taten.meaning: And that I do righteous deeds with which You are pleased.

Und lass mich durch Deine Barmherzigkeit.title: Admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants
Und lass mich durch Deine Barmherzigkeit.meaning: And admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.

Lass mich durch Deine Barmherzigkeit unt.title: Admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants
Lass mich durch Deine Barmherzigkeit unt.meaning: And admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.

Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns und.title: Our Lord, judge between us in truth
Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns und.occasion: When truth and falsehood stand opposed
Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns und.meaning: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, and You are the Best of judges.

Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns in W.title: Our Lord, judge between us in truth
Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns in W.occasion: When truth and falsehood stand opposed
Unser Herr, entscheide zwischen uns in W.meaning: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, and You are the Best of judges.

Unser Herr, gieße Geduld über uns aus un.title: Let us die as Muslims
Unser Herr, gieße Geduld über uns aus un.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.

Lass uns als Muslime sterben.title: Let us die as Muslims
Lass uns als Muslime sterben.meaning: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.

Unser Herr, Du umfasst alles mit Barmher.title: Our Lord encompasses all things in mercy and knowledge
Unser Herr, Du umfasst alles mit Barmher.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and protection from the Fire
Unser Herr, Du umfasst alles mit Barmher.meaning: Our Lord, You encompass all things in mercy and knowledge. Forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

Unser Herr umfasst alles mit Barmherzigk.title: Our Lord encompasses all things in mercy and knowledge
Unser Herr umfasst alles mit Barmherzigk.occasion: A plea for forgiveness and protection from the Fire
Unser Herr umfasst alles mit Barmherzigk.meaning: Our Lord, You encompass all things in mercy and knowledge. Forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

Unser Herr, lass sie in die Gärten von ʿ.title: Admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn
Unser Herr, lass sie in die Gärten von ʿ.occasion: Duʿāʾ for the believers and their families
Unser Herr, lass sie in die Gärten von ʿ.meaning: Our Lord, admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn which You have promised them, and the righteous among their fathers, their spouses, and their descendants.

Lass sie in die Gärten von ʿAdn eintrete.title: Admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn
Lass sie in die Gärten von ʿAdn eintrete.occasion: Duʿāʾ for the believers and their families
Lass sie in die Gärten von ʿAdn eintrete.meaning: Our Lord, admit them into the Gardens of ʿAdn which You have promised them, and the righteous among their fathers, their spouses, and their descendants.

Und bewahre sie vor den schlechten Taten.title: Protect them from evil deeds
Und bewahre sie vor den schlechten Taten.occasion: Protection from sins and a bad end
Und bewahre sie vor den schlechten Taten.meaning: And protect them from evil deeds. Whomever You protect from evil deeds on that Day, him You have had mercy upon.

Bewahre sie vor schlechten Taten.title: Protect them from evil deeds
Bewahre sie vor schlechten Taten.occasion: Protection from sins and a bad end
Bewahre sie vor schlechten Taten.meaning: And protect them from evil deeds. Whomever You protect from evil deeds on that Day, him You have had mercy upon.

Unser Herr, vergib uns und unseren Brüde.title: Forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
Unser Herr, vergib uns und unseren Brüde.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

Vergib uns und unseren Brüdern, die uns.title: Forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
Vergib uns und unseren Brüdern, die uns.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

Und lass in unseren Herzen keinen Groll.title: Leave no rancor in our hearts toward the believers
Und lass in unseren Herzen keinen Groll.occasion: Purification of the heart toward the Muslims
Und lass in unseren Herzen keinen Groll.meaning: And place no rancor in our hearts toward those who believe. Our Lord, You are surely Kind and Merciful.

Lass keinen Groll in unseren Herzen gege.title: Leave no rancor in our hearts toward the believers
Lass keinen Groll in unseren Herzen gege.occasion: Purification of the heart toward the Muslims
Lass keinen Groll in unseren Herzen gege.meaning: And place no rancor in our hearts toward those who believe. Our Lord, You are surely Kind and Merciful.

Unser Herr, auf Dich vertrauen wir, zu D.title: In You we trust and to You we turn
Unser Herr, auf Dich vertrauen wir, zu D.meaning: Our Lord, in You we place our trust, to You we turn in repentance, and to You is the return.

Auf Dich vertrauen wir und zu Dir kehren.title: In You we trust and to You we turn
Auf Dich vertrauen wir und zu Dir kehren.meaning: Our Lord, in You we place our trust, to You we turn in repentance, and to You is the return.

Unser Herr, mache uns nicht zur Versuchu.title: Do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve
Unser Herr, mache uns nicht zur Versuchu.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord.

Mache uns nicht zur Versuchung für die U.title: Do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve
Mache uns nicht zur Versuchung für die U.meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord.

Unser Herr, vollende unser Licht für uns.title: Complete our light for us and forgive us
Unser Herr, vollende unser Licht für uns.occasion: A plea for light and forgiveness
Unser Herr, vollende unser Licht für uns.meaning: Our Lord, complete our light for us and forgive us. You surely have power over all things.

Vollende unser Licht und vergib uns.title: Complete our light for us and forgive us
Vollende unser Licht und vergib uns.occasion: A plea for light and forgiveness
Vollende unser Licht und vergib uns.meaning: Our Lord, complete our light for us and forgive us. You surely have power over all things.

O Allah, leite mich unter denen, die Du.title: Duʿāʾ al-Qunūt in the Witr
O Allah, leite mich unter denen, die Du.meaning: O Allāh, guide me among those whom You have guided; grant me well-being among those whom You have granted well-being; and take me into Your care among those whom You have taken into Your care.

Duʿāʾ al-Qunūt im Witr.title: Duʿāʾ al-Qunūt in the Witr
Duʿāʾ al-Qunūt im Witr.meaning: O Allāh, guide me among those whom You have guided; grant me well-being among those whom You have granted well-being; and take me into Your care among those whom You have taken into Your care.

O Wender der Herzen, festige mein Herz a.title: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm
O Wender der Herzen, festige mein Herz a.meaning: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

O Wender der Herzen, festige mein Herz.title: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm
O Wender der Herzen, festige mein Herz.meaning: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

O Allah, ich bitte Dich um Rechtleitung,.title: Supplication for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment
O Allah, ich bitte Dich um Rechtleitung,.meaning: O Allāh, I ask You for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment.

Bitte um Rechtleitung, Taqwā, Keuschheit.title: Supplication for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment
Bitte um Rechtleitung, Taqwā, Keuschheit.meaning: O Allāh, I ask You for guidance, Taqwā, chastity and contentment.

O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.title: Protection from knowledge that brings no benefit
O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.occasion: Knowledge and protection of the heart
O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that brings no benefit, from a heart that is not humble, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a Duʿāʾ that is not answered.

Schutz vor Wissen, das nicht nützt.title: Protection from knowledge that brings no benefit
Schutz vor Wissen, das nicht nützt.occasion: Knowledge and protection of the heart
Schutz vor Wissen, das nicht nützt.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that brings no benefit, from a heart that is not humble, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a Duʿāʾ that is not answered.

O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.title: Protection from the vanishing of favor
O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the vanishing of Your favor, from the change of Your well-being, from the sudden coming of Your punishment, and from everything that provokes Your anger.

Schutz vor dem Verschwinden der Gunst.title: Protection from the vanishing of favor
Schutz vor dem Verschwinden der Gunst.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the vanishing of Your favor, from the change of Your well-being, from the sudden coming of Your punishment, and from everything that provokes Your anger.

O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.title: Protection from severe trial and an evil fate
O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.occasion: Protection from hardship, misery and gloating
O Allah, ich suche Zuflucht bei Dir vor.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from severe trial, from reaching misery, from an evil fate, and from the gloating of enemies.

Schutz vor schwerer Prüfung und schlecht.title: Protection from severe trial and an evil fate
Schutz vor schwerer Prüfung und schlecht.occasion: Protection from hardship, misery and gloating
Schutz vor schwerer Prüfung und schlecht.meaning: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from severe trial, from reaching misery, from an evil fate, and from the gloating of enemies.

Unser Herr, lass unsere Herzen nicht abw.occasion: Against the heart turning away after guidance
Unser Herr, lass unsere Herzen nicht abw.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Giver.

Duʿāʾ um festen Iman und Barmherzigkeit.occasion: Against the heart turning away after guidance
Duʿāʾ um festen Iman und Barmherzigkeit.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Giver.

Mein Herr, mehre mein Wissen..occasion: When learning, studying and asking for beneficial knowledge
Mein Herr, mehre mein Wissen..meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

Duʿāʾ um mehr Wissen.title: Duʿāʾ for more knowledge
Duʿāʾ um mehr Wissen.occasion: When learning, studying and asking for beneficial knowledge
Duʿāʾ um mehr Wissen.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

Unser Herr, lege uns keine schwere Last.title: Duʿāʾ against a heavy burden
Unser Herr, lege uns keine schwere Last.occasion: In overwhelm, strain and heavy responsibility
Unser Herr, lege uns keine schwere Last.meaning: Our Lord, do not lay upon us a heavy burden as You laid it upon those before us.

Duʿāʾ gegen schwere Last.occasion: In overwhelm, strain and heavy responsibility
Duʿāʾ gegen schwere Last.meaning: Our Lord, do not lay upon us a heavy burden as You laid it upon those before us.

Unser Herr, belaste uns nicht mit dem, w.occasion: In weakness, sin and great strain
Unser Herr, belaste uns nicht mit dem, w.meaning: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear; pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us.

Duʿāʾ um Nachsicht, Vergebung und Barmhe.occasion: In weakness, sin and great strain
Duʿāʾ um Nachsicht, Vergebung und Barmhe.meaning: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear; pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us.

Unser Herr, wir glauben; so vergib uns u.occasion: A general plea for forgiveness and salvation
Unser Herr, wir glauben; so vergib uns u.meaning: Our Lord, we believe; so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Duʿāʾ um Vergebung und Schutz vor dem Fe.title: Duʿāʾ for forgiveness and protection from the Fire
Duʿāʾ um Vergebung und Schutz vor dem Fe.occasion: A general plea for forgiveness and salvation
Duʿāʾ um Vergebung und Schutz vor dem Fe.meaning: Our Lord, we believe; so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Unser Herr, wir glauben an das, was Du h.occasion: When faith is made firm and revelation is affirmed
Unser Herr, wir glauben an das, was Du h.meaning: Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down and we follow the Messenger; so record us among the witnesses.

Duʿāʾ um Zugehörigkeit zu den Bezeugende.title: Duʿāʾ to be recorded among the witnesses
Duʿāʾ um Zugehörigkeit zu den Bezeugende.occasion: When faith is made firm and revelation is affirmed
Duʿāʾ um Zugehörigkeit zu den Bezeugende.meaning: Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down and we follow the Messenger; so record us among the witnesses.

Unser Herr, vergib uns unsere Sünden und.occasion: In trial, struggle against one’s own Nafs and steadfastness
Unser Herr, vergib uns unsere Sünden und.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

Duʿāʾ um Vergebung, Festigkeit und Sieg.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

Unser Herr, Du hast dies nicht sinnlos e.occasion: When reflecting on the heavens, the earth and the signs of Allāh
Unser Herr, Du hast dies nicht sinnlos e.meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Duʿāʾ beim Nachdenken über die Schöpfung.meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
